And I passed by you and saw you kicking about in your blood, and I said to you in your blood, "Live!" — and I said to you in your blood, "Live!"
A myriad, like the growth of the field, I made you; and you grew and became great and came to the finest of ornaments. Your breasts were firm and your hair had grown, and you were naked and bare.

And I passed by you and saw you, and there — your time was the time of love. And I spread the skirt of my garment over you and covered your nakedness; and I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you — declares Lord GOD — and you became mine.
And I washed you with water and rinsed your blood off you, and I anointed you with oil.
And I clothed you with embroidered cloth and shod you with fine leather, and I wrapped your head with fine linen and covered you with silk.
And I adorned you with ornaments and put bracelets on your hands and a chain on your neck.
And I put a ring in your nose and earrings on your ears, and a crown of beauty on your head.

And you adorned yourself with gold and silver, and your clothing was fine linen and silk and embroidered cloth. Fine flour and honey and oil you ate, and you became beautiful, very, very, and you prospered into kingship.
And a name went out for you among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through my splendour that I had put upon you — declares Lord GOD.
But you trusted in your beauty and whored on the strength of your name, and you poured out your whorings on every passer-by — let it be his!
And you took some of your clothes and made for yourself high places of many colours, and you whored on them — such as should not come and should not be.
And you took your articles of beauty, from my gold and from my silver that I had given you, and you made for yourself male images, and you whored with them.
And you took your embroidered clothes and covered them, and my oil and my incense you set before them.
And my bread that I gave you — fine flour and oil and honey I fed you — you set before them for a soothing odour; and so it was, declares Lord GOD.
And you took your sons and your daughters whom you had borne to me, and you sacrificed them to them to be devoured. Was your whoring too little?
And you slaughtered my children and gave them up, making them pass over to them.
And in all your abominations and your whorings you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.
And it was, after all your evil — woe, woe to you! declares Lord GOD —
you built for yourself a mound and made for yourself a high place in every open square.
At the head of every road you built your high place, and you made your beauty an abomination, and you spread your legs open to every passer-by, and you multiplied your whorings.
And you whored with the Egyptians, your neighbours, big of flesh; and you multiplied your whoring to provoke me to anger.

And look, I stretched out my hand against you and cut back your allotted portion, and I gave you over to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your licentious conduct.
And you whored with the Assyrians, because you were not satisfied; and you whored with them, and even so you were not satisfied.
And you multiplied your whoring toward a land of merchants, toward Chaldea; and even by this you were not satisfied.
How sick is your heart — declares Lord GOD — that you do all these things, the deeds of a woman, a whore, and a domineering one!
When you built your mound at the head of every road and made your high place in every open square — and you were not like the whore, in that you scorned the whore's fee.
The adulterous wife, who takes strangers in place of her husband!
To all whores men give a gift; but you gave your gifts to all your lovers and bribed them to come to you from all around for your whorings.
And in you it was the opposite of other women in your whorings: no one whored after you, and you gave a fee when no fee was given to you. You became the opposite.
Therefore, whore, hear the word of the LORD!

This is what Lord GOD says: Because your lust was poured out and your nakedness uncovered in your whorings with your lovers, and because of all the idols of your abominations, and because of the blood of your children that you gave to them —

therefore look, I am gathering all your lovers to whom you were pleasing, and all whom you loved along with all whom you hated; and I will gather them against you from all around, and I will uncover your nakedness to them, and they will see all your nakedness.
And I will judge you with the judgements of adulteresses and of women who shed blood, and I will bring on you the blood of rage and jealousy.

And I will give you into their hand, and they will tear down your mound and break down your high places; and they will strip your clothes off you and take your articles of beauty, and leave you naked and bare.
And they will bring up a company against you and stone you with stones and cut you to pieces with their swords.
And they will burn your houses with fire and perform acts of judgement on you before the eyes of many women; and I will make you cease from being a whore, and you will give a fee no more.
And I will give my rage rest upon you, and my jealousy will turn aside from you; and I will be quiet and will not be angry any more.

Because you did not remember the days of your youth and enraged me with all these things, look, I too have requited your conduct on your head — declares Lord GOD — and have you not committed licentiousness on top of all your abominations?
Look, everyone who quotes a proverb will quote one about you: "Like mother, like daughter."

You are your mother's daughter, who loathed her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
And your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, who lives to your north; and your sister who is younger than you, who lives to your south, is Sodom and her daughters.
And you did not walk in their ways or act according to their abominations — as if that were a little thing — and you acted more corruptly than they did in all your ways.
As I live — declares Lord GOD — Sodom your sister, she and her daughters, did not do as you have done, you and your daughters.
Look, this was the iniquity of Sodom your sister: pride, surfeit of food and untroubled ease belonged to her and her daughters; and she did not strengthen the hand of the poor and the needy.
And they were haughty and did abomination before me; and I removed them when I saw it.
And Samaria did not sin as much as half your sins; and you multiplied your abominations more than they did, and you made your sisters appear righteous by all your abominations that you have done.

You too, bear your disgrace, you who have interceded for your sister: by your sins, in which you acted more abominably than they did, they are more righteous than you. And you too, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, because you made your sisters appear righteous.
And I will turn back their captivity — the captivity of Sodom and her daughters and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters — and the captivity of your captives among them,
so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all that you have done, in comforting them.

And your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former state; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former state; and you and your daughters will return to your former state.
And was not Sodom your sister a byword in your mouth in the day of your pride,
before your own evil was uncovered — like the time of the reproach of the daughters of Aram and all those around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you on every side?
Your licentiousness and your abominations — you have borne them, declares the LORD.
For this is what Lord GOD says: And I will deal with you as you have done, you who despised an oath by breaking a covenant.
But I myself will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish for you a perpetual covenant.
And you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when you receive your sisters, those older than you and those younger than you; and I will give them to you as daughters, though not by your covenant.
And I myself will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD,
so that you may remember and be ashamed, and may no longer open your mouth because of your disgrace, when I make atonement for you for all that you have done — declares Lord GOD."

ezekiel_17.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, put a riddle and speak a proverb to the house of Israel,
and say: This is what Lord GOD says: The great eagle, great of wing, long of pinion, full of plumage, which had the variegated feathers, came to Lebanon and took the treetop of the cedar.
It plucked off the top of its shoots and brought it to a land of merchants; in a city of traders it set it.
And it took some of the seed of the land and put it in a seed-field; it took it by many waters and set it like a willow.
And it sprouted and became a spreading vine, low of stature, its branches turning toward it and its roots under it; and it became a vine and produced shoots and sent out boughs.

And there was another great eagle, great of wing and abundant of plumage; and look, this vine bent its roots toward it and sent out its branches to it, for it to water the vine, away from the beds where it was planted.
It was planted in a good field, by many waters, to produce branches and bear fruit, to become a splendid vine.

Say: This is what Lord GOD says: Will it prosper? Will he not pull up its roots and strip off its fruit, so that it withers — all its fresh growth will wither — and not by a great arm or by many people, to lift it from its roots?
And look, it is planted — will it prosper? When the east wind touches it, will it not utterly wither? On the beds where it grew it will wither."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Say now to the house of rebellion: Do you not know what these things are? Say: Look, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its princes and brought them to himself, to Babylon.
And he took one of the royal offspring and made a covenant with him and brought him under an oath; and he took away the leading men of the land,
so that the kingdom should be lowly and not exalt itself, but keep his covenant so that it might stand.
But he rebelled against him by sending his messengers to Egypt, to give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one who does these things escape? Will he break a covenant and escape?
As I live — declares Lord GOD — surely in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke, with him, in the middle of Babylon, he will die.
And Pharaoh will not act on his behalf in the battle with a large army or a great company, when a ramp is thrown up and a siege-wall built to cut off many lives.
He despised an oath by breaking a covenant; and look, he had given his hand, and he did all these things — he will not escape.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: As I live, surely my oath that he despised and my covenant that he broke — I will requite it on his own head.

And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my hunting net; and I will bring him to Babylon and enter into judgement with him there for the unfaithfulness by which he acted unfaithfully against me.
And all his fugitives, among all his troops, will fall by the sword, and those who survive will be scattered to every wind; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.

This is what Lord GOD says: And I myself will take from the treetop of the high cedar and will set it out; from the top of its shoots I will pluck off a tender one, and I myself will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

On the mountain height of Israel I will plant it, and it will bear branches and produce fruit and become a majestic cedar; and under it will dwell every bird of every wing — in the shade of its branches they will dwell.

And all the trees of the field will know that I, the LORD, bring low the tall tree and raise up the low tree, dry up the green tree and make the dry tree sprout. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it."

ezekiel_18.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"What do you mean by speaking this proverb concerning the land of Israel: 'Fathers eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?
As I live — declares Lord GOD — you will no longer have occasion to speak this proverb in Israel.
Look, all lives are mine: as the life of the father, so the life of the son — they are mine. The person who sins, that one will die.
And if a man is righteous and does justice and righteousness —

he has not eaten on the mountains and has not lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; he has not made his neighbour's wife unclean and has not drawn near to a woman in her menstrual impurity;
and he has not oppressed anyone, has returned the debtor's pledge, has robbed no one, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with clothing;
he has not lent at interest and has not taken increase, has turned his hand back from injustice, has done true justice between one person and another;
he walks in my statutes and has kept my judgements, acting faithfully — he is righteous. He shall surely live, declares Lord GOD.
And he fathers a violent son, a shedder of blood, who does any one of these things,
though the father himself did none of these things — for the son has even eaten on the mountains and made his neighbour's wife unclean,
has oppressed the poor and the needy, has robbed and robbed, has not returned a pledge; and he has lifted his eyes to the idols, has done abomination,
has lent at interest and taken increase — and shall he live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations; he shall surely be put to death. His blood will be upon him.
And look, he fathers a son who has seen all the sins of his father that he did — and he saw, and did not do like them:
he has not eaten on the mountains and has not lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; he has not made his neighbour's wife unclean;
and he has not oppressed anyone, has not taken a pledge, has robbed no one, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with clothing;
he has turned his hand back from the poor, has not taken interest or increase, has done my judgements and walked in my statutes — he will not die for his father's iniquity. He shall surely live.
His father, because he extorted and extorted, robbed his brother, and did what was not good among his people — look, he will die for his own iniquity.
And you say, "Why has the son not borne the iniquity of the father?" But the son has done justice and righteousness, has kept all my statutes and done them; he shall surely live.

The person who sins, that one will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of the father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous will be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked will be upon him.
And if the wicked turns back from all his sins that he has done and keeps all my statutes and does justice and righteousness, he shall surely live; he will not die.
All his transgressions that he has done will not be remembered against him. For the righteousness he has done he will live.
Do I really take pleasure in the death of the wicked — declares Lord GOD — and not rather that he should turn back from his ways and live?

And when a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice, doing according to all the abominations that the wicked does — shall he live? None of the righteous acts he has done will be remembered. For the unfaithfulness by which he acted unfaithfully and the sin by which he sinned — for them he will die.
And you say, "The way of the Lord is not right." Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not right? Is it not your ways that are not right?
When a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice and dies for them — for the injustice he has done he dies.
And when a wicked one turns from the wickedness he has done and does justice and righteousness, he will keep his own life alive.
And he saw and turned back from all the transgressions he had done; he shall surely live, he will not die.
And the house of Israel say, "The way of the Lord is not right." Are my ways not right, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are not right?
Therefore I will judge you, each according to his ways, house of Israel — declares Lord GOD. Turn back and turn away from all your transgressions, and iniquity will not be a stumbling block to you.
Throw away from yourselves all the transgressions by which you have transgressed, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. And why will you die, house of Israel?
For I take no pleasure in the death of the one who dies — declares Lord GOD. So turn back and live!"

ezekiel_19.t: "And you, take up a lamentation over the princes of Israel,
and say: What a lioness your mother was among lions! She lay down among young lions; she reared her cubs.
And she brought up one of her cubs; he became a young lion. And he learned to tear prey; he devoured humans.
And nations heard of him; he was caught in their pit, and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
And she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope was lost; and she took one of her cubs and made him a young lion.
And he went about among lions; he became a young lion. And he learned to tear prey; he devoured humans.
And he knew their widows, and he laid waste their cities; and the land and all that fills it were desolate at the sound of his roaring.
And nations set on him from the provinces all around; and they spread their net over him — he was caught in their pit.
And they put him in a cage with hooks and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, so that his voice would no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by water; she was fruitful and full of branches from the abundant waters.
And she had strong branches fit for the sceptres of rulers; and its stature towered above the thick boughs, and it was conspicuous in its height, in the abundance of its branches.
But she was plucked up in rage, thrown down to the ground; and the east wind dried up her fruit. They were torn off and withered — her strong branch; fire consumed it.
And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
And fire went out from the branch of her shoots; it consumed her fruit. And there was in her no strong branch, no sceptre for ruling. This is a lamentation, and it has become a lamentation.

ezekiel_20.t: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of Israel came to consult the LORD, and they sat down before me.
And the word of the LORD came to me:

"Mortal, speak with the elders of Israel and say to them: This is what Lord GOD says: Is it to consult me that you are coming? As I live, I will not let myself be consulted by you — declares Lord GOD.
Will you judge them? Will you judge, mortal? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers,

and say to them: This is what Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I raised my hand in an oath to the offspring of the house of Jacob and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt; and I raised my hand in an oath to them, saying, 'I am the LORD your God.'
On that day I raised my hand in an oath to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt to a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey — it is the beauty of all lands.
And I said to them: Each of you, throw away the detestable things your eyes are set on, and do not make yourselves unclean with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

But they rebelled against me and were not willing to listen to me. None of them threw away the detestable things his eyes were set on, and they did not forsake the idols of Egypt. And I said I would pour out my rage on them, to complete my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.

But I acted for the sake of my name, so that it should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations among whom they were — before whose eyes I had made myself known to them, in bringing them out from the land of Egypt.
And I brought them out from the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
And I gave them my statutes and made known to them my judgements, which a person will live by if he does them.
And also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, so that they would know that I am the LORD who sets them apart as holy.

But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not walk in my statutes and they rejected my judgements, which a person will live by if he does them; and my sabbaths they profaned exceedingly. And I said I would pour out my rage on them in the wilderness, to make an end of them.
But I acted for the sake of my name, so that it should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations before whose eyes I had brought them out.
And I also raised my hand in an oath to them in the wilderness, not to bring them into the land that I had given, flowing with milk and honey — it is the beauty of all lands —
because they had rejected my judgements and had not walked in my statutes and had profaned my sabbaths; for their heart was walking after their idols.
But my eye spared them, so as not to destroy them, and I did not make an end of them in the wilderness.
And I said to their children in the wilderness: Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, do not keep their judgements, and do not make yourselves unclean with their idols.
I am the LORD your God. Walk in my statutes and keep my judgements and do them,
and set my sabbaths apart as holy; and they will be a sign between me and you, so that you will know that I am the LORD your God.

But the children rebelled against me. They did not walk in my statutes and did not keep my judgements, to do them — which a person will live by if he does them; my sabbaths they profaned. And I said I would pour out my rage on them, to complete my anger against them in the wilderness.
But I turned back my hand and acted for the sake of my name, so that it should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations before whose eyes I had brought them out.
Also I raised my hand in an oath to them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the lands,
because they had not done my judgements and had rejected my statutes and had profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
And I also gave them statutes that were not good, and judgements by which they could not live;
and I made them unclean by their own gifts, in making every firstborn of the womb pass over — so that I might make them appalled, so that they would know that I am the LORD.
Therefore speak to the house of Israel, mortal, and say to them: This is what Lord GOD says: In this also your fathers blasphemed me, by acting unfaithfully against me.

And I brought them into the land that I had raised my hand in an oath to give them; and they saw every high hill and every leafy tree, and there they sacrificed their sacrifices, there they presented their provoking offering, there they set their soothing odours, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
And I said to them: What is this high place that you go to? And its name has been called Bamah to this day.
Therefore say to the house of Israel: This is what Lord GOD says: Are you making yourselves unclean in the way of your fathers, and whoring after their detestable things?

And in lifting up your gifts, in making your children pass through the fire, you are making yourselves unclean with all your idols to this day. And shall I let myself be consulted by you, house of Israel? As I live — declares Lord GOD — I will not let myself be consulted by you.
And what comes up in your spirit will certainly not happen — what you are saying: 'We will be like the nations, like the clans of the lands, serving wood and stone.'
As I live — declares Lord GOD — surely with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with rage poured out I will reign over you.
And I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered, with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with rage poured out.
And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgement with you, face to face.
Just as I entered into judgement with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgement with you — declares Lord GOD.
And I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

And I will purge out from among you those who rebel and those who transgress against me. From the land of their sojournings I will bring them out, but into the land of Israel they will not come; and you will know that I am the LORD.

And you, house of Israel — this is what Lord GOD says: Go, serve each of you his idols; and afterwards, if you will not listen to me — but my holy name you shall no longer profane with your gifts and with your idols.

For on my holy mountain, on the mountain height of Israel — declares Lord GOD — there all the house of Israel, all of it, will serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will seek your contributions and the choicest of your gifts, with all your holy things.

As a soothing odour I will accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you have been scattered; and I will show myself holy among you before the eyes of the nations.
And you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land that I raised my hand in an oath to give to your fathers.
And there you will remember your ways and all your practices by which you made yourselves unclean; and you will loathe yourselves to your own faces for all the evils you have done.
And you will know that I am the LORD, when I deal with you for the sake of my name — not according to your evil ways or your corrupt practices, house of Israel — declares Lord GOD."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, set your face toward the south, and prophesy against the south, and prophesy against the forest land of the Negev.

And say to the forest of the Negev: Hear the word of the LORD. This is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am kindling a fire in you, and it will consume in you every green tree and every dry tree. The blazing flame will not be extinguished, and by it every face from the south to the north will be scorched.
And all flesh will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it; it will not be extinguished."
And I said, "Alas, Lord GOD! They are saying of me, 'Is he not just a maker of parables?'"

ezekiel_21.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, set your face toward Jerusalem and prophesy against the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
And say to the land of Israel: This is what the LORD says: Look, I am against you, and I will bring my sword out of its sheath and cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
Because I am cutting off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh, from south to north.
And all flesh will know that I, the LORD, have brought my sword out of its sheath; it will not go back again."
"And you, mortal, groan; with breaking loins and with bitterness, groan before their eyes.

And when they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' you shall say: Because of a report — for it is coming, and every heart will melt and all hands will hang limp, and every spirit will grow faint and all knees will run with water. Look, it is coming, and it will happen — declares Lord GOD."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, prophesy and say: This is what the Lord says: Say: A sword, a sword — sharpened, and also polished!
Sharpened for slaughtering a slaughter, polished so as to flash like lightning — or shall we rejoice? The rod of my son rejects every tree.
And he gave it to be polished, to be grasped in the hand. It has been sharpened, a sword, and it has been polished, to be put into the hand of the slayer.
Cry out and wail, mortal, for it has come upon my people; it is upon all the princes of Israel. Thrown to the sword they have been, along with my people. Therefore slap your thigh.
For it has been tested — and what if even the rejecting rod does not come? declares Lord GOD."
"And you, mortal, prophesy and strike palm against palm. And let the sword be doubled a third time — the sword of the slain; it is the sword of the great slain one that closes in on them,
so that the heart may melt and the stumblings be many. At all their gates I have set the slaughter of a sword. Alas! It is made to flash like lightning, wrapped for slaughtering.
Be sharp! Go right! Set yourself! Go left! Wherever your face is appointed.
And I too will strike my palm against my palm and give my rage rest. I, the LORD, have spoken."
And the word of the LORD came to me:

"And you, mortal, mark out for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to come by. Both of them shall go out from one land; and make a signpost — make it at the head of the road to a city.
Mark out a road for the sword to come to Rabbah of the Ammonites, and to Judah, in fortified Jerusalem.

For the king of Babylon has stopped at the fork of the road, at the head of the two roads, to practise divination. He has shaken the arrows, he has enquired of the teraphim, he has looked at the liver.

Into his right hand came the divination — Jerusalem: to set up battering-rams, to open the mouth with a killing shout, to lift the voice with a war cry, to set up battering-rams against the gates, to throw up a ramp, to build a siege-wall.
And it will seem to them like a false divination — they who have sworn oaths! But he brings iniquity to remembrance, so that they may be seized.

Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Because you have brought your iniquity to remembrance, in that your transgressions are uncovered so that your sins are seen in all your practices — because you have been brought to remembrance, you will be seized by the hand.
And you, profaned and wicked one, prince of Israel, whose day has come at the time of final punishment —
this is what Lord GOD says: Remove the turban and lift off the crown! This shall not be this. Exalt the lowly and bring low the exalted.
A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I will make it! And this too will not be, until he comes to whom the judgement belongs; and I will give it to him.

"And you, mortal, prophesy and say: This is what Lord GOD says concerning the Ammonites and concerning their reproach; and say: A sword, a sword — drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, so as to flash like lightning!
while they see worthlessness for you, while they divine falsehood for you — to lay you on the necks of the profaned wicked, whose day has come at the time of final punishment.
Put it back into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origins, I will judge you.
And I will pour out my indignation on you; with the fire of my wrath I will blow on you, and I will give you into the hand of brutish men, craftsmen of destruction.
You will become fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the middle of the land; you will not be remembered. For I, the LORD, have spoken."

ezekiel_22.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"And you, mortal — will you judge? will you judge the city of blood? Then make known to her all her abominations,
and say: This is what Lord GOD says: A city that sheds blood in her midst, so that her time comes; and that has made idols for herself, to become unclean!

By the blood you have shed you have become guilty, and by the idols you have made you have become unclean; you have brought your days near and have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a derision to all the lands.
Those near and those far from you will deride you — you of unclean name, great in turmoil!
Look, the princes of Israel — each according to his own strength — have been in you, so as to shed blood.
Father and mother they have treated with contempt in you; the sojourner they have oppressed in your midst; the fatherless and the widow they have maltreated in you.
My holy things you have despised, and my sabbaths you have profaned.
Men of slander have been in you, so as to shed blood; they have eaten on the mountains in you; licentiousness they have done in your midst.
A father's nakedness has been uncovered in you; the woman unclean in her menstrual impurity has been violated in you.
One has done abomination with his neighbour's wife; one has made his daughter-in-law unclean with licentiousness; one has violated his sister, his father's daughter, in you.

A bribe they have taken in you, so as to shed blood. Interest and increase you have taken, and you have made unjust gain from your neighbours by oppression; and me you have forgotten — declares Lord GOD.
And look, I have struck my palm at the unjust gain you have made, and at the blood that has been in your midst.
Will your heart endure, or will your hands be strong, in the days when I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the lands, and I will make an end of your uncleanness from you.
And you will be profaned by your own doing before the eyes of the nations; and you will know that I am the LORD."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are copper and tin and iron and lead in the middle of a furnace; they have become the dross of silver.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Because all of you have become dross, therefore look, I am gathering you into the middle of Jerusalem.

As silver and copper and iron and lead and tin are gathered into the middle of a furnace, to blow fire on it to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my rage, and I will set you down and melt you.
And I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.
As silver is melted in the middle of a furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my rage on you."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, say to her: You are a land that has not been cleansed, not rained on in a day of indignation.
A conspiracy of her prophets is in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing prey. They have devoured lives; they take treasure and precious things; they have made many widows in her midst.

Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. Between the holy and the common they have not separated, and between the unclean and the clean they have taught no difference; and from my sabbaths they have hidden their eyes, and I have been profaned among them.
Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing prey, to shed blood, to destroy lives, so as to make unjust gain.
And her prophets have plastered whitewash for them, seeing worthlessness and divining falsehood for them, saying, 'This is what Lord GOD says,' when the LORD had not spoken.
The people of the land have oppressed and oppressed and robbed and robbed; they have maltreated the poor and the needy, and have oppressed the sojourner without justice.
And I sought from among them someone to build up a wall and stand in the breach before me for the land, so that I should not destroy it; but I found no one.
And I have poured out my indignation on them; with the fire of my wrath I have made an end of them. Their conduct I have requited on their own head — declares Lord GOD."

ezekiel_23.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, there were two women, daughters of one mother.
And they whored in Egypt; in their youth they whored. There their breasts were handled, and there their virgin nipples were squeezed.
And their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister; and they became mine and bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
And Oholah whored while she was mine, and lusted after her lovers, after Assyria — warriors,
clothed in violet, governors and officials, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding horses.
And she gave her whorings to them — all of them the choicest of the Assyrians — and by all whom she lusted after, by all their idols, she made herself unclean.
And she did not forsake her whorings from Egypt, for they had lain with her in her youth and had squeezed her virgin nipples and poured out their whoring on her.
Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, after whom she lusted.
They uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters, and her they killed with the sword. And she became a byword among women, and they carried out acts of judgement on her.
And her sister Oholibah saw, and she was more corrupt in her lusting than she was, and her whorings were more than her sister's whorings.
She lusted after the Assyrians — governors and officials, warriors magnificently clothed, horsemen riding horses, all of them desirable young men.
And I saw that she had made herself unclean; both of them had one way.
And she added to her whorings. She saw men carved on the wall, images of Chaldeans inscribed in vermilion,
girded with a waistband at their hips, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them with the appearance of officers, the likeness of the Babylonians — Chaldea was the land of their birth.
And she lusted after them at the sight of her eyes, and sent messengers to them, to Chaldea.
And the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and they made her unclean with their whoring; and she became unclean by them, and she turned away from them in disgust.
And she uncovered her whorings and uncovered her nakedness; and I turned away from her in disgust, as I had turned away from her sister.
And she multiplied her whorings, remembering the days of her youth, when she whored in the land of Egypt.
And she lusted after their paramours, whose flesh is the flesh of donkeys and whose emission is the emission of horses.
And you sought out the licentiousness of your youth, when the Egyptians squeezed your nipples, on account of the breasts of your youth.
Therefore, Oholibah, this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am rousing your lovers against you, the ones you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from all around —

the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the Assyrians with them — desirable young men, governors and officials, all of them, officers and men of renown, all of them riding horses.

And they will come against you with weapons, chariots and wheels, and with a company of peoples. Body shield and shield and helmet they will set against you all around; and I will set judgement before them, and they will judge you by their own judgements.

And I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in rage. Your nose and your ears they will cut off, and what is left of you will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters, and what is left of you will be consumed by fire.
And they will strip you of your clothes and take away your articles of beauty.
And I will put an end to your licentiousness and to your whoring from the land of Egypt; and you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will not remember any more.
For this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am giving you into the hand of those you hate, into the hand of those you turned away from in disgust.
And they will deal with you in hatred and take all your property and leave you naked and bare; and the nakedness of your whorings will be uncovered, and your licentiousness and your whorings.
These things have been done to you because you whored after the nations, because you made yourself unclean with their idols.
In the way of your sister you have walked; and I will put her cup into your hand.
This is what Lord GOD says: You will drink your sister's cup, the deep and the wide one; you will become laughter and mockery — it holds much.
With drunkenness and sorrow you will be filled — the cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
And you will drink it and drain it, and you will gnaw its shards and tear out your own breasts. For I have spoken — declares Lord GOD.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Because you have forgotten me and thrown me behind your back, you too must bear your licentiousness and your whorings.
And the LORD said to me: "Mortal, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations,
for they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. With their idols they have committed adultery, and even their children whom they bore to me they have made pass over to them, as food.
This too they have done to me: they made my sanctuary unclean on that same day, and my sabbaths they profaned.
And when they had slaughtered their children for their idols, they came into my sanctuary on that same day to profane it. And look — this is what they did inside my house.
And more than that: they sent for men coming from far off, to whom a messenger was sent — and look, they came. For them you bathed, painted your eyes and put on ornaments.
And you sat on a glorious couch, with a table laid out before it; and my incense and my oil you set on it.

And the sound of a carefree multitude was in her; and to the men, out of the multitude of humankind, Sabeans were brought from the wilderness. And they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of beauty on their heads.
And I said of the worn-out one, "Adulteries! Now they will whore her whorings, and she with them."
And they went in to her as one goes in to a whore. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the licentious women.
And righteous men — they will judge them with the judgement of adulteresses and the judgement of women who shed blood; for they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
For this is what Lord GOD says: Bring up a company against them and give them over to terror and to spoil.
And the company will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses they will burn with fire.
And I will put an end to licentiousness in the land, and all the women will take warning, and they will not act according to your licentiousness.
And they will requite your licentiousness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols; and you will know that I am Lord GOD."

ezekiel_24.t: And the word of the LORD came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month:
"Mortal, write down for yourself the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon has thrown himself against Jerusalem on this very day.
And speak a parable to the house of rebellion, and say to them: This is what Lord GOD says: Set on the pot, set it on, and pour water into it.
Gather its pieces into it, every good piece — thigh and shoulder; fill it with the choicest bones.
Take the choicest of the flock, and pile the bones under it; make it boil hard; its bones too have been cooked inside it.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Woe, city of blood — a pot whose rust is in it, whose rust has not gone out of it! Piece by piece take it out; no lot has fallen on it.
For her blood is in her midst; she set it on the bare rock. She did not pour it out on the ground, to cover it with dust.
To stir up rage, to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, so that it should not be covered.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Woe, city of blood! I too will make the fire-pile great.
Heap on the wood, kindle the fire, finish off the meat, mix in the seasoning; and let the bones be charred.
And set it empty on its coals, so that it may grow hot and its bronze burn, and its uncleanness be melted inside it and its rust consumed.
It has worn itself out with toil, and its great rust has not gone out of it — its rust, into the fire!
In your uncleanness is licentiousness. Because I cleansed you and you were not clean, you will not be clean from your uncleanness again, until I have given my rage rest upon you.

I, the LORD, have spoken. It is coming, and I will do it. I will not refrain, I will not have compassion, and I will not relent. According to your ways and according to your practices they have judged you — declares Lord GOD."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, look, I am about to take from you the desire of your eyes with a blow; and you shall not lament and shall not weep, and your tears shall not come.
Groan — but in silence. Do not perform mourning for the dead. Bind your turban on your head and put your sandals on your feet; do not cover your upper lip, and do not eat the bread of mourners.
And I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening; and in the morning I did as I had been commanded.
And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things mean for us, that you are doing?"
And I said to them: The word of the LORD came to me:

Say to the house of Israel: This is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am about to profane my sanctuary — the pride of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and what your very self spares. And your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
And you will do as I have done: you will not cover your upper lip and will not eat the bread of mourners;
and your turbans will be on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not lament and will not weep, but you will waste away in your iniquities and groan, each to his brother.
And Ezekiel will be a sign for you: according to all that he has done, you will do. When it comes, you will know that I am Lord GOD."

"And you, mortal — will it not be on the day I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendour, the desire of their eyes and the uplifting of their being — their sons and their daughters —
on that day an escapee will come to you, to bring the news to your ears?
On that day your mouth will be opened with the escapee, and you will speak and will no longer be mute. And you will be a sign for them; and they will know that I am the LORD."

ezekiel_25.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, set your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them,

and say to the Ammonites: Hear the word of Lord GOD. This is what Lord GOD says: Because you said 'Aha!' over my sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile —

therefore look, I am giving you to the people of the east as a possession. They will set up their encampments among you and put their dwellings among you; they will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.
And I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and the Ammonites a resting place for flocks; and you will know that I am the LORD.
For this is what Lord GOD says: Because you clapped your hand and stamped your foot and rejoiced with all the scorn of your being against the land of Israel —

therefore look, I have stretched out my hand against you and will give you as spoil to the nations; I will cut you off from the peoples and destroy you from the lands. I will annihilate you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
This is what Lord GOD says: Because Moab and Seir said, 'Look, the house of Judah is like all the nations' —
therefore look, I am about to lay open the flank of Moab, from the cities — from his cities, from his frontier — the beauty of the land: Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and Kiriathaim,
to the people of the east, along with the Ammonites; and I will give it as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations.
And on Moab I will perform acts of judgement; and they will know that I am the LORD.
This is what Lord GOD says: Because Edom acted by taking vengeance on the house of Judah, and became utterly guilty in avenging themselves on them —

therefore this is what Lord GOD says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and cut off from it humankind and animals, and I will make it a ruin. From Teman, and as far as Dedan, they will fall by the sword.
And I will put my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to my anger and according to my rage; and they will know my vengeance — declares Lord GOD.
This is what Lord GOD says: Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and avenged themselves with scorn in the self, to destroy in perpetual enmity —
therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am stretching out my hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Kerethites and destroy the remnant of the seacoast.
And I will perform great acts of vengeance on them, with rebukes of rage; and they will know that I am the LORD, when I put my vengeance on them."

ezekiel_26.t: In the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, because Tyre said over Jerusalem, 'Aha! The doors of the peoples are broken; trade has turned to me; I shall be filled, now that she is laid waste' —
therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
And they will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers; and I will scrape her soil from her and make her a bare rock.
She will be a place for spreading nets in the middle of the sea, for I have spoken — declares Lord GOD. And she will become spoil for the nations.
And her daughters who are on the mainland will be killed by the sword; and they will know that I am the LORD.

For this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am bringing against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north — king of kings — with horses and chariotry and horsemen, and a company and a numerous people.
Your daughters on the mainland he will kill with the sword; and he will set a siege-wall against you, throw up a ramp against you and raise a body shield against you.
And the blow of his battering-ram he will set against your walls, and your towers he will break down with his weapons.
From the abundance of his horses their dust will cover you; at the sound of horseman and wheel and chariot your walls will shake, when he enters your gates as men enter a city broken into.
With the hooves of his horses he will trample all your streets; your people he will kill with the sword, and the pillars of your strength will come down to the ground.

And they will plunder your wealth and take your merchandise as spoil, tear down your walls and pull down your fine houses; and your stones and your timber and your soil they will put in the middle of the water.
And I will put an end to the noise of your songs, and the sound of your lyres will not be heard again.
And I will make you a bare rock; you will be a place for spreading nets. You will not be built again, for I, the LORD, have spoken — declares Lord GOD.
This is what Lord GOD says to Tyre: Will the islands not quake at the sound of your downfall, when the fatally wounded groan, when slaughter is done in your midst?

And all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones and remove their robes and strip off their embroidered clothes. They will clothe themselves in trembling; they will sit on the ground and tremble every moment and be appalled at you.

And they will take up a lamentation over you and say to you: How you have perished, you who were peopled from the seas, the praised city that was mighty on the sea — she and her inhabitants, who put their terror on all who dwell there!
Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall, and the islands that are in the sea are terrified at your passing.
For this is what Lord GOD says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and the many waters cover you,

then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago, and make you dwell in the world below, among ruins from of old, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; and I will set splendour in the land of the living.
I will make you a horror, and you will be no more; you will be sought and not found again, for ever — declares Lord GOD."

ezekiel_27.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"And you, mortal, take up a lamentation over Tyre,
and say to Tyre, who sits at the entrances of the sea, the trader of the peoples to many islands: This is what Lord GOD says: Tyre, you have said, "I am perfect in beauty."
In the heart of the seas were your borders; your builders perfected your beauty.
Of fir trees from Senir they built all your planking; a cedar from Lebanon they took, to make a mast for you.
Oaks from Bashan they made into your oars; your deck they made of ivory inlaid in pine from the islands of Kittim.
Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt was your sail, to serve as your banner; violet and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.
The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; your own skilled men, Tyre, were in you — they were your sailors.
The elders of Gebal and her skilled men were in you, repairing your leaks. All the ships of the sea and their mariners were in you, to trade your merchandise.
Persia and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war. Shield and helmet they hung in you; they gave you your splendour.
The people of Arvad and Helech were on your walls all around, and the Gammadites were in your towers. Their shields they hung on your walls all around; they perfected your beauty.
Tarshish was your trading partner because of your abundance of every kind of wealth; for silver, iron, tin and lead they exchanged your wares.
Javan, Tubal and Meshech — they were your traders. For human lives and vessels of bronze they exchanged your merchandise.
From Beth-togarmah they exchanged your wares for horses and warhorses and mules.
The people of Dedan were your traders; many islands were the market at your command. Horns of ivory and ebony they brought back to you as payment.
Aram was your trading partner because of your abundance of products. For emeralds, purple and embroidered cloth, and fine linen and corals and ruby, they traded for your wares.
Judah and the land of Israel — they were your traders. For wheat of Minnith and pannag and honey and oil and balm they exchanged your merchandise.
Damascus was your trading partner in the abundance of your products, because of your abundance of every kind of wealth — with the wine of Helbon and white wool.
And Vedan and Javan from Uzal exchanged for your wares: wrought iron, cassia and calamus were among your merchandise.
Dedan was your trader in saddlecloths for riding.
Arabia and all the princes of Kedar — they were the traders at your command, in lambs and rams and goats; in these they were your traders.
The traders of Sheba and Raamah — they were your traders. For the best of every spice and for every precious stone and gold they exchanged your wares.
Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad were your traders.
They were your traders in fine garments, in wrappings of violet and embroidered cloth, in chests of variegated cloth, bound with cords and made firm — in your market.
The ships of Tarshish were the caravans that carried your merchandise; and you were filled and heavily laden in the heart of the seas.
Into many waters your rowers brought you; the east wind broke you in the heart of the seas.

Your wealth and your wares, your merchandise, your mariners and your sailors, those who repaired your leaks and those who traded your merchandise, and all your men of war who were in you, and all your company that was in your midst — they will fall into the heart of the seas on the day of your downfall.
At the sound of the outcry of your sailors the pasturelands will quake.
And all who wield an oar will come down from their ships; the mariners, all the sailors of the sea, will stand on the land.
And they will make their voice heard over you and cry out bitterly; they will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
And they will shave themselves bald for you and gird on sackcloth, and weep for you in bitterness of spirit, with bitter wailing.
And in their wailing they will take up a lamentation over you and lament over you: Who was like Tyre, like one silenced in the middle of the sea?
When your wares went out from the seas you satisfied many peoples; with the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise you made the kings of the earth rich.
Now you are broken, gone from the seas, in the depths of the water; your merchandise and all your company have fallen in your midst.
All the inhabitants of the islands are appalled at you, and their kings shudder with horror; their faces are disturbed.
The traders among the peoples hiss at you; you have become a horror, and you will be no more, for ever."

ezekiel_28.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:

"Mortal, say to the ruler of Tyre: This is what Lord GOD says: Because your heart has been haughty and you have said, 'I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods, in the heart of the seas' — yet you are a human and not a god, and you have made your heart like the heart of a god —
look, you are wiser than Danel; no secret is too dark for you!
By your wisdom and by your understanding you have acquired wealth for yourself, and have acquired gold and silver in your treasuries.
By the greatness of your wisdom, by your trading, you have increased your wealth; and your heart has been haughty in your wealth.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Because you have made your heart like the heart of a god,
therefore look, I am bringing against you strangers, the most ruthless of nations; and they will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and profane your splendour.
They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die the deaths of the slain in the heart of the seas.
Will you really say, 'I am a god,' before the one who kills you? You are a human and not a god, in the hand of those who pierce you.
You will die the deaths of the uncircumcised, by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken — declares Lord GOD."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say to him: This is what Lord GOD says: You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering: ruby, topaz and diamond, beryl, onyx and jasper, sapphire, turquoise and emerald — and gold. The workmanship of your settings and your mountings was in you; on the day you were created they were prepared.
You were an anointed cherub who covers, and I appointed you; you were on the holy mountain of God, you walked about among stones of fire.
You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.
In the abundance of your trading your midst was filled with violence, and you sinned; and I profaned you from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, covering cherub, from among the stones of fire.
Your heart was haughty in your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your splendour. I threw you to the ground; before kings I set you, for them to gaze at you.

From the greatness of your iniquities, by the unrighteousness of your trading, you profaned your sanctuaries. And I brought out fire from your midst; it consumed you, and I made you ashes on the ground before the eyes of all who saw you.
All who knew you among the peoples are appalled at you. You have become a horror, and you will be no more, for ever."
And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,

and say: This is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will gain glory in your midst; and they will know that I am the LORD when I perform acts of judgement on her and show myself holy in her.
And I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the slain will fall in her midst, by the sword against her from all around; and they will know that I am the LORD.
And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a pricking brier or a painful thorn from any around them who despise them; and they will know that I am Lord GOD.

This is what Lord GOD says: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, and show myself holy among them before the eyes of the nations, then they will dwell on their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

And they will dwell on it in safety, and build houses and plant vineyards, and dwell in safety, when I perform acts of judgement on all who despise them from around them; and they will know that I am the LORD their God."

ezekiel_29.t: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
Speak and say: This is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great sea monster lying among his canals, who has said, 'My Nile is my own, and I made it for myself.'
And I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your canals cling to your scales; and I will bring you up out of your canals, with all the fish of your canals clinging to your scales.

And I will abandon you in the wilderness, you and all the fish of your canals. You will fall on the open field; you will not be gathered up and will not be collected. To the beasts of the earth and the birds of the heavens I have given you for food.
And all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, because they were a staff of reed for the house of Israel.
When they grasped you by the hand you splintered, and you tore open every shoulder of theirs; and when they leaned on you, you broke, and you made all their hips give way.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am bringing a sword upon you, and I will cut off from you humankind and animals.
And the land of Egypt will become a desolation and a ruin; and they will know that I am the LORD — because he said, 'The Nile is mine, and I made it.'
Therefore look, I am against you and against your canals, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly desolate ruins, a waste, from Migdol to Syene and as far as the border of Cush.
No human foot will pass through it, and no animal's foot will pass through it; and it will not be inhabited for forty years.

And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated lands, and her cities will be a desolation among laid-waste cities for forty years; and I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
For this is what Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather Egypt from the peoples where they were scattered.
And I will turn back the captivity of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin; and there they will be a lowly kingdom.
It will be the lowliest of the kingdoms and will not exalt itself over the nations again; and I will make them few, so that they will not rule over the nations.
And it will no longer be a confidence for the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to remembrance when they turned after them; and they will know that I am Lord GOD."
In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

"Mortal, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army labour a great labour against Tyre: every head was rubbed bald and every shoulder rubbed bare. But neither he nor his army got wages out of Tyre for the labour he had laboured against it.

Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am giving the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will carry off her wealth, plunder her plunder and take her spoil as spoil; and it will be wages for his army.
As his recompense, for which he laboured, I have given him the land of Egypt, because they acted for me — declares Lord GOD.
On that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and to you I will give an opening of the mouth in their midst; and they will know that I am the LORD."

ezekiel_30.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, prophesy and say: This is what Lord GOD says: Wail — Alas for the day!
For a day is near, and a day for the LORD is near, a day of cloud; it will be the time of the nations.
And a sword will come upon Egypt, and there will be anguish in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt; and they will take away her wealth, and her foundations will be torn down.
Cush and Put and Lud, and all the mixed people, and Kub, and the people of the land of the covenant — with them they will fall by the sword.
This is what the LORD says: The supporters of Egypt will fall, and the pride of her strength will come down. From Migdol to Syene they will fall in her by the sword — declares Lord GOD.
And they will be desolate in the midst of desolated lands, and her cities will be among laid-waste cities.
And they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are broken.
On that day messengers will go out from before me in ships, to make Cush tremble in her security; and there will be anguish among them on the day of Egypt — for look, it is coming.
This is what Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the multitude of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations, will be brought to destroy the land; and they will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
And I will make the canals dry land and sell the land into the hand of the wicked, and I will devastate the land and all that fills it by the hand of strangers. I, the LORD, have spoken.
This is what Lord GOD says: I will destroy idols and put an end to worthless idols from Memphis; there will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
And I will devastate Pathros and set fire to Zoan, and I will perform acts of judgement on Thebes.
And I will pour out my rage on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the multitude of Thebes.
And I will set fire to Egypt. Sin will writhe in anguish; Thebes is about to be broken into; and Memphis — distress in broad daylight.
The young men of On and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and the women will go into captivity.

And in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark, when I break there the yoke-bars of Egypt, and the pride of her strength will cease in her. As for her — a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
And I will perform acts of judgement on Egypt; and they will know that I am the LORD."
In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and look, it has not been bound up to give it healing, no bandage put on to bind it and make it strong enough to wield the sword.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Look, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms — the strong one and the one already broken — and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
And I will make strong the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand; and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan the groans of a fatally wounded man before him.

And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh will fall; and they will know that I am the LORD, when I put my sword in the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands; and they will know that I am the LORD."

ezekiel_31.t: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: Whom are you like in your greatness?
Look, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, beautiful in its branches, a shading thicket, tall of height; and its treetop was among the thick boughs.
Waters made it grow; the deep raised it up, sending its rivers around the place where it was planted, and sending out its channels to all the trees of the field.
Therefore its height was taller than all the trees of the field; its boughs became many and its branches became long, from the abundant waters, as it sent them out.
In its boughs all the birds of the heavens made their nests, and under its branches all the beasts of the field gave birth; and in its shade all the great nations dwelt.
And it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches, for its root was by abundant waters.
Cedars did not eclipse it in the garden of God; fir trees were not like its boughs, and plane trees were not like its branches. No tree in the garden of God was like it in its beauty.
Beautiful I made it, in the abundance of its branches; and all the trees of Eden that were in the garden of God envied it.
Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: Because you were tall in height, and it set its treetop among the thick boughs, and its heart was lifted up in its height,
I gave it into the hand of a leader of nations; he will surely deal with it. According to its wickedness I drove it out.

And strangers cut it down, the most ruthless of nations, and abandoned it. On the mountains and in all the valleys its boughs fell, and its branches were broken in all the ravines of the land; and all the peoples of the earth went down out of its shade and abandoned it.
On its fallen trunk all the birds of the heavens settled, and to its branches came all the beasts of the field —

so that no trees by water may be lifted up in their height or set their treetops among the thick boughs, and that no drinkers of water may stand up to them in their height. For all of them have been given over to death, to the world below, among the children of humankind, with those who go down to the pit.

This is what Lord GOD says: On the day it went down to Sheol I caused mourning; I covered the deep over it and restrained its rivers, and the abundant waters were held back. And I made Lebanon mourn over it, and all the trees of the field wilted over it.

At the sound of its downfall I made nations tremble, when I brought it down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the drinkers of water, were comforted in the world below.
They too went down with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword — and its arm, those who had dwelt in its shade among the nations.

Whom are you like in this, in splendour and in greatness, among the trees of Eden? And you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the world below; among the uncircumcised you will lie, with those slain by the sword. That is Pharaoh and all his multitude — declares Lord GOD."

ezekiel_32.t: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

"Mortal, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him: You likened yourself to a young lion of the nations, but you were like the sea monster in the seas; you burst out in your rivers, made the waters turbid with your feet and fouled their rivers.
This is what Lord GOD says: I will spread my net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will haul you up in my dragnet.
And I will abandon you on the land; on the open field I will fling you, and I will settle on you every bird of the heavens and satisfy the beasts of all the earth from you.
And I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your carcass.
And I will make the land drink your outflow, from your blood, as far as the mountains; and the ravines will be filled from you.
And when I extinguish you I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; the sun I will cover with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will put darkness over your land — declares Lord GOD.
And I will disturb the heart of many peoples when I bring news of your breaking among the nations, to lands you have not known.

And I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror over you when I brandish my sword before their faces; and they will tremble every moment, each for his own life, on the day of your downfall.
For this is what Lord GOD says: The sword of the king of Babylon will come upon you.
By the swords of warriors I will make your multitude fall — all of them the most ruthless of nations. And they will devastate the pride of Egypt, and all her multitude will be destroyed.
And I will destroy all her livestock from beside the abundant waters; and no human foot will muddy them again, nor will the hooves of livestock muddy them.
Then I will let their waters settle and make their rivers run like oil — declares Lord GOD.
When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, and the land is emptied of its fullness, when I strike down all who dwell in it — then they will know that I am the LORD.
It is a lamentation, and they will chant it; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and over all her multitude they will chant it — declares Lord GOD.
In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, wail over the multitude of Egypt, and bring her down — her and the daughters of majestic nations — to the world below, with those who go down to the pit.
Whom do you surpass in loveliness? Go down and be laid with the uncircumcised!
Among those slain by the sword they will fall. The sword has been appointed; drag her down, and all her multitudes.
The leaders of the mighty will speak to him from the midst of Sheol, along with his helpers: They have gone down, they lie still — the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
Assyria is there, and all her company; her graves are around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword —
whose graves are set in the remotest parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword — those who put terror in the land of the living.

Elam is there, and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the world below — those who put their terror in the land of the living. And they have borne their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.

Among the slain they have made a bed for her, with all her multitude; her graves are around her. All of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because their terror was put in the land of the living; and they have borne their disgrace with those who go down to the pit. Among the slain she was put.
Meshech, Tubal and all their multitude are there; their graves are around them. All of them uncircumcised, pierced by the sword, because they put their terror in the land of the living.

And they do not lie with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were laid under their heads and whose shields were on their bones — for the terror of these warriors was in the land of the living.
And you will be broken among the uncircumcised and will lie with those slain by the sword.
Edom is there, her kings and all her princes, who for all their strength were placed with those slain by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the pit.

The princes of the north are there, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who went down with the slain — ashamed, for all the terror their strength inspired; and they lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword, and they have borne their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude — Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword — declares Lord GOD.
For I put my terror in the land of the living; and he will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword — Pharaoh and all his multitude — declares Lord GOD."

ezekiel_33.t: And the word of the LORD came to me:
"Mortal, speak to the children of your people and say to them: When I bring a sword upon a land, and the people of the land take one man from among them and make him their watchman,
and he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the trumpet and warns the people —
then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, and the sword comes and takes him — his blood will be on his own head.
He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take warning; his blood will be upon him. But the one who took warning has delivered his life.

But the watchman, if he sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, and the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes a life from among them — that one is taken in his own iniquity, but his blood I will require from the hand of the watchman.
And you, mortal, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel; you shall hear a word from my mouth and warn them from me.

When I say to the wicked, 'Wicked one, you shall surely die,' and you have not spoken to warn the wicked from his way — that wicked one will die in his iniquity, and I will require his blood from your hand.
But you, if you have warned the wicked from his way, to turn back from it, and he has not turned back from his way — he will die in his iniquity, and you have delivered your life.
"And you, mortal, say to the house of Israel: This is what you have said: 'Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and in them we are wasting away — how then shall we live?'

Say to them: As I live — declares Lord GOD — I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn back from his way and live. Turn back, turn back from your evil ways! Why should you die, house of Israel?

"And you, mortal, say to the children of your people: The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him on the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not stumble by it on the day he turns back from his wickedness; and a righteous one will not be able to live by his righteousness on the day he sins.

When I say to the righteous, 'You shall surely live,' and he relies on his righteousness and does unrighteousness — none of the righteous acts he has done will be remembered, and in the unrighteousness he has done, in that he will die.
And when I say to the wicked, 'You shall surely die,' and he turns back from his sin and does justice and righteousness —
if the wicked returns a pledge, repays what he has robbed, and walks in the statutes of life, doing no unrighteousness — he shall surely live; he will not die.
None of the sins he has sinned will be remembered against him. He has done justice and righteousness; he shall surely live.
And the children of your people say, 'The way of the Lord is not right' — but it is their own way that is not right.
When a righteous one turns back from his righteousness and does unrighteousness, he will die by them.
And when a wicked one turns back from his wickedness and does justice and righteousness, by them he will live.
