I myself know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now you have prostituted yourself, Ephraim, and Israel has made itself unclean.
Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
The pride of Israel testifies against him, and Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity; Judah also has stumbled with them.
With their flocks and their herds they will go to seek the LORD, and they will not find him; he has withdrawn from them.
Against the LORD they have dealt treacherously, for they have borne strange children. Now a new moon will devour them along with their fields.
Blow the horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah! Raise the alarm at Beth-aven — after you, Benjamin!
Ephraim will become a waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I make known what is certain.
The leaders of Judah have become like those who move a boundary marker. On them I will pour out my fury like water.
Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in his right, because he was determined to go after a command.
And I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like rot to the house of Judah.
When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, Ephraim went to Assyria and sent to king Jareb. But he is not able to heal you, or cure your wound.
For I am like a lion to Ephraim, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, I myself will tear and go; I will carry off, and there is no one to deliver.
I will go, I will return to my place, until they acknowledge their guilt and seek my face. In their distress they will seek me earnestly.

hosea_6.t: Come, let us return to the LORD, for he has torn and he will heal us; he has struck and he will bind us up.
He will revive us after two days; on the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live before him.
Let us know, let us pursue the knowledge of the LORD. His going forth is as sure as the dawn; he will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.
What shall I do with you, Ephraim? What shall I do with you, Judah? Your steadfast love is like a morning cloud, like the dew that goes early away.
Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets, I have killed them by the sayings of my mouth; and my judgement on you goes forth like light.
For steadfast love I desire, and not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they dealt treacherously with me.
Gilead is a town of evildoers, tracked with blood.
And like marauders lying in wait for a man, so is a company of priests: they murder on the road to Shechem, for they have committed depravity.
In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: there is Ephraim's prostitution; Israel has made itself unclean.
For you also, Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I turn back the fortunes of my people.

hosea_7.t: When I would heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, and the evils of Samaria, for they practise falsehood: a thief comes in, a marauding band strips outside.
And they do not say in their heart that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds have surrounded them; they are before my face.
With their evil they make the king glad, and with their lies, the princes.
All of them are adulterers, like an oven heated by the baker, who ceases to stir the fire from the kneading of the dough until it is leavened.
On the day of our king the princes made themselves sick with the fever of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
For they bring their heart near like an oven in their ambush. All night their baker sleeps; in the morning it burns like a flaming fire.
All of them grow hot like the oven and devour their rulers. All their kings have fallen; not one of them calls to me.
Ephraim mixes himself among the peoples. Ephraim has become a flat cake not turned over.
Strangers have devoured his strength, and he does not know it; grey hair is sprinkled on him too, and he does not know it.
The pride of Israel testifies against him, yet they have not returned to the LORD their God and have not sought him, for all this.
Ephraim has become like a silly dove, without sense: they have called to Egypt, they have gone to Assyria.
As they go, I will spread my net over them; I will bring them down like a bird of the heavens. I will chastise them according to the report to their assembly.
Woe to them, for they have strayed from me! Devastation to them, for they have rebelled against me! And I would redeem them, but they have spoken lies against me.
They have not cried out to me from their heart, but they wail on their beds; over grain and new wine they assemble themselves; they turn aside against me.
And I disciplined them, I strengthened their arms, and against me they plot evil.
They turn — but not upward. They have become like a slack bow. Their princes will fall by the sword because of the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.

hosea_8.t: Put the horn to your lips! One comes like an eagle over the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant and rebelled against my law.
To me they cry out, "My God, we know you — Israel!"
Israel has rejected good; an enemy will pursue him.
They themselves have made kings, but not from me; they have made princes, and I did not know it. Of their silver and their gold they have made idols for themselves, so that it will be cut off.
He has rejected your calf, Samaria! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
For it is from Israel; a craftsman made it, and it is not God. The calf of Samaria will be broken to pieces.
For they sow wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. It has no standing grain; the shoot will yield no flour; and if it should yield any, strangers would swallow it.
Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a vessel no one wants.
For they have gone up to Assyria — a wild donkey off on its own. Ephraim has hired lovers.
Even though they hire among the nations, now I will gather them; and they have begun to be diminished under the burden of a king of princes.
Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they have become to him altars for sinning.
I wrote for him the multitude of my law; it was regarded as something foreign.
As for the sacrifices of my gifts — they sacrifice flesh and eat it; the LORD is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their iniquity and visit their sins: they will return to Egypt.
Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces, and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send fire on his cities, and it will consume her fortresses.

hosea_9.t: Do not rejoice, Israel, to exultation like the peoples, for you have prostituted yourself away from your God. You have loved a prostitute's fee on every threshing floor of grain.
Threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
They will not remain in the land of the LORD; Ephraim will return to Egypt, and in Assyria they will eat what is unclean.

They will not pour out wine to the LORD, and their sacrifices will not please him. Their bread will be to them like the bread of mourners: all who eat it will make themselves unclean, for their bread is for their own hunger; it will not come into the house of the LORD.
What will you do for the day of the appointed feast, for the day of the festival of the LORD?
For look — they have gone away from devastation; Egypt will gather them, Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess the treasure of their silver; thorns will be in their tents.

The days of punishment have come, the days of recompense have come. Let Israel know it! The prophet is a fool, the man of the spirit is mad — because your iniquity is great, and great is the animosity.
The prophet is Ephraim's watchman with my God; yet a fowler's trap is on all his ways, and animosity is in the house of his God.
They have gone deep in corruption, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity; he will visit their sins.

Like grapes in the wilderness I found Israel; like an early fig on a fig tree in its first season I saw your fathers. But they came to Baal-peor and devoted themselves to the shameful thing, and they became detestable like the thing they loved.
Ephraim — like a bird their glory will fly away: no birth, no womb, no conception.
Even if they bring up their children, I will bereave them of every one. Woe to them also when I turn away from them!
Ephraim, as I have seen it, is planted in a meadow like Tyre; yet Ephraim must bring out his children to the slayer.
Give them, LORD — what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
All their evil is at Gilgal; there I came to hate them. Because of the evil of their deeds I will drive them out of my house. I will not love them again; all their princes are rebels.
Ephraim is struck down; their root is dried up; they will bear no fruit. Even if they give birth, I will put to death the precious fruit of their womb.
My God will reject them, because they have not listened to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.

hosea_10.t: Israel is a luxuriant vine that makes fruit for itself. The more his fruit, the more altars he multiplied; the better his land, the better the pillars they made.
Their heart is divided; now they will bear their guilt. He will break down their altars; he will destroy their pillars.
For now they will say, "We have no king, because we did not fear the LORD — and as for a king, what could he do for us?"
They speak words, swear false oaths, cut covenants; and justice sprouts like a poison-weed on the furrows of a field.

For the calves of Beth-aven the inhabitants of Samaria will be in dread. Its people will mourn over it, and its idol-priests will writhe over it, over its glory, because it has gone into exile from it.
It too will be carried to Assyria as tribute to king Jareb. Ephraim will take shame, and Israel will be ashamed of its own counsel.
Samaria is destroyed; her king is like a twig on the face of the waters.
The high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. Thorn and thistle will come up on their altars. And they will say to the mountains, "Cover us," and to the hills, "Fall on us."
Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, Israel; there they have stood. Will not war overtake them in Gibeah, against the sons of injustice?
At my desire I will discipline them, and peoples will be gathered against them when they are harnessed to their double iniquity.
Ephraim was a trained heifer that loved to thresh, and I myself passed over the goodness of her neck. I will put Ephraim to the yoke; Judah will plough; Jacob will harrow for himself.
Sow for yourselves in righteousness; reap according to steadfast love. Break up for yourselves untilled ground, for it is time to seek the LORD until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
You have ploughed wickedness; you have reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lying, because you trusted in your own way, in the multitude of your warriors.
An uproar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be devastated as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel on the day of battle — mothers dashed to pieces upon their children.
Thus it will be done to you, Bethel, because of your great evil. At dawn the king of Israel will be utterly destroyed.

hosea_11.t: When Israel was a youth, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
They called to them; so they went away from them. They sacrificed to the Baals and made offerings smoke to the carved images.
And I myself taught Ephraim to walk, taking them in my arms; and they did not know that I had healed them.
With human cords I drew them, with ropes of love; and I was to them like those who lift the yoke from their jaws, and I bent down to him and fed him.
He will not return to the land of Egypt, but Assyria will be his king, because they have refused to return.
A sword will whirl in his cities and put an end to his bars and devour them, because of their counsels.
My people are bent on turning away from me; and though they call him upward, not one of them exalts him.

How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I set you like Zeboiim? My heart is overturned within me; my compassions have grown warm together.
I will not carry out the burning of my anger; I will not turn back to destroy Ephraim. For I am God and not a human, the Holy One in your midst; and I will not come in rage.
They will walk after the LORD; he will roar like a lion. When he roars, children will come trembling from the west.
They will come trembling like a bird from Egypt, and like a dove from the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses. Declaration of the LORD.
Ephraim has surrounded me with lying, and the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah still walks with God, and with the Holy One he is faithful.

hosea_12.t: Ephraim feeds on wind and pursues the east wind all day long; he multiplies lying and violence. They cut a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried to Egypt.
The LORD has a case against Judah, to visit judgement on Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.
In the womb he seized his brother's heel, and in his vigour he struggled with God.
He struggled against an angel and prevailed; he wept and sought his favour. At Bethel he found him, and there he spoke with us —
and the LORD, the God of hosts — the LORD is his memorial name.
And you — return to your God! Keep steadfast love and justice, and wait for your God continually.
A merchant! In his hand are scales of deceit; he loves to defraud.
And Ephraim said, "Surely I have grown rich; I have found wealth for myself. In all my gains they will find in me no iniquity that is sin."
And I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt. I will again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
I spoke to the prophets; I myself multiplied visions, and through the prophets I gave likenesses.
If Gilead is iniquity, they have surely become worthless. In Gilgal they have sacrificed bulls; their altars too are like heaps of stones on the furrows of a field.
Jacob fled to the country of Aram; Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept flocks.
And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel up from Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept.
Ephraim has given bitter provocation; so his Lord will leave his bloodshed upon him and return his reproach to him.

hosea_13.t: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty through the Baal, and he died.

And now they go on sinning: they have made for themselves a molten image from their silver, idols of their own devising, all of it the work of craftsmen. Of them they say, "Let the men who sacrifice kiss calves."
Therefore they will be like a morning cloud, like the dew that goes early away, like chaff driven by a storm from a threshing floor, like smoke from a lattice.
And I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt; you shall know no god but me, and there is no saviour besides me.
I knew you in the wilderness, in a land of drought.
When they had their pasture, they were satisfied; they were satisfied and their heart was exalted. Therefore they forgot me.
So I became to them like a lion; like a leopard I will watch beside the road.
I will meet them like a bear robbed of her cubs and tear open the enclosure of their heart. I will devour them there like a lion; the wild animals of the field will rip them open.
It has destroyed you, Israel, that you were against me, against your help.
Where now is your king, that he may save you in all your cities, and your rulers, of whom you said, "Give me a king and princes"?
I gave you a king in my anger, and I take him away in my fury.
The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is stored away.
The pains of a woman in labour will come upon him. He is a son who is not wise: when the time comes he does not present himself at the mouth of the womb.
I will ransom them from the hand of Sheol; I will redeem them from Death. Where are your plagues, Death? Where is your destruction, Sheol? Compassion is hidden from my eyes.

Though he flourishes among his brothers, an east wind will come, the wind of the LORD, coming up from the wilderness; his spring will be dried up and his fountain parched. It will plunder the treasury of every precious thing.
Samaria will bear her guilt, for she has rebelled against her God. By the sword they will fall; their infants will be dashed to pieces, and her pregnant women will be ripped open.

hosea_14.t: Return, Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled in your iniquity.
Take words with you and return to the LORD. Say to him, "Forgive all iniquity and receive what is good, and let us pay the bulls of our lips."
Assyria will not save us; we will not ride on horses, and we will no longer say "Our God" to the work of our hands — for in you the fatherless finds compassion.
I will heal their turning away; I will love them freely, for my anger has turned away from him.
I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and strike his roots like Lebanon.
His young shoots will spread out; his splendour will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
Those who dwell in his shade will return; they will revive the grain and blossom like the vine. His renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.
Ephraim — what have I to do any more with idols? I have answered and I will watch over him. I am like a luxuriant cypress; from me your fruit is found.
Who is wise? Let him understand these things. Who is discerning? Let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are upright, and the righteous walk in them, but transgressors stumble in them.

isaiah_1.t: The vision of Isaiah son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for the LORD has spoken: Children I have brought up and raised high, and they have transgressed against me.
An ox knows its owner, and a donkey its master's trough; Israel does not know, my people does not understand.

Woe — a sinning nation, a people heavy with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who act corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD, they have spurned the Holy One of Israel, they have turned away backward.
Where will you be struck again? You keep on turning away. The whole head is sick, and the whole heart is faint.
From the sole of the foot to the head there is no soundness in it — only bruise and welt and open wound, not pressed out, not bound up, not softened with oil.
Your land is a desolation, your cities are burned with fire; your ground — right in front of you strangers are devouring it, and it is a desolation, like an overthrow by strangers.
And the daughter of Zion is left like a booth in a vineyard, like a shelter in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.
If the LORD of hosts had not left us a few survivors, we would have been like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.
Hear the word of the LORD, rulers of Sodom! Give ear to the law of our God, people of Gomorrah!

'What is the multitude of your sacrifices to me?' says the LORD. 'I have had my fill of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fattened beasts; in the blood of bulls and lambs and he-goats I take no pleasure.
When you come to appear before me, who required this from your hand — this trampling of my courts?
Bring no more worthless offerings; incense is an abomination to me. New moon and sabbath, the calling of an assembly — I cannot endure wrongdoing together with solemn assembly.
Your new moons and your appointed times my whole being hates. They have become a burden to me; I am weary of bearing them.
When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you; even though you multiply prayers, I am not listening. Your hands are full of blood.
Wash, make yourselves clean; remove the evil of your deeds from before my eyes; cease to do evil,
learn to do good; seek justice, set the oppressor right; vindicate the fatherless, take up the widow's case.
'Come now, let us argue the case out together,' says the LORD. 'Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall become white as snow; though they are red like the worm, they shall be like wool.
If you are willing and you obey, you shall eat the good of the land;
but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be eaten by the sword — for the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
How she has become a prostitute, the faithful town! She was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her — and now, murderers.
Your silver has become dross; your drink is diluted with water.
Your officials are stubborn, companions of thieves; every one of them loves a bribe and runs after payments. They do not vindicate the fatherless, and the widow's case never reaches them.
Therefore — declares the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel: 'Ah, I will get relief from my foes and avenge myself on my enemies.
And I will turn my hand against you and refine your dross away as with lye, and remove all your alloy.
And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counsellors as at the beginning. After that you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful Town.
Zion will be ransomed by justice, and those in her who turn back, by righteousness.
But there will be a crushing of transgressors and sinners together, and those who forsake the LORD will come to an end.
For they will be ashamed of the great trees that you desired, and you will be abashed at the gardens that you chose.
For you will be like a terebinth whose leaves are withering, and like a garden that has no water.
And the strong one will become tow, and his work a spark; the two of them will burn together, with no one to put them out.

isaiah_2.t: The word that Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
And it will be, at the end of the days, that the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established at the head of the mountains, and lifted above the hills; and all the nations will stream to it.

And many peoples will come and say: 'Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob, that he may teach us of his ways and we may walk in his paths.' For law goes out from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

And he will judge between the nations and hand down decisions for many peoples; and they will beat their swords into ploughshares and their spears into pruning knives. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, and they will not learn war any more.
House of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the LORD.

For you have abandoned your people, the house of Jacob, because they are full of what comes from the east, and of soothsayers like the Philistines, and they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
His land is filled with silver and gold, and there is no end to his treasures; his land is filled with horses, and there is no end to his chariots.
His land is filled with idols; they bow down to the work of his hands, to what his fingers have made.
And humankind is brought low, and each man is made low; and do not forgive them.
Go into the rock and hide yourself in the dust, from the dread of the LORD and from the magnificence of his majesty.
The haughty eyes of humankind will be brought low, and the pride of men will be humbled; and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
For the LORD of hosts has a day against all that is proud and lofty, and against all that is lifted up — and it will be brought low;
and against all the cedars of Lebanon that are lofty and lifted up, and against all the oaks of Bashan;
and against all the lofty mountains, and against all the hills that are lifted up;
and against every high tower, and against every fortified wall;
and against all the ships of Tarshish, and against all the desirable craft.
And the haughtiness of humankind will be humbled, and the pride of men will be brought low; and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
And the idols will pass away completely.
And people will go into the caves of the rocks and into the holes of the ground, from the dread of the LORD and from the magnificence of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
In that day humankind will throw away its idols of silver and its idols of gold, which they made for themselves to bow down to, throwing them to the burrowing moles and the bats;
to go into the crevices of the rocks and into the clefts of the rocks, from the dread of the LORD and from the magnificence of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
Stop relying on humankind, whose breath is in his nostrils — for of what account is he?

isaiah_3.t: For look — the Lord, the LORD of hosts, is removing from Jerusalem and from Judah support and support, every support of bread and every support of water;
warrior and man of war, judge and prophet, diviner and elder,
commander of fifty and man of rank, counsellor, skilled in magic arts, expert in charms.
And I will make youths their officials, and caprice will rule over them.
And the people will oppress one another, each man against a man, each against his neighbour; the youth will act insolently against the elder, and the lightly esteemed against the honoured.
For a man will seize his brother in his father's house: 'You have a cloak — you be our ruler, and let this heap of ruins be under your hand.'
In that day he will speak up: 'I will not be a binder of wounds; in my house there is no bread and no cloak. Do not appoint me a ruler of the people.'
For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen, because their tongue and their deeds are against the LORD, rebelling against the eyes of his glory.
The look on their faces testifies against them; they declare their sin like Sodom — they do not hide it. Alas for them, for they have dealt out evil to themselves.
Say of the righteous that it will go well, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.
Alas for the wicked — it will go badly, for what his hands have dealt out will be done to him.
My people — its oppressors act like children, and women rule over it. O my people, your guides mislead you, and they have swallowed up the way of your paths.
The LORD is taking his stand to conduct a case, and standing to judge the peoples.
The LORD will come into judgement with the elders of his people and its officials: 'It is you who have consumed the vineyard; the plunder of the poor is in your houses.
What do you mean by crushing my people and grinding the faces of the poor?' The declaration of the Lord GOD of hosts.
And the LORD said: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty and walk with necks stretched out, making eyes as they go, walking and mincing along, and tinkling with their feet —
therefore the Lord will make the scalp of the daughters of Zion scabby, and the LORD will lay their foreheads bare.
In that day the Lord will remove the splendour of the anklets, the headbands and the crescents,
the pendants, the bracelets and the veils,
the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume boxes and the amulets,
the signet rings and the nose rings,
the festal robes, the over-tunics, the cloaks and the purses,
the mirrors, the linen garments, the turbans and the shawls.
And it will be: instead of perfume, rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of set hair, baldness; instead of a rich robe, a girding of sackcloth; a brand instead of beauty.
Your men will fall by the sword, and your might in battle.
And her gates will lament and mourn, and emptied out, she will sit on the ground.

isaiah_4.t: And seven women will take hold of one man in that day, saying: 'We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothing; only let your name be called over us — take away our reproach.'
In that day the Branch of the LORD will be beauty and glory, and the fruit of the land exaltation and splendour, for those of Israel who have escaped.
And it will be that the one who remains in Zion and the one left in Jerusalem will be called holy — everyone recorded for life in Jerusalem;
when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and rinsed away the blood of Jerusalem from its midst by a spirit of judgement and by a spirit of burning.

And the LORD will create over the whole site of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud by day and smoke, and the brightness of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory there will be a canopy.
And there will be a booth for shade by day from the heat, and a refuge and a shelter from the storm and the rain.

isaiah_5.t: Let me sing now for my beloved my love's song about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a fertile hillside.

He dug it and cleared it of stones and planted it with choice vines, and built a tower in the middle of it, and hewed out a winepress in it; and he waited for it to produce grapes, and it produced rotten grapes.
And now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and people of Judah, judge, please, between me and my vineyard.
What more was there to do for my vineyard that I did not do in it? Why, when I waited for it to produce grapes, did it produce rotten grapes?
And now let me tell you what I am about to do to my vineyard: I will remove its hedge, and it will become grazing land; I will break down its wall, and it will become a trampling ground.
And I will make it a waste: it will not be pruned and it will not be hoed, and thorns and briars will come up; and I will command the clouds not to rain rain on it.

For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the people of Judah are the planting of his delight. And he waited for justice — and there was bloodshed; for righteousness — and there was an outcry.
Woe to those who join house to house, who bring field near to field, until there is no room, and you are left to dwell alone in the midst of the land.
In my ears the LORD of hosts has sworn: Many houses will surely become a waste, great and good ones, with no one living in them.
For ten acres of vineyard will produce one bath, and a homer of seed will produce an ephah.
Woe to those who rise early in the morning to pursue strong drink, who linger on into the twilight while wine inflames them.
Lyre and harp, tambourine and flute and wine are their feasts; but the deed of the LORD they do not regard, and the work of his hands they have not seen.
Therefore my people has gone into exile for lack of knowledge; its nobility are men starved with hunger, and its multitude parched with thirst.
Therefore Sheol has enlarged its being and opened its mouth beyond measure; and her magnificence and her multitude and her uproar go down, and whoever exults in her.
And humankind is brought low, and each man is made low, and the eyes of the proud are brought low.
And the LORD of hosts is exalted in judgement, and the holy God shows himself holy in righteousness.
And lambs will graze as in their own pasture, and sojourners will eat among the waste places of the fat ones.
Woe to those who drag iniquity along with cords of falsehood, and sin as with a cart rope;
who say: 'Let him hurry, let him hasten his work, so that we may see it; and let the plan of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, so that we may know it.'
Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and discerning in their own sight.
Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine, and men of valour at mixing strong drink,
who acquit the wicked for a bribe, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him.

Therefore, as a tongue of fire consumes stubble and dry grass sinks down in the flame, their root will be like rottenness and their blossom will go up like dust; because they have rejected the law of the LORD of hosts, and spurned the speech of the Holy One of Israel.

Therefore the anger of the LORD has burned against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against it and struck it, and the mountains quaked, and their corpses were like refuse in the middle of the streets. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
And he will lift up a standard for the nations from afar, and whistle for one from the end of the earth; and there it is — swiftly, quickly, it comes.
None among them is weary, none stumbles; no one slumbers, no one sleeps; the waistcloth of their loins is not loosed, and the thong of their sandals is not torn.
Their arrows are sharpened and all their bows are bent; the hooves of their horses are reckoned like flint, and their wheels like the storm wind.
Their roaring is like a lion's; they roar like young lions, and growl and seize the prey and carry it off, and there is no one to rescue.
And they will growl over it in that day like the growling of the sea; and one looks to the land, and there is darkness and distress; and the light has grown dark in its clouds.

isaiah_6.t: In the year that King Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, and the hem of his robe filled the temple.
Seraphim were standing above him. Each had six wings: with two he covered his face, with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.
And one called to another and said: Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts; the whole earth is full of his glory.
And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of the one calling, and the house was filled with smoke.
And I said: Alas for me, I am destroyed! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips — and my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
And one of the seraphim flew to me, and in his hand was a live coal that he had taken with tongs from the altar.
And he touched it to my mouth and said: Look — this has touched your lips; your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.
And I heard the voice of the Lord saying: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? And I said: Here I am — send me.
And he said: Go, and say to this people: Keep on hearing, but do not understand; keep on seeing, but do not perceive.
Make the heart of this people fat, make its ears heavy, and seal its eyes shut — lest it see with its eyes, and hear with its ears, and its heart understand, and it turn back and be healed.
And I said: How long, Lord? And he said: Until cities lie waste with no inhabitant, and houses with no one in them, and the ground is devastated, a desolation;
and the LORD has sent humankind far away, and the abandoned places are many in the midst of the land.
and though a tenth is still in it, it will again be for burning — like a terebinth or an oak, which when felled still has its stump. A holy seed is its stump.

isaiah_7.t: In the days of Ahaz son of Jotham son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel went up to Jerusalem to make war on it, but they were not able to fight against it.
And it was told to the house of David: Aram has settled on Ephraim. And his heart shook, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest shake before a wind.
And the LORD said to Isaiah: Go out to meet Ahaz, you and Shear-jashub your son, to the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway to the Launderer's Field,

and say to him: Take care and be quiet. Do not be afraid, and do not let your heart be weak, because of these two smoking stubs of firebrands, because of the burning anger of Rezin and Aram and the son of Remaliah.
Because Aram has planned evil against you — Ephraim and the son of Remaliah — saying,
Let us go up against Judah and tear it apart and break it open for ourselves, and let us set up a king in its midst — the son of Tabeel.
Thus says the Lord GOD: It will not stand, and it will not happen.
For the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. And within sixty-five years Ephraim will be shattered and be a people no longer.
And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you will not hold firm, you will not be held firm.
And the LORD spoke to Ahaz again:
Ask a sign for yourself from the LORD your God — make it deep as Sheol, or make it high as the heights.
And Ahaz said: I will not ask, and I will not put the LORD to the test.
And he said: Hear now, house of David! Is it too little for you to weary men, that you weary my God as well?
Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: Look — the virgin will conceive and bear a son, and she will call his name Immanuel.
Curds and honey he will eat, by the time he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
For before the boy knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you dread will be forsaken.
The LORD will bring upon you and upon your people and upon your father's house days such as have not come since the day Ephraim turned aside from Judah — the king of Assyria.
And it will be in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is at the end of the canals of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
And they will all come and settle in the wadis of the cliffs and in the clefts of the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the watering places.
In that day the Lord will shave, with a razor hired from beyond the River — with the king of Assyria — the head and the hair of the legs; and it will sweep away the beard as well.
And it will be in that day that a man will keep alive one heifer and two sheep,
And from the abundance of milk they produce he will eat curds; for curds and honey will be the food of everyone left in the midst of the land.
And it will be in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand pieces of silver will become thorns and briars.
With arrows and a bow one will go there, for the whole land will be thorns and briars.
And all the hills that were hoed with the hoe — you will not go there for fear of thorns and briars; they will become a place for turning out oxen and for the trampling of sheep.

isaiah_8.t: And the LORD said to me: Take a large tablet and write on it with an ordinary stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
And I called reliable witnesses for myself: Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.
And I went in to the prophetess, and she conceived and bore a son. And the LORD said to me: Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
For before the boy knows how to call out 'my father' and 'my mother', the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off before the king of Assyria.
And the LORD spoke to me again:
Because this people has rejected the waters of Shiloah that go gently, and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
therefore, look — the Lord is bringing up over them the waters of the River, mighty and many: the king of Assyria and all his glory. And it will rise over all its channels and go over all its banks.
And it will sweep on into Judah, overflowing and passing over; it will reach up to the neck. And the spreading of its wings will fill the breadth of your land, Immanuel.
Be broken, O peoples, and be shattered! Give ear, all you distant places of the earth! Gird yourselves and be shattered! Gird yourselves and be shattered!
Plan a plan — and it will be frustrated; speak a word — and it will not stand; for God is with us.
For thus the LORD said to me, with the strength of his hand upon me, instructing me not to walk in the way of this people:
Do not call conspiracy everything this people calls conspiracy; do not fear what it fears, and do not hold it in awe.
The LORD of hosts — him you shall regard as holy; he is your fear, and he is the one you hold in awe.
And he will become a sanctuary — and a stone of striking and a rock of stumbling to the two houses of Israel, a trap and a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And many among them will stumble and fall and be broken, and be ensnared and captured.
Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
And I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding his face from the house of Jacob, and I will hope for him.
Look — I and the children the LORD has given me are for signs and portents in Israel, from the LORD of hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion.
And when they say to you, 'Consult the ghosts and the knowing spirits, who chirp and mutter' — should not a people consult its God? On behalf of the living, the dead?
To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, there is no dawn for them.
And he will pass through the land, hard pressed and hungry; and when he is hungry he will be enraged and will curse his king and his God, and turn his face upward.
And he will look to the earth, and there — distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and he is thrust into thick darkness.

isaiah_9.t: But there will be no gloom for her that was in distress. In the former time he treated the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali with contempt, but in the latter he will make it honoured — the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
The people who walk in darkness have seen a great light; on those who dwell in a land of deep darkness light has shone.
You have multiplied the nation; you have made its joy great. They rejoice before you as with the joy of harvest, as people are glad when they divide plunder.
For the yoke of his burden, and the staff on his shoulder, the rod of the one who oppresses him — you have shattered as on the day of Midian.
For every boot that marches with a shaking, and every cloak rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for fire.
For a child has been born to us, a son has been given to us, and the dominion is upon his shoulder; and his name is called Wonderful Counsellor, Mighty God, Father Everlasting, Prince of Peace.

Of the increase of the dominion and of peace there will be no end, upon the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish it and to sustain it in justice and in righteousness, from now and for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will do this.
The Lord has sent a word against Jacob, and it has fallen on Israel.
And all the people will know it — Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria — who say in pride and greatness of heart:
Bricks have fallen, but we will build with hewn stone; sycamores have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.
And the LORD has raised up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and has stirred up his enemies —
Aram from the east and the Philistines from behind, and they have devoured Israel with open mouth. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
And the people has not turned back to the one who struck it, and they have not sought the LORD of hosts.
And the LORD has cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
The elder and the man of rank — he is the head; and the prophet who teaches falsehood — he is the tail.
And the guides of this people have been misleading them, and those they guided have been swallowed up.

Therefore the Lord does not rejoice over its young men, and on its fatherless and its widows he has no compassion; for all of it is godless and doing evil, and every mouth speaks disgraceful folly. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
For wickedness burns like fire; it consumes thorns and briars, and kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they swirl upward in a rising of smoke.
By the wrath of the LORD of hosts the land is scorched, and the people has become like fuel for fire; no one spares his brother.
And one devours on the right and is still hungry, and eats on the left and they are not satisfied; each devours the flesh of his own arm.
Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they are against Judah. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.

isaiah_10.t: Woe to those who decree decrees of wrongdoing, and to the writers who write out trouble,
to turn the weak aside from judgement, and to rob the poor of my people of justice, so that widows become their prey and they may plunder the fatherless.
And what will you do on the day of reckoning, at the devastation that comes from afar? To whom will you flee for help, and where will you leave your wealth?
There is nothing left but to crouch among the prisoners, and among the slain they will fall. In all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still.
Woe, Assyria — the rod of my anger! And the staff in their hand is my indignation.
Against a godless nation I send him, and against the people of my wrath I command him, to plunder plunder and to spoil spoil, and to make it a trampling ground like the mud of the streets.
But he does not intend it so, and his heart does not plan it so; for it is in his heart to destroy and to cut off nations, not a few.
For he says: Are not my commanders all of them kings?
Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?
Just as my hand has reached the kingdoms of the idol — and their images were more than those of Jerusalem and Samaria —
shall I not do to Jerusalem and its figures as I have done to Samaria and its idols?
And when the Lord has finished all his work on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, he will attend to the fruit of the arrogant heart of the king of Assyria, and to the splendour of his haughty eyes.

For he has said: By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of peoples and plundered their stores, and like a mighty one I brought down those who sat enthroned.

And my hand has found the wealth of the peoples as one finds a nest; and as one gathers abandoned eggs, I myself gathered all the earth; and there was none that fluttered a wing or opened a mouth or chirped.

Does the axe glorify itself over the one who hews with it? Does the saw magnify itself over the one who wields it? As if a rod should wield the one who lifts it, as if a staff should lift what is not wood.
Therefore the Lord, the LORD of hosts, will send leanness among his fat ones; and under his glory a burning will burn like the burning of fire.
And the Light of Israel will become a fire, and his Holy One a flame; and it will burn and consume his briars and his thorns in one day.
And the glory of his forest and of his orchard he will bring to an end, from being to flesh; and it will be as when a sick man wastes away.
And the remnant of the trees of his forest will be so few that a boy could write them down.

And it will be in that day that the remnant of Israel and the escaped of the house of Jacob will no longer lean on the one who struck them, but will lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in faithfulness.
A remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the Mighty God.
For though your people Israel were as the sand of the sea, only a remnant of it will return. Annihilation is decreed, overflowing with righteousness.
For a complete destruction, and one decreed, the Lord GOD of hosts is about to make in the midst of all the land.
Therefore thus says the Lord GOD of hosts: Do not be afraid of Assyria, my people who dwell in Zion, who strikes you with the rod and lifts up his staff against you as Egypt did.
For in a very little while indignation will be finished, and my anger will turn to their destruction.
And the LORD of hosts will wield a whip against him, like the striking of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and his staff will be over the sea, and he will lift it up as he did in Egypt.
And it will be in that day that his burden will be removed from your shoulder and his yoke from your neck; and the yoke will be broken because of fatness.
He has come to Aiath, he has passed through Migron; at Michmash he stores his baggage.
They have crossed the pass: 'Geba is our lodging place.' Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul has fled.
Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! Poor Anathoth!
Madmenah has fled; the inhabitants of Gebim have taken refuge.
This very day he will halt at Nob; he shakes his fist at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
Look — the Lord, the LORD of hosts, is lopping off the boughs with a crash; the lofty in height are cut down, and the tall are brought low.
And he will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by a mighty one.

isaiah_11.t: And a shoot will come out from the stock of Jesse, and a branch from his roots will bear fruit.
And the spirit of the LORD will rest upon him: a spirit of wisdom and understanding, a spirit of counsel and might, a spirit of knowledge and the fear of the LORD.
And his delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what his eyes see, nor decide by what his ears hear;

but he will judge the weak with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth; and he will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips he will put the wicked to death.
And righteousness will be the waistcloth of his hips, and trustworthiness the waistcloth of his loins.
And a wolf will live with a lamb, and a leopard will lie down with a kid; and a calf and a young lion and a fatling together, with a small boy leading them.
And a cow and a bear will graze; their young will lie down together; and a lion will eat straw like the ox.
And a nursing child will play over the hole of a cobra, and a weaned child will put his hand over the viper's den.
They will not do harm and they will not destroy in all my holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
And it will be in that day that the root of Jesse, who stands as a standard for the peoples — to him the nations will resort; and his resting place will be glory.

And it will be in that day that the Lord will put out his hand a second time to acquire the remnant of his people that remains from Assyria and from Egypt, from Pathros and from Cush, from Elam and from Shinar and from Hamath and from the coastlands of the sea.
And he will lift up a standard for the nations, and gather the banished of Israel; and the scattered of Judah he will assemble from the four corners of the earth.
And the jealousy of Ephraim will come to an end, and the opponents of Judah will be cut off; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, and Judah will not oppose Ephraim.
And they will swoop on the shoulder of the Philistines to the west; together they will plunder the people of the east. Edom and Moab will be the reach of their hand, and the Ammonites their subjects.

And the LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the sea of Egypt, and will wave his hand over the River with the scorching of his wind; and he will strike it into seven wadis and let people walk across in sandals.
And there will be a highway for the remnant of his people that remains from Assyria, as there was for Israel on the day it came up from the land of Egypt.

isaiah_12.t: And you will say in that day: I will give you thanks, LORD, for you were angry with me; your anger has turned back, and you have comforted me.
Look — God is my deliverance; I will trust and will not dread; for the LORD, the LORD, is my power and my might, and he has become my deliverance.
And you will draw water with rejoicing from the springs of deliverance.
And you will say in that day: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name; make known his deeds among the peoples, proclaim that his name is exalted.
Make music to the LORD, for he has done majestically; let this be made known in all the earth.
Cry aloud and shout, you who dwell in Zion, for great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel.

isaiah_13.t: The oracle concerning Babylon, which Isaiah son of Amoz saw.
On a bare mountain lift up a standard; raise your voice to them, wave a hand, and let them enter the gates of the nobles.
I myself have commanded my consecrated ones; I have also summoned my warriors to serve my anger, my proudly exulting ones.
The sound of a tumult on the mountains, like a numerous people! The sound of an uproar of kingdoms, of nations gathering! The LORD of hosts is mustering an army for battle.
They come from a distant land, from the end of the heavens — the LORD and the weapons of his indignation — to destroy all the earth.
Wail, for the day of the LORD is near; it comes like devastation from the Almighty.
Therefore all hands will go slack, and every human heart will melt.
And they will be terrified; pangs and pains will seize them; they will writhe like a woman in labour. Each will look at his neighbour in astonishment; their faces will be faces of flame.
Look — the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and burning anger, to make the land a waste; and its sinners he will destroy from it.
For the stars of the heavens and their constellations will not flash their light; the sun will be dark at its rising, and the moon will not shed its light.
And I will visit evil upon the world, and their iniquity upon the wicked; I will put an end to the pride of the arrogant, and bring low the haughtiness of the ruthless.
I will make a human being more precious than pure gold, and humankind than the gold of Ophir.
Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will shake from its place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts and in the day of his burning anger.
And it will be like a hunted gazelle, like sheep with no one to gather them: each will turn to his own people, and each will flee to his own land.
Everyone found will be pierced through, and everyone swept up will fall by the sword.
And their children will be dashed in pieces before their eyes; their houses will be plundered and their wives lain with.
Look — I am rousing the Medes against them, who do not value silver and take no delight in gold.
And their bows will dash young men in pieces; they will have no compassion on the fruit of the womb; their eye will not look with pity on children.
And Babylon, the beauty of kingdoms, the splendour of the pride of the Chaldeans, will be like God's overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah.
She will never be inhabited, nor settled from generation to generation; no Arab will pitch a tent there, and shepherds will not make their flocks lie down there.
But desert creatures will lie down there, and their houses will be full of howling things; ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will leap about there.
And hyenas will cry in its citadels, and jackals in the palaces of delight. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

isaiah_14.t: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob and will again choose Israel, and will give them rest on their own ground; and the sojourner will join himself to them, and they will attach themselves to the house of Jacob.

And peoples will take them and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel will take them as an inheritance on the land of the LORD, as male and female servants. They will take their captors captive, and rule over their oppressors.
And on the day the LORD gives you rest from your pain and your turmoil and the hard labour that was forced on you,
you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon and say: How the oppressor has ceased! How the raging has ceased!
The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the rod of rulers,
that struck peoples in wrath with unceasing blows, that ruled nations in anger with a persecution none restrained.
All the earth is at rest and at peace; people have broken out in a shout of joy.
Even the fir trees rejoice over you, the cedars of Lebanon: 'Since you lay down, no woodcutter has come up against us.'
Sheol beneath is stirred for you, to meet you at your coming; it rouses the shades for you, all the leaders of the earth; it has raised from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
All of them will answer and say to you: 'You too have been made weak, like us; you have become like us.'
Your pride has been brought down to Sheol, and the sound of your harps; beneath you maggots are spread as a bed, and worms are your covering.
How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of dawn! You have been cut down to the ground, you who laid the nations low!
And you said in your heart: 'I will ascend to the heavens; above the stars of God I will raise my throne; and I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the remotest parts of the north.
I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.'
Nevertheless, you are brought down to Sheol, to the remotest parts of the pit.
Those who see you will stare at you; they will look you over closely: 'Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who made kingdoms shake,
who made the world like the wilderness and tore down its cities, who would not let his prisoners go home?'
All the kings of the nations, all of them, lie down in glory, each in his own house.
But you have been thrown out from your tomb like an abhorred branch, covered with the slain, those pierced by the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit — like a trampled corpse.
You will not be joined with them in burial, for you have ruined your land, you have slain your people. May the offspring of evildoers never be named.
Prepare a place of slaughter for his sons because of the iniquity of their fathers, lest they rise and take possession of the earth and fill the face of the world with cities.
And I will rise up against them — declares the LORD of hosts — and I will cut off from Babylon name and remnant, offspring and posterity — declares the LORD.
And I will make it a possession of the hedgehog, and pools of water; and I will sweep it away with the broom of destruction — declares the LORD of hosts.
The LORD of hosts has sworn: Surely as I have intended, so it has come to be; and as I have planned, it will stand.
to break Assyria in my land, and on my mountains I will trample him; and his yoke will be removed from them, and his burden from their shoulder.
This is the plan that is planned against all the earth, and this is the hand stretched out over all the nations.
For the LORD of hosts has planned, and who will frustrate it? His hand is stretched out — and who will turn it back?
In the year that King Ahaz died this oracle came.
Do not rejoice, all Philistia, that the rod of the one who struck you is broken; for from the root of a serpent a viper will come out, and its fruit will be a flying serpent.
And the firstborn of the weak will graze, and the needy will lie down in safety; but I will put your root to death with famine, and it will kill your remnant.
Wail, gate! Cry out, city! Melt away, all Philistia! For from the north smoke is coming, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
And what will one answer the messengers of a nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the poor of his people will take refuge.

isaiah_15.t: The oracle concerning Moab. Because in a night Ar of Moab was devastated and destroyed; because in a night Kir of Moab was devastated and destroyed —
The temple and Dibon have gone up to the high places to weep. Over Nebo and over Medeba Moab wails. On all its heads is baldness; every beard is cut off.
In its streets they have girded on sackcloth; on its roofs and in its squares all of it wails, going down in weeping.
And Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; as far as Jahaz their voice is heard. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; its whole being trembles within it.
My heart cries out for Moab; its fugitives are as far as Zoar, Eglath-shelishiyah. For the ascent of Luhith — with weeping they go up it; and on the road to Horonaim they raise a cry of shattering.
For the waters of Nimrim are desolate; the grass has dried up, the vegetation has wasted away, there is no greenery.
Therefore the surplus they have made, and their store, they carry over the Wadi of the Poplars.
For the cry has gone round the territory of Moab; its wailing reaches Eglaim, its wailing Beer-elim.
For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon — a lion for those of Moab who escape, and for the remainder of the ground.

isaiah_16.t: Send a lamb to the ruler of the land, from Sela toward the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
And it will be: like a fluttering bird, a nest driven out, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
'Bring counsel, make a decision; make your shade like night at high noon; hide the outcasts, do not expose the fugitive.
Let my outcasts sojourn among you, Moab; be a shelter for them from the destroyer.' For the oppressor will come to an end, devastation will cease, those who trample will be finished from the land.
And a throne will be established in steadfast love, and one will sit on it in faithfulness, in the tent of David, judging and seeking justice and swift to do righteousness.
We have heard of the pride of Moab — exceedingly proud — its haughtiness and its pride and its fury; its empty boasts are not right.
Therefore Moab will wail for Moab; all of it will wail. For the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth you will groan, utterly stricken.

For the fields of Heshbon have withered, the vine of Sibmah; the rulers of nations have struck down its choice branches, which reached as far as Jazer and wandered into the wilderness; its shoots spread out, they crossed the sea.
Therefore I weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; I drench you with my tears, Heshbon and Elealeh; for over your summer fruit and your harvest the shout has fallen.
And joy and gladness are taken away from the orchard; in the vineyards there is no singing, no shouting; no treader treads out wine in the winepresses. I have made the shout to cease.
Therefore my inward parts moan like a lyre for Moab, and my inner being for Kir-heres.
And when Moab presents itself, when it wearies itself on the high place and comes to its sanctuary to pray, it will not prevail.
This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.

And now the LORD has spoken: Within three years, like the years of a hired labourer, the glory of Moab will be brought into contempt, with all its great multitude; and the remnant will be very few and not mighty.

isaiah_17.t: The oracle concerning Damascus. Look — Damascus is being removed from being a city, and it will be a heap of ruins.
The cities of Aroer are abandoned; they will be for flocks, and they will lie down with no one to terrify them.
And the fortress will cease from Ephraim, and kingship from Damascus and the remnant of Aram; they will be like the glory of the Israelites — declares the LORD of hosts.
And it will be in that day that the glory of Jacob will be brought low, and the fatness of his flesh will be made lean.
And it will be like the gathering of a harvest of standing grain, with the arm reaping the ears; and it will be like one gleaning ears in the Valley of Rephaim.
And gleanings will be left in it, as when an olive tree is beaten: two or three olives at the top of the topmost bough; four or five on its fruiting branches — declares the LORD, the God of Israel.
In that day a person will look to his Maker, and his eyes will see the Holy One of Israel;
and he will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, and what his fingers have made he will not see — the asherahs and the incense altars.
In that day his fortified cities will be like the forsaken places of the wood and the topmost bough, which they abandoned because of the Israelites; and it will be a desolation.
For you have forgotten the God of your deliverance, and the Rock of your refuge you have not remembered. Therefore you plant pleasant plantings and sow them with a stranger's vine-shoot.
On the day of your planting you make it grow, and in the morning you make your seed sprout; but the harvest flees away in a day of sickness and incurable pain.
Woe — the tumult of many peoples! Like the roaring of seas they roar. And the uproar of nations! Like the uproar of mighty waters they are in uproar.
Nations are in uproar like the uproar of many waters — but he rebukes them, and they flee far away, chased like chaff of the mountains before a wind, like whirling dust before a storm.
At evening time — and there is sudden terror! Before morning, it is no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who despoil us.

isaiah_18.t: Woe — land of whirring wings, which is beyond the rivers of Cush,

which sends envoys by the sea, in vessels of papyrus on the face of the waters. Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth-skinned, to a people feared from that place and beyond, a nation of strength upon strength and of trampling, whose land the rivers divide.
All you inhabitants of the world and dwellers on the earth: when a standard is lifted on the mountains, you will see it; and when a ram's horn is sounded, you will hear it.
For thus the LORD said to me: I will be quiet and will look on from my place, like dazzling heat in the sunlight, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
For before the harvest, when the bud is finished and the ripening grape becomes a blossom, he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives and remove the tendrils, cutting them away.

They will be abandoned together to the birds of prey of the mountains and to the animals of the earth; and the birds of prey will pass the summer on them, and every animal of the earth will pass the winter on them.

At that time a gift will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people feared from that place and beyond, a nation of strength upon strength and of trampling, whose land the rivers divide — to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, Mount Zion.

isaiah_19.t: The oracle concerning Egypt. Look — the LORD is riding on a swift cloud and coming to Egypt; and the idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the heart of Egypt melts within it.
And I will provoke Egypt against Egypt, and they will fight, each against his brother and each against his neighbour, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.
And the spirit of Egypt will be emptied out within it, and its plan I will confuse; and they will consult the idols and the mutterers, the ghosts and the knowing spirits.
And I will hand Egypt over into the hand of a cruel master, and a strong king will rule over them — declares the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
And the waters will be dried up from the sea, and the river will run dry and be dry.
And the rivers will stink; the canals of Egypt will run low and dry up; reed and rush will wither.
The bare places by the Nile, at the mouth of the Nile, and all that is sown by the Nile, will dry up, be driven away, and be no more.
And the fishermen will lament, and all who cast a hook in the Nile will mourn; and those who spread a net on the face of the waters will languish.
And those who work combed flax will be ashamed, and the weavers of white cloth.
And her foundations will be crushed; all who work for wages will be grieved in their being.
The officials of Zoan are nothing but fools; the wise counsellors of Pharaoh — their counsel is stupid. How can you say to Pharaoh, 'I am a son of the wise, a son of ancient kings'?
Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts has planned against Egypt.
The officials of Zoan have become fools; the officials of Memphis are deceived; they have led Egypt astray, the cornerstone of its tribes.
The LORD has mixed within her a spirit of confusion, and they have made Egypt stagger in all its work, as a drunkard staggers in his vomit.
And there will be no work for Egypt that head or tail, palm branch or reed can do.
In that day Egypt will be like women, and will tremble and be in dread before the brandishing of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he is brandishing over it.
And the land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt; everyone to whom it is mentioned will be in dread, because of the plan of the LORD of hosts, which he is planning against it.
In that day there will be five cities in the land of Egypt speaking the language of Canaan and swearing allegiance to the LORD of hosts. One of them will be called the City of Destruction.
In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD beside its border.

And it will be a sign and a witness to the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they will cry out to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a deliverer and a defender, and he will rescue them.
And the LORD will make himself known to Egypt, and Egypt will know the LORD in that day; and they will serve with sacrifice and offering, and they will vow a vow to the LORD and pay it.
And the LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing; and they will turn back to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them and will heal them.
In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria; Assyria will come into Egypt and Egypt into Assyria, and Egypt will serve with Assyria.
In that day Israel will be a third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,
which the LORD of hosts will bless, saying: Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.

isaiah_20.t: In the year the commander-in-chief came to Ashdod, when Sargon king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and captured it —
at that time the LORD spoke by the hand of Isaiah son of Amoz: Go and loosen the sackcloth from your hips, and take your sandals off your feet. And he did so, going naked and barefoot.
And the LORD said: Just as my servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years, a sign and a portent against Egypt and against Cush,
so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old, naked and barefoot, with buttocks uncovered — the nakedness of Egypt.
And they will be dismayed and ashamed of Cush their hope and of Egypt their splendour.
And the inhabitants of this coastland will say in that day: Look at our hope — the place we fled to for help, to be rescued from the king of Assyria! And how shall we ourselves escape?

isaiah_21.t: The oracle concerning the wilderness of the sea. Like storms sweeping through the Negeb, it comes from the wilderness, from a land to be feared.
A severe vision has been told to me: the traitor betrays, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam! Lay siege, Media! I have put an end to all her groaning.
Therefore my loins are filled with anguish; pangs have seized me like the pangs of a woman in labour. I am too bent over to hear; I am too terrified to see.
My heart reels; shuddering has overwhelmed me. The twilight I longed for he has turned into trembling for me.
They arrange the table, they spread the rug — eating, drinking. Get up, officials! Oil the shield!
For thus the Lord said to me: Go, station the watchman; let him tell what he sees.
And he will see riders, a pair of horsemen, riders on donkeys, riders on camels; and he will listen closely, with great attentiveness.
And the lookout called out: On a watchtower, Lord, I stand continually by day, and at my post I am stationed all through the nights.
And look — this is coming: riders, a man, a pair of horsemen! And he answered and said: Fallen, fallen is Babylon, and all the images of her gods are shattered to the ground.
My threshed one, son of my threshing floor: what I have heard from the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, I have told you.
The oracle concerning Dumah. Someone is calling to me from Seir: Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
The watchman says: Morning comes, and also night. If you would enquire, enquire; come back again.
The oracle concerning Arabia. In the thickets in Arabia you will spend the night, caravans of Dedanites.
Bring water to meet the thirsty! Inhabitants of the land of Tema, meet the fugitive with bread.
For they have fled from swords, from a drawn sword, from a bent bow, and from the weight of battle.
For thus the Lord said to me: Within a year, like the years of a hired labourer, all the glory of Kedar will be finished.
And the remnant of the number of the bowmen, the warriors of the sons of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.

isaiah_22.t: The oracle concerning the Valley of Vision. What is the matter with you, then, that all of you have gone up to the roofs?
You that are full of noise, turbulent city, jubilant town! Your slain are not slain by the sword and are not dead in battle.
All your rulers have fled together; they were captured without a bow. All of you who were found were captured together; they had fled from far off.
Therefore I said: Look away from me; let me weep bitterly. Do not insist on comforting me over the devastation of the daughter of my people.
For the Lord GOD of hosts has a day of consternation and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision — a breaking down of walls, and a crying out to the mountain.
And Elam took up the quiver, with chariotry and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
And your choicest valleys were full of chariotry, and the horsemen took a firm stand at the gate.
And he stripped away the covering of Judah. And in that day you looked to the weaponry of the House of the Forest,
and you saw that the breaches in the City of David were many; and you gathered the waters of the lower pool.
And you counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you pulled the houses down to fortify the city wall.
And you made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool; but you did not look to the one who made it, and the one who formed it long ago you did not consider.
And in that day the Lord GOD of hosts called for weeping and for wailing, for baldness and for girding on sackcloth;
and instead — rejoicing and joy, killing cattle and slaughtering sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: 'Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!'
And the LORD of hosts revealed himself in my ears: Surely this iniquity will not be atoned for you until you die, says the Lord GOD of hosts.
Thus says the Lord GOD of hosts: Go, come to this steward, to Shebna who is over the house,
What have you here, and whom have you here, that you have dug out a tomb for yourself here — you who dig your tomb on a height, cutting a dwelling for yourself in the rock?
Look — the LORD is about to hurl you away with a hurling, O man, and to grasp you firmly.
He will wind you round and round like a ball, into a land broad on both hands. There you will die, and there the chariots of your splendour will be the disgrace of your master's house.
And I will push you from your office, and from your post he will tear you down.
And it will be in that day that I will summon my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah,
and I will clothe him with your tunic and fasten your sash on him, and I will put your authority into his hand; and he will become a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
And I will put the key of the house of David on his shoulder; he will open, and no one will shut; he will shut, and no one will open.
And I will drive him in like a tent peg in a firm place; and he will become a seat of honour for his father's house.
And they will hang on him all the honour of his father's house — the descendants and the offshoots, all the small vessels, from the bowls to all the jars.
In that day — declares the LORD of hosts — the tent peg driven in a firm place will be removed; it will be cut down and fall, and the burden that was on it will be cut off; for the LORD has spoken.

isaiah_23.t: The oracle concerning Tyre. Wail, ships of Tarshish, for it is devastated — no house, no way in! From the land of Cyprus it was revealed to them.
Be silent, inhabitants of the coastland! The traders of Sidon, crossing the sea, have filled you.
And on many waters the grain of Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; and she became the traffic of the nations.
Be ashamed, Sidon, for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying: I have not been in labour and I have not given birth; I have not brought up young men or raised virgins.
When the report reaches Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
Cross over to Tarshish! Wail, inhabitants of the coastland!
Is this your jubilant city, whose beginning is from days of antiquity, whose feet carried her far off to settle?
Who has planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders were princes, whose merchants were the honoured of the earth?
The LORD of hosts has planned it, to profane the pride of all beauty, to bring into contempt all the honoured of the earth.
Cross over your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint any more.
He has stretched out his hand over the sea; he has made kingdoms tremble. The LORD has commanded concerning Canaan to destroy her strongholds.
And he said: You will not exult again, oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Get up, cross over to Cyprus; even there you will have no rest.
Look — the land of the Chaldeans: this is the people that was not; Assyria allotted it to desert creatures. They raised up their siege towers, they stripped bare her palaces, they made her a ruin.
Wail, ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is devastated.
And it will be in that day that Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, like the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:
Take a lyre, go about the city, forgotten prostitute! Play well, sing many songs, so that you may be remembered.
And at the end of seventy years the LORD will visit Tyre, and she will return to her hire and will prostitute herself with all the kingdoms of the earth on the face of the ground.

And her profit and her hire will be holy to the LORD. It will not be stored up and it will not be hoarded; for her profit will belong to those who dwell before the LORD, to eat their fill and for fine clothing.

isaiah_24.t: Look — the LORD is laying the earth waste and devastating it; he will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants.

And it will be: as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maidservant, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the creditor, so with the one who owes him.
The earth will be utterly laid waste; it will be utterly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
The earth dries up and withers; the world languishes and withers; the exalted of the people of the earth languish.
And the earth has been polluted under its inhabitants, for they have transgressed laws, overstepped the statute, broken the everlasting covenant.
Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and those who dwell in it are held guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth have dwindled, and few humans are left.
The new wine dries up, the vine languishes; all the joyful of heart groan.
The gaiety of tambourines has ceased; the uproar of the jubilant has stopped; the gaiety of the lyre has ceased.
They will not drink wine with song; strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
The town of emptiness is broken; every house is shut, with no way in.
There is an outcry over wine in the streets; all joy has darkened to evening; the gaiety of the earth has departed.
Desolation is left in the city, and the gate is battered to ruin.
For so it will be in the midst of the earth, among the peoples: like the beating of an olive tree, like gleanings when the grape harvest is over.
They lift up their voice, they shout for joy; over the majesty of the LORD they cry aloud from the west.
Therefore in the east give glory to the LORD, in the coastlands of the sea the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
