An appalling thing, a horror, has happened in the land:
The prophets prophesy falsehood, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love it so. And what will you do at the end of it?

jeremiah_6.t: Take refuge, people of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem! Blow the ram's horn in Tekoa; raise a signal over Beth-hakkerem! For disaster looks down from the north, and a great shattering.
The comely one, the delicate one — I destroy the daughter of Zion.
Shepherds will come to her with their flocks; they will pitch their tents against her all around; each will graze his own portion.
Consecrate war against her! Arise, and let us go up at noon! Woe to us, for the day has turned, for the shadows of evening are stretching out.
Arise, and let us go up by night, and destroy her fortresses!
For this is what the LORD of hosts says: Cut down timber and throw up a siege mound against Jerusalem. She is the city that must be called to account; all of her is oppression within her.
As a well keeps its waters fresh, so she keeps her evil fresh. Violence and havoc are heard in her; before my face continually are sickness and wounds.
Take correction, Jerusalem, or I will be torn away from you, or I will make you a desolation, a land not inhabited.
This is what the LORD of hosts says: They will glean the remnant of Israel thoroughly, like a vine. Pass your hand back over it again like a grape gatherer over the branches.

To whom shall I speak and give warning, so that they will hear? See, their ear is uncircumcised; they are not able to pay attention. See, the word of the LORD has become a reproach to them; they take no delight in it.

And I am full of the wrath of the LORD; I am weary of holding it in. Pour it out on the child in the street and on the gathering of young men together; for even husband with wife will be taken, the old with the one full of days.
Their houses will be turned over to others, fields and wives together; for I will stretch out my hand against the inhabitants of the land, declares the LORD.
For from the least of them to the greatest, all of them are out for unjust gain; and from prophet to priest, all of them practise falsehood.
They have healed the shattering of my people lightly, saying, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

Were they ashamed when they committed an abomination? They were not ashamed at all; they did not even know how to feel disgrace. Therefore they will fall among the fallen; at the time I call them to account they will stumble, says the LORD.
This is what the LORD says: Stand at the roads and look, and ask for the ancient paths — where the good way is — and walk in it, and find rest for yourselves. But they said, "We will not walk in it."
I raised up watchmen over you: "Pay attention to the sound of the ram's horn!" But they said, "We will not pay attention."
Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what will happen to them.
Hear, earth! I am about to bring disaster on this people, the fruit of their own schemes; for they have not paid attention to my words, and as for my law, they have rejected it.
What is this to me — frankincense that comes from Sheba, and the good cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices do not please me.
Therefore this is what the LORD says: I am about to put stumbling blocks before this people, and they will stumble over them — fathers and sons together, neighbour and friend — and they will perish.
This is what the LORD says: See, a people is coming from the land of the north, and a great nation is being roused from the remotest parts of the earth.
They take hold of bow and javelin; cruel they are, and they show no mercy. Their sound roars like the sea; they ride on horses, drawn up as one man for battle against you, daughter of Zion.
We have heard the report of it; our hands hang limp. Distress has seized us, anguish like a woman in labour.
Do not go out into the field, and do not walk on the road; for the enemy has a sword — terror all around.
Daughter of my people, put on sackcloth and roll in ashes. Make for yourself the mourning of an only child, a bitter wailing; for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
I have made you an assayer among my people, a fortification, so that you may know and test their way.
All of them are stubborn rebels, going about slandering. They are bronze and iron; all of them are destroyers.
The bellows puff; the lead is consumed by the fire. In vain the refiner has refined: the evil ones have not been separated out.
"Rejected silver" they are called, for the LORD has rejected them.

jeremiah_7.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim there this word, and say: Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah, you who come in at these gates to bow down to the LORD.
This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Make your ways and your deeds good, and I will let you dwell in this place.
Do not trust in the words of falsehood, saying: "The temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD are these!"
For if you thoroughly make your ways and your deeds good, if you truly do justice between one person and another,
if you do not oppress the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after other gods to your own harm,
then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your ancestors, from of old and for ever.
See, you are trusting in the words of falsehood, which are of no profit.
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn offerings as smoke to Baal, and walk after other gods you have not known,
and then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, "We are delivered!" — so that you can go on doing all these abominations?
Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? I too have seen it, declares the LORD.
Go now to my place that was in Shiloh, where I first caused my name to dwell, and see what I did to it because of the evil of my people Israel.
And now, because you have done all these deeds, declares the LORD — and I spoke to you, rising early and speaking, but you did not listen, and I called you, but you did not answer —
therefore I will do to the house that is called by my name, in which you are trusting, and to the place I gave to you and to your ancestors, just as I did to Shiloh.
And I will cast you out from before my face, just as I cast out all your brothers, all the offspring of Ephraim.
And you — do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry of entreaty or a prayer for them, and do not press me, for I will not hear you.
Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

The children gather wood, the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes for the queen of the heavens; and they pour out drink offerings to other gods, so as to provoke me to anger.
Is it me they are provoking? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves, to the shame of their own faces?

Therefore this is what Lord GOD says: My anger and my wrath are about to be poured out on this place — on humankind and on the animals, on the trees of the field and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and not be quenched.
This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat the meat.
For I did not speak with your ancestors, and I did not command them, on the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offering and sacrifice.
But this is what I commanded them: Listen to my voice, and I will be God to you and you will be a people to me; and walk in all the way that I command you, so that it may go well for you.
But they did not listen and did not incline their ear; they walked in their own counsels, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and they went backward and not forward.
From the day your ancestors came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I sent to you all my servants the prophets, day after day, rising early and sending them;
But they did not listen to me and did not incline their ear; they stiffened their neck. They did worse evil than their ancestors.
You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; you shall call to them, but they will not answer you.
And you shall say to them: This is the nation that did not listen to the voice of the LORD its God and did not accept correction. Faithfulness has perished; it has been cut off from their mouth.
Cut off your consecrated hair and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for the LORD has rejected and abandoned the generation of his fury.
For the people of Judah have done what is evil in my eyes, declares the LORD. They have set their detestable things in the house that is called by my name, to make it unclean.

And they have built the high places of the Topheth that is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire — which I did not command, and which never came into my mind.

Therefore, days are coming, declares the LORD, when it will no longer be called "the Topheth" or "the Valley of Ben-hinnom," but "the Valley of Slaughter"; and they will bury in Topheth for lack of room.
And the corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the heavens and the animals of the earth, with no one to frighten them away.

And I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the sound of the bridegroom and the sound of the bride; for the land will become a desolation.

jeremiah_8.t: At that time, declares the LORD, they will bring out from their graves the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

And they will spread them out to the sun and the moon and all the host of the heavens, which they loved and served and walked after and consulted and bowed down to. They will not be gathered and they will not be buried; they will be dung on the face of the ground.
And death will be chosen rather than life by all the remnant that remains of this evil clan, in all the places that remain, where I have banished them, declares the LORD of hosts.
And you shall say to them: This is what the LORD says: Do people fall and not get up? Does anyone turn away and not turn back?
Why has this people, Jerusalem, turned away with a lasting turning away? They have kept hold of deceit; they have refused to turn back.

I have paid attention and listened: they do not speak rightly. There is no one who relents over his evil, saying, "What have I done?" Every one of them turns to his own course, like a horse rushing into battle.
Even the stork in the heavens knows her appointed times, and the turtle-dove, the swift and the crane keep the time of their coming; but my people do not know the ordinance of the LORD.
How can you say, "We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us"? Truly, it has been turned into falsehood by the false stylus of the scribes.
The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and captured. See, they have rejected the word of the LORD — so what wisdom is theirs?

Therefore I will give their wives to others, their fields to those who dispossess them; for from the small to the great, all of them are out for unjust gain; from prophet to priest, all of them practise falsehood.
They have healed the shattering of the daughter of my people lightly, saying, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

Were they ashamed when they committed an abomination? They were not ashamed at all; they did not know how to be shamed. Therefore they will fall among the fallen; at the time of their punishment they will stumble, says the LORD.
I will utterly make an end of them, declares the LORD. There are no grapes on the vine and no figs on the fig tree; the leaf has withered, and what I gave them passes away from them.

Why are we sitting still? Gather together, and let us go into the fortified cities and perish there; for the LORD our God has silenced us and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
We waited for peace, but there was no good; for a time of healing, and instead — terror.
From Dan is heard the snorting of his horses; at the sound of the neighing of his stallions all the land quakes. They come and devour the land and everything in it, the city and those who live in it.
For I am about to send among you serpents, vipers for which there is no charm, and they will bite you, declares the LORD.
My cheer is gone over sorrow; my heart within me is faint.

Listen — the sound of the cry of the daughter of my people from a distant land: "Is the LORD not in Zion? Is her king not in her?" Why have they provoked me to anger with their carved images, with foreign worthlessness?
The harvest has passed, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
For the shattering of the daughter of my people I am shattered; I am in mourning; desolation has taken hold of me.
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has no new flesh come up over the daughter of my people?

jeremiah_9.t: Oh that my head were water and my eye a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
Oh that I had in the wilderness a travellers' lodging place, that I might leave my people and go away from them! For all of them are adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
They bend their tongue, their bow of falsehood; it is not for faithfulness that they are strong in the land. For they go out from evil to evil, and they do not know me, declares the LORD.
Each of you, be on guard against your neighbour; do not rely on any brother. For every brother utterly supplants, and every neighbour goes about slandering.
Each one deceives his neighbour, and faithfulness they do not speak. They have taught their tongue to speak falsehood; they wear themselves out acting perversely.
Your dwelling is in the midst of deceit; in their deceit they have refused to know me, declares the LORD.
Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says: I am about to refine them and test them; for how else shall I act, because of the daughter of my people?
Their tongue is a sharpened arrow; it speaks deceit. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbour, but within him he sets his ambush.
Shall I not call them to account for these things, declares the LORD; and on a nation such as this shall I not avenge myself?

Over the mountains I will take up weeping and wailing, and over the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation; for they are burned up, with no one passing through, and the sound of livestock is not heard. From the birds of the heavens to the animals, they have fled, they are gone.
I will make Jerusalem heaps of stones, a lair of jackals; and the cities of Judah I will make a waste, with no inhabitant.

Who is the wise man who can understand this, and to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it — why the land has perished, is burned up like the wilderness, with no one passing through?
And the LORD said: Because they have forsaken my law that I set before them, and have not listened to my voice and have not walked in it,
but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baals, which their ancestors taught them —
therefore this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am about to feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
And I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known, and I will send the sword after them until I have made an end of them.
This is what the LORD of hosts says: Consider, and summon the wailing women, and let them come; send for the skilled women, and let them come.
Let them hurry and take up a wailing over us, so that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids flow with water.
For a sound of wailing is heard from Zion: "How we are devastated! We are utterly put to shame, for we have left the land, for they have cast down our dwellings."
Hear the word of the LORD, you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters a wailing, and each woman her neighbour a lamentation.
For death has come up into our windows; it has entered our fortresses, to cut off the children from the street, the young men from the open squares.
Speak: This is what the LORD declares — The corpses of humankind will fall like dung on the face of the field, and like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather it.
This is what the LORD says: Let not the wise boast in his wisdom, and let not the mighty boast in his might; let not the rich boast in his riches.

But let the one who boasts boast in this: that he has insight and knows me, that I am the LORD, who does steadfast love, justice and righteousness in the earth; for in these I delight, declares the LORD.
Days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will call to account everyone who is circumcised in the foreskin:

against Egypt and Judah and Edom and the Ammonites and Moab, and against all who have their temples clipped, who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised of heart.

jeremiah_10.t: Hear the word that the LORD has spoken to you, house of Israel.
This is what the LORD says: Do not learn the way of the nations, and do not be dismayed at the signs of the heavens, though the nations are dismayed at them.
For the customs of the peoples are worthlessness: it is a tree from the forest that someone cut down, the work of a craftsman's hands with a tool.
With silver and gold he beautifies it; with nails and hammers they fasten them, so that it will not totter.
They are like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, and they do not speak; they have to be carried, for they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them, for they do no harm — and neither is doing good in them.
There is none like you, LORD. You are great, and your name is great in strength.
Who would not fear you, King of the nations? For it is your due; for among all the wise of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is none like you.
All together they are stupid and foolish: the instruction of worthless things — it is wood.
Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz — the work of a craftsman and of a metalsmith's hands. Violet and purple are their clothing; they are all the work of skilled men.
But the LORD is a God of faithfulness; he is the living God and the everlasting King. At his rage the earth quakes, and the nations cannot endure his indignation.
This is what you shall say to them: The gods that did not make the heavens and the earth shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens.
He made the earth by his power, established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the heavens.
At the sound of his voice there is a tumult of waters in the heavens; he makes clouds rise from the end of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
Every human being is stupid, without knowledge; every metalsmith is put to shame by his idol, for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
They are worthlessness, a work of mockery; at the time of their punishment they will perish.
The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the one who formed all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. The LORD of hosts is his name.
Gather up your bundle from the ground, you who live under siege.
For this is what the LORD says: I am about to sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and I will bring distress on them, so that they may feel it.
Woe to me for my shattering! My wound is severe. But I said: This is only a sickness, and I will bear it.
My tent is devastated, and all my tent cords are snapped. My children have gone out from me, and they are no more. There is no one to pitch my tent again or to raise up my curtains.
For the shepherds have behaved stupidly, and they have not sought the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
The sound of a report! It is coming — a great din from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a lair of jackals.
I know, LORD, that a person's way is not his own, that it is not for the one who walks to direct his step.
Correct me, LORD, but only in justice — not in your anger, or you will make me few.

Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not know you, and on the clans that have not called on your name; for they have devoured Jacob — they have devoured him and made an end of him, and they have devastated his habitation.

jeremiah_11.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
Hear the words of this covenant, and speak them to the people of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And you shall say to them: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the one who does not hear the words of this covenant,

which I commanded your ancestors on the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying: Listen to my voice and do them, according to all that I command you; and you shall be a people to me, and I will be God to you —
so as to carry out the oath I swore to your ancestors, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. And I answered and said: Amen, LORD.
And the LORD said to me: Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
For I solemnly warned your ancestors on the day I brought them up from the land of Egypt, and until this day, rising early and warning them: Listen to my voice.

But they did not listen and did not incline their ear; each walked in the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do and they did not do.
And the LORD said to me: A conspiracy has been found among the people of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

They have turned back to the iniquities of their forebears, who refused to hear my words; and they themselves have walked after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I cut with their ancestors.
Therefore this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring on them a disaster they cannot escape; and they will cry out to me, and I will not listen to them.
And the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn offerings as smoke, but those will certainly not deliver them at the time of their calamity.
For your gods are as many as your cities, Judah; and as many as the streets of Jerusalem are the altars you have set up to the Shame, altars for burning offerings as smoke to Baal.
And you — do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry of entreaty or a prayer for them; for I will not be listening at the time they call to me about their calamity.
What has my beloved to do in my house, doing her schemes with the many? And will holy flesh pass away from you? For when your evil comes — then you exult.
"A luxuriant olive tree, beautiful in shapely fruit" — by that name the LORD called you. At the sound of a great roar he has kindled fire against it, and its branches are broken.

And the LORD of hosts, who planted you, has spoken disaster against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves, provoking me to anger by burning offerings as smoke to Baal.
The LORD made it known to me, and I knew; then you showed me their deeds.

And I was like a docile lamb led to the slaughter; I did not know that they had planned plans against me: "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, and his name will be remembered no more."
But LORD of hosts, who judges righteously, who tests the kidneys and the heart — let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my case.
Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the men of Anathoth, who are seeking your life, saying: "You shall not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand" —
therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says: I am about to call them to account. The young men will die by the sword; their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
And there will be no remnant left of them, for I will bring disaster on the men of Anathoth — the year of their punishment.

jeremiah_12.t: You are righteous, LORD, when I bring a case to you; yet I will speak judgements with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are all who deal treachery at ease?
You planted them, and they have taken root; they go on, and they have produced fruit. You are near in their mouth and far from their kidneys.
But you, LORD, know me; you see me, and you have tested my heart toward you. Drag them away like sheep for slaughter, and set them apart for a day of killing.
How long will the land mourn and the vegetation of every field wither, because of the evil of those who dwell in it? Beasts and birds have been swept away, for they said, "He will not see our end."
If you have run with foot soldiers and they have wearied you, how will you compete with horses? And if in a land of peace you feel secure, how will you do in the thicket of the Jordan?

For even your brothers and the house of your father — even they have dealt treacherously with you; even they have cried out after you at full voice. Do not trust them, though they speak fair words to you.
I have forsaken my house, I have abandoned my inheritance; I have given the beloved of my heart into the hand of her enemies.
My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest; she has raised her voice against me; therefore I hate her.
Is my inheritance a hyena to me, with birds of prey all around against her? Go, gather all the animals of the field; bring them to eat.
Many shepherds have ruined my vineyard; they have trampled my portion; they have made the portion of my delight a desolate wilderness.
He has made it a desolation; desolate, it mourns before me. The whole land is made desolate, because there is no one who takes it to heart.
Over all the bare heights in the wilderness destroyers have come; for a sword of the LORD is devouring from one end of the land to the other. There is no peace for any flesh.
They have sown wheat and reaped thorns; they have worn themselves out and have not profited. Be ashamed of your harvests, because of the burning of the LORD's anger.

This is what the LORD says concerning all my evil neighbours who touch the inheritance I gave my people Israel to inherit: I am about to uproot them from their own soil, and the house of Judah I will uproot from among them.
And after I have uprooted them, I will turn back and have compassion on them, and I will bring them back, each to his own inheritance and each to his own land.
And if they will indeed learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, "As the LORD lives," just as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the midst of my people.
But if they will not listen, then I will utterly uproot that nation and destroy it, declares the LORD.

jeremiah_13.t: This is what the LORD said to me: Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth and put it on your loins, but do not bring it into water.
So I bought the loincloth according to the word of the LORD, and I put it on my loins.
And the word of the LORD came to me a second time:
Take the loincloth you bought, which is on your loins, and arise, go to Perath and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.
So I went and hid it at Perath, just as the LORD had commanded me.
And after many days the LORD said to me: Arise, go to Perath and take from there the loincloth I commanded you to hide there.
So I went to Perath and dug, and I took the loincloth from the place where I had hidden it — and the loincloth was ruined; it was good for nothing.
And the word of the LORD came to me:
This is what the LORD says: In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart and have walked after other gods to serve them and bow down to them — let them be like this loincloth, which is good for nothing.

For just as the loincloth clings to a man's loins, so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to me, declares the LORD, to be to me a people, a name, a praise and a splendour; but they did not listen.

And you shall speak this word to them: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin will be filled with wine. And they will say to you: Do we not know perfectly well that every wineskin will be filled with wine?

And you shall say to them: This is what the LORD says: I am about to fill all the inhabitants of this land — the kings who sit for David on his throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem — with drunkenness.

And I will smash them one against another, both the fathers and the sons together, declares the LORD. I will not show pity, I will not spare, I will not have compassion — I will not hold back from destroying them.
Hear and give ear; do not be haughty, for the LORD has spoken.

Give glory to the LORD your God before he brings darkness, and before your feet stumble on the mountains of twilight; and you wait for light, and he turns it to deep darkness, and makes it thick darkness.
But if you will not listen to it, I will weep in secret places because of your pride; my eye will weep bitterly and run down with tears, for the flock of the LORD has been taken captive.
Say to the king and to the queen mother: Humble yourselves, sit down, for it has come down from your heads — your crown of splendour.
The cities of the Negev are shut up, with no one to open them. Judah is taken into exile, all of it, taken into exile completely.
Lift up your eyes and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, the sheep of your splendour?
What will you say when he appoints over you those you yourself taught to be over you, close companions, as your head? Will not pangs seize you like a woman in labour?
And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things happened to me?" — it is for the greatness of your iniquity that your skirts have been stripped up and your heels have suffered violence.
Can a Cushite change his skin, or a leopard his spots? Then you too could do good, you who are trained to do evil.
And I will scatter them like chaff driven away by the wilderness wind.
This is your lot, the portion measured out to you from me, declares the LORD, because you have forgotten me and trusted in falsehood.
And I myself have stripped your skirts up over your face, and your shame is seen.
Your adulteries and your neighings, the wickedness of your whoring — on the hills, in the field, I have seen your detestable things. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be clean. How much longer?

jeremiah_14.t: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the droughts:
Judah mourns, and her gates languish; they mourn down to the ground, and the outcry of Jerusalem goes up.
Their nobles have sent their servants for water. They came to the cisterns and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty. They were ashamed and humiliated, and they covered their heads.
Because the ground is cracked, for there has been no rain in the land, the farmers are ashamed; they have covered their heads.
Even the doe in the field gives birth and abandons her young, because there is no grass.
Wild donkeys stand on the bare heights; they pant for breath like jackals. Their eyes fail, for there is no vegetation.
Though our iniquities testify against us, LORD, act for the sake of your name; for our turnings away are many; against you we have sinned.
Hope of Israel, its deliverer in a time of distress, why are you like a sojourner in the land, like a traveller who turns aside to stay the night?
Why are you like a man astounded, like a warrior who cannot save? Yet you are in our midst, LORD, and your name is called over us. Do not leave us!

This is what the LORD says concerning this people: So they have loved to wander; they have not restrained their feet. And the LORD has not accepted them; now he will remember their iniquity and call their sins to account.
And the LORD said to me: Do not pray for this people, for their good.

When they fast, I will not listen to their cry of entreaty; and when they offer up a burnt offering and a grain offering, I will not accept them. For by sword and famine and pestilence I am bringing them to an end.
And I said: Ah, Lord GOD! See, the prophets are saying to them: You will not see the sword, and famine will not come upon you; for I will give you a peace of faithfulness in this place.

And the LORD said to me: The prophets are prophesying falsehood in my name. I did not send them, I did not command them, and I did not speak to them. A vision of falsehood, and divination, and a worthless thing, and the deceit of their own heart — that is what they are prophesying to you.

Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name — and I did not send them — and who say, "Sword and famine will not come on this land": By sword and by famine those prophets will meet their end.

And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword, with no one to bury them — them, their wives, their sons and their daughters. And I will pour out their evil upon them.

And you shall speak this word to them: Let my eyes run down with tears, night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is shattered with a great shattering, with a wound made very grievous.
If I go out into the field — there, those slain by the sword; and if I enter the city — there, the diseases of famine. For both prophet and priest have gone about in a land they do not know.

Have you utterly rejected Judah? Does your very self abhor Zion? Why have you struck us, so that there is no healing for us? We waited for peace, but there was no good; for a time of healing, and instead — terror.
We know our wickedness, LORD, the iniquity of our ancestors; for we have sinned against you.
Do not spurn us, for the sake of your name; do not treat the throne of your glory with contempt. Remember — do not break your covenant with us.
Are there among the worthless things of the nations any that send rain? Or do the heavens themselves give showers? Is it not you, LORD our God? So we wait for you, for you have made all these things.

jeremiah_15.t: And the LORD said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel stood before me, I would not turn toward this people. Send them away from before my face, and let them go.

And when they say to you, "Where shall we go?", you shall say to them: This is what the LORD says: Those who are for death, to death; those who are for the sword, to the sword; those who are for famine, to famine; those who are for captivity, to captivity.
And I will appoint over them four kinds, declares the LORD: the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the heavens and the animals of the earth to devour and destroy.
And I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, on account of Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.
For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will show sympathy for you? Who will turn aside to ask after your welfare?
You yourself abandoned me, declares the LORD; you keep going backward. So I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you; I am weary of relenting.
I have winnowed them with a winnowing fork in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them, I have destroyed my people; they did not turn back from their ways.

Their widows have become more numerous to me than the sand of the seas. I have brought against them — against the mother of a young man — a destroyer at noon. I have made anguish and sudden terror fall upon her suddenly.

She who bore seven has grown feeble; she has breathed out her life. Her sun set while it was still day; she is ashamed and abashed. And the rest of them I will give to the sword before their enemies, declares the LORD.
Woe to me, my mother, that you bore me, a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole land! I have not lent, and no one has lent to me, yet all of them curse me.
The LORD said: Surely I have set you free for good; surely I have made the enemy plead with you in a time of evil and in a time of distress.
Can iron be broken — iron from the north — or bronze?
Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without price — and that for all your sins throughout all your territories.
And I will make your enemies pass over into a land you do not know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, and it will burn against you.
You know, LORD. Remember me and attend to me, and avenge me on those who harass me. Do not take me away in your patience; know that for your sake I bear reproach.
Your words were found, and I ate them, and your word became to me a joy and the delight of my heart; for your name is called over me, LORD, God of hosts.
I have not sat in the company of merrymakers and rejoiced; because of your hand I sat alone, for you filled me with indignation.
Why has my pain become perpetual, and my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? Will you really be to me like a deceitful stream, waters that cannot be relied on?

Therefore this is what the LORD says: If you turn back, I will bring you back; you will stand before me. And if you bring out what is precious from what is worthless, you will be as my mouth. They will turn back to you, but you shall not turn back to them.
And I will make you to this people a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not prevail over you, for I am with you to save you and to deliver you, declares the LORD.
And I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked and ransom you from the grasp of the ruthless.

jeremiah_16.t: The word of the LORD came to me:
You shall not take a wife for yourself, and you shall not have sons or daughters in this place.
For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and the daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them and their fathers who fathered them in this land:

They will die of deadly diseases; they will not be mourned and they will not be buried; they will be dung on the face of the ground. By sword and by famine they will come to an end, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the heavens and the animals of the earth.

For this is what the LORD says: Do not enter a house of mourning, and do not go to lament, and do not show sympathy for them; for I have withdrawn my peace from this people, declares the LORD — the steadfast love and the compassion.
Great and small will die in this land; they will not be buried, and no one will lament for them, and no one will gash himself or shave his head bald for them.
No one will break bread for them in mourning, to comfort anyone for the dead; and no one will give them the cup of consolations to drink, for his father or for his mother.
And you shall not enter a house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am about to cause to cease from this place, before your eyes and in your days, the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the sound of the bridegroom and the sound of the bride.

And when you tell this people all these words, and they say to you, "For what has the LORD spoken all this great disaster against us? And what is our iniquity, and what is our sin that we have sinned against the LORD our God?" —
then you shall say to them: Because your ancestors forsook me, declares the LORD, and walked after other gods and served them and bowed down to them, and they forsook me and did not keep my law;
and you yourselves have done worse evil than your ancestors; and look, each of you is walking after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so as not to listen to me.
So I will hurl you off this land into the land you have not known, you and your ancestors; and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will grant you no favour.
Therefore, days are coming, declares the LORD, when it will no longer be said, "As the LORD lives, who brought up the people of Israel from the land of Egypt,"

but, "As the LORD lives, who brought up the people of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where he had banished them." And I will bring them back to their own soil, which I gave to their ancestors.

I am about to send for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will fish them out; and after that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and every hill and from the clefts of the rocks.
For my eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, and their iniquity is not concealed from before my eyes.
And first I will repay double for their iniquity and their sin, because they profaned my land with the corpses of their detestable things, and filled my inheritance with their abominations.

LORD, my strength and my stronghold, my refuge in a day of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say: Our ancestors inherited nothing but falsehood, worthlessness, and there was nothing in them that profits.
Can a human being make gods for himself? And they are not gods!
Therefore I am about to make them know — this time I will make them know my hand and my might; and they will know that my name is the LORD.

jeremiah_17.t: The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, engraved with a point of flint on the tablet of their heart and on the horns of your altars.
as their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles beside every green tree, on the high hills.
My mountain in the field — your wealth, all your treasures I will give as plunder, your high places too, for sin throughout all your territories.

And you will let go, by your own doing, of the inheritance I gave you; and I will make you serve your enemies in the land you do not know; for you have kindled a fire in my anger — it will burn for ever.
This is what the LORD says: Cursed is the man who trusts in humankind and makes flesh his arm, whose heart turns aside from the LORD.
He will be like a bush in the desert plain, and he will not see when good comes; he will dwell in parched places in the wilderness, a land of salt that is not inhabited.
Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose trust is the LORD.

He will be like a tree planted by water, which sends out its roots by a stream; it will not see when heat comes, and its leaf will stay green; in a year of drought it will not be anxious, and it will not cease producing fruit.
The heart is more crooked than anything, and it is incurable. Who can know it?
I, the LORD, search the heart, test the kidneys, to give to each according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds.
A partridge that gathers a brood it did not lay — so is the one who makes wealth, and not with justice. In the middle of his days it will leave him, and at his end he will be a fool.
A throne of glory, exalted from the first, is the place of our sanctuary.
Hope of Israel, LORD! All who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn away from me will be written in the earth, for they have forsaken the spring of living water, the LORD.
Heal me, LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
See, they are saying to me: "Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come, then!"
But I have not hurried away from being a shepherd after you, and I have not desired the day of ruin. You know: what came out of my lips was before your face.
Do not become a terror to me; you are my refuge in a day of disaster.
Let my pursuers be put to shame, and let me not be put to shame; let them be dismayed, and let me not be dismayed. Bring on them a day of disaster, and shatter them with a double shattering.
This is what the LORD said to me: Go and stand in the People's Gate, by which the kings of Judah come in and go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.
And you shall say to them: Hear the word of the LORD, kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem who come in at these gates.
This is what the LORD says: Take heed for your lives, and do not carry a burden on the sabbath day, and do not bring it in at the gates of Jerusalem.
And you shall not bring a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, and you shall do no work; and you shall set apart the sabbath day as holy, just as I commanded your ancestors.
But they did not listen and did not incline their ear; they stiffened their neck so as not to listen and not to accept correction.
And if you will indeed listen to me, declares the LORD, not bringing a burden in at the gates of this city on the sabbath day, and setting apart the sabbath day as holy, doing no work on it,

then there will come in at the gates of this city kings and officials sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses — they and their officials, the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem — and this city will remain for ever.

And they will come from the cities of Judah and from around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin and the Shephelah and the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offering and sacrifice and grain offering and frankincense, and bringing a thank offering to the house of the LORD.

But if you will not listen to me, to set apart the sabbath day as holy and not to carry a burden and come in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in her gates, and it will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem, and it will not be extinguished.

jeremiah_18.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
Arise and go down to the potter's house, and there I will let you hear my words.
So I went down to the potter's house, and there he was, working at the wheel.
And the vessel he was making with the clay was spoiled in the potter's hand; so he would start again and make it into another vessel, just as it seemed right in the potter's eyes to make.
Then the word of the LORD came to me:
Can I not do to you as this potter does, house of Israel? declares the LORD. See, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.
At one moment I may speak concerning a nation or a kingdom, to uproot and to pull down and to destroy;
and if that nation turns back from its evil, concerning which I spoke, then I will relent concerning the disaster I had planned to do to it.
And at another moment I may speak concerning a nation or a kingdom, to build and to plant;
and if it does what is evil in my eyes, so as not to listen to my voice, then I will relent concerning the good I said I would do to it.

And now, say to the people of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: This is what the LORD says: I am shaping disaster against you and planning a plan against you. Turn back, each of you, from your evil way, and make your ways and your deeds good.
But they say: It is hopeless. We will walk after our own plans, and each of us will act according to the stubbornness of his evil heart.
Therefore this is what the LORD says: Ask now among the nations: who has heard anything like this? A most horrible thing the virgin of Israel has done.
Does the snow of Lebanon leave the rock of the field? Are the cool waters that flow from afar ever plucked up?
But my people have forgotten me; they burn offerings as smoke to a delusion. And they have made them stumble in their ways, the paths of old, to walk in bypaths, on a road not built up,
making their land a waste, a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will wag his head.
Like an east wind I will scatter them before the enemy. I will show them my back and not my face on the day of their doom.

And they said: Come, let us plan plans against Jeremiah; for law will not be lost from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and let us pay no attention to any of his words.
Be attentive to me, LORD, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.
Is evil repaid in place of good? For they have dug a pit for my life. Remember how I stood before you to speak good on their behalf, to turn your wrath back from them.

Therefore give their children to famine and pour them out onto the hands of the sword; let their wives be bereaved of children and widowed, let their men be slain by death, their young men struck down by the sword in battle.
Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a marauding band upon them suddenly; for they have dug a pit to capture me, and they have hidden snares for my feet.

And you, LORD, know all their plan against me, for death. Do not make atonement for their iniquity, and do not wipe out their sin from before you. Let them be overthrown before you; in the time of your anger deal with them.

jeremiah_19.t: This is what the LORD said: Go and buy a potter's earthenware flask, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests;
and go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is at the entrance of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I speak to you.

And you shall say: Hear the word of the LORD, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am about to bring disaster on this place, such that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.

Because they have forsaken me and made this place foreign, and burned offerings as smoke in it to other gods whom neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah have known, and have filled this place with the blood of the innocent;
and they have built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal — which I did not command and did not speak, and which never came into my mind.
Therefore, days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called the Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

And I will make void the plan of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies and by the hand of those who seek their life; and I will give their corpses as food to the birds of the heavens and the animals of the earth.
And I will make this city a waste and a hissing; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and hiss over all its wounds.

And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each will eat the flesh of his neighbour, in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies and those who seek their life will press them.
And you shall break the flask before the eyes of the men who go with you,

and say to them: This is what the LORD of hosts says: So will I shatter this people and this city, as one shatters a potter's vessel that can never be repaired; and in Topheth they will bury, for lack of room to bury.
So I will do to this place, declares the LORD, and to its inhabitants, making this city like Topheth.

And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be like the place of the Topheth — the unclean ones — all the houses on whose roofs they burned offerings as smoke to all the host of the heavens and poured out drink offerings to other gods.
Then Jeremiah came from the Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of the LORD and said to all the people:

This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am about to bring on this city and on all its towns all the disaster I have spoken against it, because they have stiffened their neck so as not to hear my words.

jeremiah_20.t: Now Pashhur son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
And Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, in the house of the LORD.
The next day Pashhur brought Jeremiah out from the stocks, and Jeremiah said to him: The LORD has not called your name Pashhur, but Terror All Around.

For this is what the LORD says: I am about to make you a terror to yourself and to all who love you; and they will fall by the sword of their enemies while your eyes look on. And all Judah I will give into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take them into exile to Babylon and strike them down with the sword.

And I will give all the wealth of this city and all its produce and all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah I will give into the hand of their enemies; and they will plunder them and take them and bring them to Babylon.

And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into captivity; you will come to Babylon, and there you will die and there you will be buried — you and all who love you, to whom you have prophesied falsehood.
You deceived me, LORD, and I was deceived; you overpowered me and prevailed. I have become a laughing-stock all day long; every one of them mocks me.
For as often as I speak I cry out; "Violence and havoc!" I proclaim. For the word of the LORD has become for me a reproach and derision all day long.
And if I say, "I will not remember him, and I will not speak any more in his name," then it becomes in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones; and I am weary of holding it in, and I cannot.

For I have heard the whispering of many — Terror All Around! — "Denounce him! Let us denounce him!" Every man at peace with me watches for my stumbling: "Perhaps he will be deceived, and we will prevail over him and take our vengeance on him."

But the LORD is with me like a ruthless warrior; therefore my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will be utterly put to shame, for they will not succeed — a perpetual ignominy that will not be forgotten.
LORD of hosts, who tests the righteous, who sees the kidneys and the heart — let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my case.
Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD! For he has delivered the life of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
Cursed be the day on which I was born! The day my mother bore me — let it not be blessed!
Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, saying, "A son has been born to you, a male!" — and made him very glad.
Let that man be like the cities the LORD overturned without relenting; let him hear a cry in the morning and an alarm at the time of noon,
because he did not kill me in the womb, so that my mother would have been my grave and her womb pregnant for ever.
Why did I come out from the womb to see trouble and sorrow, and my days end in shame?

jeremiah_21.t: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying:
Seek the LORD on our behalf, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all his wonders, and he will withdraw from us.
And Jeremiah said to them: This is what you shall say to Zedekiah:

This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn back the weapons of war that are in your hand, with which you are fighting the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are besieging you outside the wall; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.
And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a strong arm, in anger and in wrath and in great rage.
And I will strike down the inhabitants of this city, both humankind and the animals; they will die by a great pestilence.

And after that, declares the LORD, I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people — those who remain in this city from the pestilence, the sword and the famine — into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life; and he will strike them down by the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, he will not show pity, he will not have compassion.
And to this people you shall say: This is what the LORD says: I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.
Whoever remains in this city will die by sword and famine and pestilence; and whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who are besieging you will live, and his life will be his as plunder.
For I have set my face against this city for harm and not for good, declares the LORD. It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.
And to the house of the king of Judah: Hear the word of the LORD.

House of David, this is what the LORD says: Administer justice each morning, and deliver the robbed from the hand of the oppressor, or my wrath will go out like fire and burn with no one to quench it, because of the evil of your deeds.
See, I am against you, you who sit above the valley, rock of the plain, declares the LORD — you who say, "Who will come down against us? Who will enter our lairs?"
And I will call you to account according to the fruit of your deeds, declares the LORD; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will consume everything around her.

jeremiah_22.t: This is what the LORD said: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there,
and say: Hear the word of the LORD, king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David — you and your servants and your people who come in at these gates.

This is what the LORD says: Do justice and righteousness, and deliver the robbed from the hand of the oppressor; do not maltreat the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow, do not treat them violently, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
For if you will indeed do this thing, then there will come in at the gates of this house kings sitting for David on his throne, riding in chariots and on horses — he and his servants and his people.
But if you will not listen to these words, I swear by myself, declares the LORD, that this house will become a ruin.
For this is what the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: You are Gilead to me, the summit of Lebanon; yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities that are not inhabited.
And I will set apart destroyers against you, each with his weapons; they will cut down the choicest of your cedars and cast them on the fire.
And many nations will pass by this city, and each will say to his neighbour: Why did the LORD do this to this great city?
And they will say: Because they forsook the covenant of the LORD their God and bowed down to other gods and served them.
Do not weep for the dead, and do not show sympathy for him. Weep bitterly for the one who goes away, for he will never return to see the land of his birth.
For this is what the LORD says concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned in place of Josiah his father, and who has gone out from this place: He will not return there again;
for in the place where they have taken him into exile, there he will die, and he will not see this land again.
Woe to the one who builds his house with no righteousness and his upper rooms with no justice, who makes his neighbour work for nothing and does not give him his wages;
who says, "I will build myself a great house with spacious upper rooms," and cuts out windows for himself, panelled with cedar and painted with vermilion.
Do you reign because you compete in cedar? Your father — did he not eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it went well with him.
He defended the cause of the poor and the needy; then it went well. Is that not what it is to know me? declares the LORD.
But your eyes and your heart are on nothing but your unjust gain, on shedding the blood of the innocent, on oppression and extortion, to do them.

Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: They will not lament for him: "Alas, my brother!" and "Alas, sister!" They will not lament for him: "Alas, lord!" and "Alas, his splendour!"
With the burial of a donkey he will be buried — dragged away and thrown out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
Go up to Lebanon and cry out; in Bashan raise your voice; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers are shattered.
I spoke to you in your prosperity; you said, "I will not listen." This has been your way from your youth: you have not listened to my voice.
The wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Then indeed you will be ashamed and humiliated because of all your evil.
You who dwell in Lebanon, nested among the cedars, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, anguish like a woman in labour!
As I live, declares the LORD, even if Coniah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would pull you off from there.
And I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, into the hand of those you are afraid of, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
And I will hurl you and your mother who bore you into another land, where you were not born; and there you will die.
And to the land to which they long to return, there they will not return.
Is this man Coniah a despised, smashed pot, a vessel no one delights in? Why have they been hurled out, he and his offspring, and thrown into a land they do not know?
Land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!
This is what the LORD says: Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for none of his offspring will prosper, sitting on the throne of David and ruling over Judah again.

jeremiah_23.t: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the flock of my pasture, declares the LORD.

Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning the shepherds who shepherd my people: You have scattered my flock and driven them away, and you have not attended to them. I am about to call you to account for the evil of your deeds, declares the LORD.
And I myself will gather the remnant of my flock from all the lands where I have banished them, and I will bring them back to their pasture; and they will be fruitful and increase.
And I will raise up over them shepherds who will shepherd them; they will no longer be afraid or dismayed, and none will be missing, declares the LORD.
Days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch; a king will reign and act prudently, and will do justice and righteousness in the land.
In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell in security. And this is the name by which he will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
Therefore, days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, "As the LORD lives, who brought up the people of Israel from the land of Egypt,"

but, "As the LORD lives, who brought up and who brought the offspring of the house of Israel from a land to the north and from all the lands where I banished them." And they will dwell on their own soil.
Concerning the prophets: My heart is shattered within me; all my bones tremble. I have become like a drunken man, like a man whom wine has overcome, because of the LORD and because of his holy words.
For the land is full of adulterers; because of a curse the land mourns, the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. Their course has become evil, and their strength is not right.
For both prophet and priest are polluted; even in my house I have found their evil, declares the LORD.

Therefore their way will become for them like slippery places in the darkness; they will be driven on and fall in it. For I will bring disaster on them, the year of their punishment, declares the LORD.
Among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing: they prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.

And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: committing adultery and walking in falsehood; and they strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns back from his evil. All of them have become to me like Sodom, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah.

Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says concerning the prophets: I am about to feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink; for from the prophets of Jerusalem pollution has gone out to all the land.

This is what the LORD of hosts says: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They are filling you with worthlessness; they speak the vision of their own heart, not from the mouth of the LORD.
They keep saying to those who despise me: "The LORD has spoken: You shall have peace." And to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his heart they say: "Disaster will not come upon you."
For who has stood in the council of the LORD to see and hear his word? Who has paid attention to his word and listened?
See — the storm of the LORD! Wrath has gone out, a whirling storm; it will whirl on the head of the wicked.
The anger of the LORD will not turn back until he has done and carried out the purposes of his heart. At the end of the days you will understand it fully.
I did not send the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.
But if they had stood in my council, they would have made my people hear my words, and would have turned them back from their evil way and from the evil of their deeds.
Am I a God who is near, declares the LORD, and not a God far off?
Can anyone hide himself in hiding places and I not see him? declares the LORD. Do I not fill the heavens and the earth? declares the LORD.
I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy falsehood in my name, saying: I have dreamed! I have dreamed!
How long? Is there anything in the heart of the prophets who prophesy falsehood, prophets of the deceit of their own heart —
who plan to make my people forget my name by their dreams, which they recount to one another, just as their ancestors forgot my name for Baal?
The prophet who has a dream, let him recount the dream; and the one who has my word, let him speak my word in faithfulness. What has straw to do with grain? declares the LORD.
Is not my word like fire? declares the LORD — and like a hammer that smashes rock?
Therefore I am against the prophets, declares the LORD, who steal my words from one another.
I am against the prophets, declares the LORD, who take their own tongue and utter a declaration.

I am against those who prophesy dreams of falsehood, declares the LORD, and recount them and lead my people astray by their falsehoods and their recklessness; and I did not send them and did not command them, and they certainly do not benefit this people, declares the LORD.
And when this people, or the prophet or a priest, asks you, "What is the burden of the LORD?", you shall say to them: "What burden?" And I will abandon you, declares the LORD.
And as for the prophet and the priest and the people who say, "The burden of the LORD" — I will call that man and his house to account.
This is what you shall say, each to his neighbour and each to his brother: What has the LORD answered? and What has the LORD spoken?
And you shall not mention the burden of the LORD again, for the burden is each man's own word; and you have overturned the words of the living God, the LORD of hosts, our God.
This is what you shall say to the prophet: What has the LORD answered you? and What has the LORD spoken?

But if you say, "The burden of the LORD" — therefore this is what the LORD says: Because you have spoken this word, "The burden of the LORD," when I sent to you saying, You shall not say, "The burden of the LORD" —
therefore I will surely forget you and lift you up, and I will abandon you and the city I gave to you and to your ancestors, from before my face.
And I will put on you a perpetual reproach and a perpetual shame that will not be forgotten.

jeremiah_24.t: The LORD showed me, and there were two baskets of figs set before the temple of the LORD — after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, into exile, along with the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and the smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
One basket had very good figs, like first-ripe figs; and one basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten because they were so bad.
And the LORD said to me: What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said: Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, too bad to be eaten.
Then the word of the LORD came to me:
This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Like these good figs, so I will regard for good the exiles of Judah, whom I have sent from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
And I will set my eye on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; I will build them and not tear them down, I will plant them and not uproot them.
And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD; and they will be a people to me, and I will be God to them, for they will return to me with all their heart.

And like the bad figs, which cannot be eaten because they are so bad — for this is what the LORD says — so I will make Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials and the remnant of Jerusalem, those who remain in this land and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
And I will make them a horror, an evil thing, to all the kingdoms of the earth — a reproach and a byword, a taunt and a curse in all the places where I will banish them.
And I will send against them sword, famine and pestilence, until they are finished from the ground I gave to them and to their ancestors.

jeremiah_25.t: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah — that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon —
which Jeremiah the prophet spoke concerning all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, until this day — these twenty-three years — the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, but you have not listened.
And the LORD sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, but you did not listen and did not incline your ear to listen.
saying: Turn back now, each of you from his evil way and from the evil of your deeds, and dwell on the soil that the LORD gave to you and to your ancestors, from of old and for ever.
And do not walk after other gods to serve them and bow down to them; do not provoke me to anger with the work of your hands, and I will not do you harm.
But you did not listen to me, declares the LORD, and so provoked me to anger with the work of your hands, to your own harm.
Therefore this is what the LORD of hosts says: Because you have not listened to my words,

I am about to send and fetch all the clans of the north, declares the LORD, and Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, my servant; and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants and against all these nations round about. And I will devote them to destruction and make them a waste and a hissing and perpetual ruins.
And I will destroy among them the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the sound of the bridegroom and the sound of the bride, the sound of the hand-mill and the light of the lamp.
And all this land will become a desolation and a waste; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

And when seventy years are completed, I will call the king of Babylon and that nation to account, declares the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans too; and I will make it perpetual desolations.
And I will bring on that land all my words that I have spoken against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.
For many nations and great kings will make them serve, they too; and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the work of their hands.
For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.
And they will drink and stagger and behave like madmen, because of the sword I am sending among them.
So I took the cup from the hand of the LORD and made all the nations to whom the LORD sent me drink:
Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and its officials — to make them a ruin, a waste, a hissing and a curse, as it is this day;
Pharaoh king of Egypt and his servants and his officials and all his people;
and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines — Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron and the remnant of Ashdod;
Edom and Moab and the Ammonites;
and all the kings of Tyre and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastland beyond the sea;
Dedan and Tema and Buz, and all who have their temples clipped;
and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;
and all the kings of Zimri and all the kings of Elam and all the kings of Media;
and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after another, and all the kingdoms of the earth that are on the face of the ground. And the king of Sheshach will drink after them.
And you shall say to them: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Drink, be drunk and vomit, fall and do not rise, because of the sword I am sending among you.
And if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, you shall say to them: This is what the LORD of hosts says: You shall surely drink!

For see, in the city that is called by my name I am beginning to do harm, and shall you go utterly unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, for I am calling a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth, declares the LORD of hosts.

And you, prophesy to them all these words, and say to them: The LORD roars from on high and from his holy dwelling gives forth his voice. He roars mightily over his habitation; he raises a shout like those who tread the winepress, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
An uproar has come to the end of the earth, for the LORD has a case against the nations; he is entering into judgement with all flesh. The wicked he has given to the sword, declares the LORD.
This is what the LORD of hosts says: See, disaster is going out from nation to nation, and a great storm is being roused from the remotest parts of the earth.
And the slain of the LORD on that day will be from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned or gathered or buried; they will be dung on the face of the ground.
Wail, shepherds, and cry out; roll in ashes, you nobles of the flock! For your days for slaughter are completed, and your dispersions; and you will fall like a precious vessel.
And there will be no place of escape for the shepherds, no escape for the nobles of the flock.
The sound of the cry of the shepherds and the wailing of the nobles of the flock! For the LORD is destroying their pasture,
and the peaceful pastures are devastated because of the burning of the LORD's anger.
He has left his lair like a young lion, for their land has become a waste because of the anger of the oppressor and because of the burning of his anger.

jeremiah_26.t: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:

This is what the LORD said: Stand in the court of the house of the LORD, and speak to all the cities of Judah who come to bow down at the house of the LORD all the words I have commanded you to speak to them. Do not hold back a word.
Perhaps they will listen and turn back, each from his evil way; and I will relent concerning the disaster I am planning to do to them because of the evil of their deeds.
And you shall say to them: This is what the LORD says: If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law that I have set before you,
to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I am sending to you — rising early and sending them, though you have not listened —
then I will make this house like Shiloh, and this city I will make a curse for all the nations of the earth.
And the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
And when Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying: You shall surely die!

Why have you prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying: This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, with no inhabitant? And all the people assembled against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
And the officials of Judah heard these things, and they came up from the house of the king to the house of the LORD, and sat at the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD.
And the priests and the prophets said to the officials and to all the people: A sentence of death for this man! For he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears.
And Jeremiah said to all the officials and to all the people: The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words you have heard.
And now, make your ways and your deeds good, and listen to the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will relent concerning the disaster he has spoken against you.
And as for me, here I am in your hand; do to me whatever is good and right in your eyes.

Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you are bringing innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and upon its inhabitants; for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.
And the officials and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: There is no sentence of death for this man, for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.
And men from among the elders of the land arose and said to all the assembly of the people:

Micah the Morashtite was prophesying in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he said to all the people of Judah: This is what the LORD of hosts says: Zion will be ploughed like a field, Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, and the mountain of the house a wooded high place.

Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah actually put him to death? Did he not fear the LORD and entreat the face of the LORD, so that the LORD relented concerning the disaster he had spoken against them? And we are about to do a great evil against our own lives.
There was also a man prophesying in the name of the LORD, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
And King Jehoiakim and all his warriors and all the officials heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death. And Uriah heard of it, and he was afraid and fled and went to Egypt.
And King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt — Elnathan son of Achbor and men with him — to Egypt.
And they brought Uriah out from Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, and he struck him down with the sword and threw his corpse into the graves of the common people.
