Then the channels of water appeared, and the foundations of the world were uncovered, at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of many waters.
He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from those who hate me, for they were too strong for me.
They confronted me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD became my support.
He brought me out to a roomy place; he rescued me, for he delighted in me.
The LORD dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the purity of my hands he repaid me.
For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and I have not wickedly turned from my God.
For all his judgements have been before me, and I have not put his statutes away from me.
And I have been blameless with him, and I have kept myself from my iniquity.
And the LORD repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the purity of my hands before his eyes.
With the faithful you show yourself faithful; with the blameless man you show yourself blameless;
with the pure you show yourself pure, and with the crooked you show yourself twisted.
For you save an afflicted people, and you bring lofty eyes low.
For you light my lamp; the LORD my God brightens my darkness.
For with you I can charge a raiding band, and with my God I can leap a wall.
As for God — his way is blameless; the speech of the LORD is refined; he is a shield to all who take refuge in him.
For who is God apart from the LORD, and who is a Rock except our God?
The God who girds me with might, and makes my way blameless;
who makes my feet like a deer's, and makes me stand firm on my high places;
who trains my hands for battle, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You have given me the shield of your salvation, and your right hand has supported me, and your gentleness has made me great.
You enlarged my stride beneath me, and my ankles did not slip.
I pursued my enemies and overtook them, and I did not turn back until they were finished.
I shattered them, and they could not rise; they fell under my feet.
You girded me with might for the battle; you made those who rose against me bow down beneath me.
As for my enemies, you gave me their necks; and those who hate me, I destroyed them.
They cried for help, and there was no saviour — to the LORD, and he did not answer them.
I crushed them like dust before the wind; like the mud of the streets I poured them out.
You brought me to safety from the strivings of a people; you set me as head of nations; a people I did not know serve me.
At the hearing of an ear they obey me; sons of a foreign land come cringing to me.
Sons of a foreign land wither, and come trembling out of their strongholds.
The LORD lives! Blessed be my Rock, and let the God of my salvation be exalted —
the God who gives me vengeance, and subdues peoples beneath me,
who brings me to safety from my enemies — indeed, you lift me above those who rise against me; you deliver me from a man of violence.
Therefore I will give thanks to you among the nations, LORD, and I will make music to your name.
He gives great salvation to his king, and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, to perpetuity.

psalms_19.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David.
The heavens are recounting the glory of God, and the vault is telling the work of his hands.
Day to day pours forth utterance, and night to night shows forth knowledge.
There is no utterance and there are no words; their voice is not heard.
Their line has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. For the sun he has set a tent in them;
and it is like a bridegroom coming out from his chamber, delighting like a mighty man to run its course.
Its rising is from the end of the heavens, and its circuit to their ends, and nothing is hidden from its heat.
The law of the LORD is perfect, restoring the being; the testimony of the LORD is reliable, making the simple wise.
The precepts of the LORD are upright, making the heart glad; the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever; the judgements of the LORD are truth — they are righteous altogether.
They are more desirable than gold, than much refined gold, and sweeter than honey, than the drippings of the comb.
Your servant too is warned by them; in keeping them there is great reward.
Who can discern his errors? Acquit me of hidden faults.
Keep your servant back from presumptuous sins as well; let them not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, and I will be acquitted of great transgression.
Let the sayings of my mouth and the murmuring of my heart be acceptable before you, LORD, my Rock and my redeemer.

psalms_20.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David.
May the LORD answer you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.
May he send your help from the sanctuary, and support you from Zion.
May he remember all your grain offerings, and receive your burnt offering as fat. Selah
May he give you according to your heart, and fulfil all your counsel.
Let us shout for joy at your salvation, and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD fulfil all your requests.
Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed; he answers him from his holy heavens with the mighty deeds of the salvation of his right hand.
Some in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
They have bowed down and fallen, but we have risen and stood upright.
LORD, save! May the King answer us on the day we call.

psalms_21.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David.
LORD, in your strength the king is glad, and in your salvation how greatly he rejoices!
You have given him the desire of his heart, and you have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
For you meet him with blessings of good; you set a crown of refined gold on his head.
He asked life of you; you gave it to him — length of days forever and ever.
Great is his glory through your salvation; splendour and majesty you place upon him.
For you make him a blessing forever; you make him rejoice with gladness in your presence.
For the king trusts in the LORD, and through the steadfast love of the Most High he will not be shaken.
Your hand will find out all your enemies; your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them like a furnace of fire at the time of your appearing; the LORD in his anger will swallow them, and fire will consume them.
You will destroy their fruit from the earth, and their offspring from among the children of humankind.
For they stretched out evil against you; they devised a scheme, but they will not succeed.
For you will make them turn their shoulder; with your bowstrings you will aim at their faces.
Be exalted, LORD, in your strength! We will sing and make music of your might.

psalms_22.t: For the choir director, upon 'The Doe of the Dawn'. A psalm of David.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my roaring.
My God, I call by day and you do not answer, and by night, and I find no rest.
And you are holy, enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
In you our ancestors trusted; they trusted, and you brought them to safety.
To you they cried out and they escaped; in you they trusted and they were not put to shame.
But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by humankind and despised by the people.
All who see me mock me; they curl the lip, they shake the head:
'Commit it to the LORD — let him bring him to safety! Let him deliver him, for he delights in him!'
For you are the one who drew me out from the belly, who made me trust at my mother's breasts.
Upon you I was cast from the womb; from my mother's belly you have been my God.
Do not be far from me, for distress is near, for there is no helper.
Many bulls have surrounded me; the strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
They open their mouths wide against me, a lion tearing and roaring.
Like water I am poured out, and all my bones are out of joint; my heart has become like wax, melted within my inward parts.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue clings to my jaws, and you lay me in the dust of death.
For dogs have surrounded me; a gang of evildoers has encircled me; they pierced my hands and my feet.
I can count all my bones; they look, they stare at me.
They divide my garments among themselves, and for my clothing they cast lots.
But you, LORD, do not be distant; my strength, hasten to my help!
Deliver my being from the sword, my only one from the power of the dog.
Save me from the mouth of the lion — and from the horns of the wild oxen you have answered me!
I will recount your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will praise you.
You who fear the LORD, praise him! All the offspring of Jacob, honour him! And stand in awe of him, all the offspring of Israel!
For he has not despised nor detested the affliction of the afflicted, and he has not hidden his face from him; and when he cried to him for help, he heard.
My praise is from you in the great assembly; I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
The humble will eat and be satisfied; those who seek him will praise the LORD. May your heart live forever!
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD, and all the clans of the nations will bow down before you.
For the kingship belongs to the LORD, and he rules over the nations.
All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and bowed down; before him will bow all who go down to the dust — even the one who could not keep his own being alive.
Offspring will serve him; it will be told of the Lord to the coming generation.
They will come and declare his righteousness to a people yet to be born — that he has done it.

psalms_23.t: The LORD is my shepherd; I lack nothing.
In green pastures he makes me lie down; by waters of rest he leads me.
He restores my being; he guides me in tracks of righteousness for the sake of his name.
Even when I walk through the valley of the shadow of death I will not fear evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff — they comfort me.
You spread a table before me in the presence of my adversaries; you have enriched my head with oil; my cup is abundance.
Surely goodness and steadfast love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I shall return to the house of the LORD for length of days.

psalms_24.t: The earth belongs to the LORD, and what fills it, the world and those who dwell in it.
For he founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the rivers.
Who may go up the mountain of the LORD? And who may stand in his holy place?
The one innocent of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up his being to what is empty and has not sworn deceitfully.
He will receive a blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
This is the generation of those who seek him, those who seek your face — Jacob. Selah
Lift up your heads, gates! Be lifted up, ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in!
Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, gates! Lift up, ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in!
Who is he, this King of glory? The LORD of hosts — he is the King of glory. Selah

psalms_25.t: Of David.
To you, LORD, I lift up my being.
My God, in you I trust; do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
Indeed, none who wait for you will be put to shame; those who act treacherously without cause will be put to shame.
Make your ways known to me, LORD; teach me your paths.
Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I have waited all day long.
Remember your compassion, LORD, and your acts of steadfast love, for they are from of old.
Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; according to your steadfast love remember me — you, for the sake of your goodness, LORD.
Good and upright is the LORD; therefore he teaches sinners in the way.
He leads the humble in what is just, and he teaches the humble his way.
All the paths of the LORD are steadfast love and faithfulness to those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.
For the sake of your name, LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will teach him the way he should choose.
His being will rest in good, and his offspring will possess the land.
The counsel of the LORD is for those who fear him, and his covenant, to make it known to them.
My eyes are continually toward the LORD, for he brings my feet out of the net.
Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am solitary and afflicted.
The distresses of my heart have grown wide; bring me out of my straits.
Consider my affliction and my trouble, and take away all my sins.
Consider my enemies, for they have become many, and they hate me with a violent hatred.
Keep my being and deliver me; do not let me be put to shame, for I have taken refuge in you.
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I have waited for you.
Redeem Israel, God, from all its distresses.

psalms_26.t: Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in the LORD; I will not slip.
Test me, LORD, and put me to the proof; refine my kidneys and my heart.
For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I have walked in your faithfulness.
I do not sit with men of emptiness, and I will not go with those who conceal themselves.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked.
I wash my hands in innocence, and go around your altar, LORD,
to make heard the sound of thanksgiving, and to recount all your wonders.
LORD, I love the habitation of your house, and the place where your glory dwells.
Do not gather my being with sinners, nor my life with men of bloodshed,
in whose hands is depravity, and whose right hand is full of bribes.
But I will walk in my integrity; redeem me and be gracious to me.
My foot stands on level ground; in the assemblies I will bless the LORD.

psalms_27.t: The LORD is my light and my salvation — whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life — of whom shall I be in dread?
When evildoers drew near against me to devour my flesh — my foes and my enemies against me — they stumbled and fell.
If an army encamps against me, my heart will not fear; if war rises against me, even then I am trusting.
One thing I have asked from the LORD — this I will seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the pleasantness of the LORD and to inquire in his temple.
For he will conceal me in his shelter in the day of evil; he will hide me in the secret place of his tent; he will raise me high on a rock.
And now my head will rise above my enemies around me, and I will sacrifice in his tent sacrifices with shouts; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
Hear my voice, LORD, when I call; be gracious to me and answer me.
To you my heart has said, 'Seek my face.' Your face, LORD, I will seek.
Do not hide your face from me; do not turn your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Do not abandon me and do not forsake me, God of my salvation.
For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the LORD will gather me.
Teach me your way, LORD, and lead me on a level path because of those who watch me.
Do not give me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses have risen against me, and one breathing out violence.
Unless I had believed that I would look on the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living —
Wait for the LORD! Be strong, and let your heart show strength. And wait for the LORD!

psalms_28.t: To you, LORD, I call — my Rock, do not be deaf to me, for if you are silent toward me I will become like those who go down to the pit.
Hear the sound of my supplications when I cry to you for help, when I lift up my hands toward your holy innermost room.
Do not drag me away with the wicked or with the workers of wrongdoing, who speak peace with their neighbours while evil is in their heart.
Give to them according to their work and according to the wickedness of their deeds; give to them according to the work of their hands; turn back on them what they have earned.
For they do not consider the deeds of the LORD or the work of his hands; he will tear them down and not build them up.
Blessed be the LORD, for he has heard the sound of my supplications.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him and I was helped; and my heart is jubilant, and with my song I give thanks to him.
The LORD is strength for them, and he is the stronghold of salvation for his anointed.
Save your people and bless your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them for ever.

psalms_29.t: Ascribe to the LORD, you heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name; bow down to the LORD in the majesty of holiness.
The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders — the LORD is over many waters.
The voice of the LORD is in strength; the voice of the LORD is in majesty.
The voice of the LORD is breaking cedars; the LORD shattered the cedars of Lebanon.
He made them skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
The voice of the LORD strikes out flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD makes the wilderness tremble; the LORD makes the wilderness of Kadesh tremble.
The voice of the LORD makes the does writhe in labour, and strips the forests bare; and in his temple, all of it says: Glory!
The LORD sat at the flood, and the LORD sits as king forever.
The LORD will give strength to his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

psalms_30.t: A psalm. A song for the dedication of the house. Of David.
I will exalt you, LORD, for you have drawn me up, and you have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
LORD my God, I cried to you for help, and you healed me.
LORD, you brought up my being from Sheol; you kept me alive from among those going down to the pit.
Make music to the LORD, you his loyal ones, and give thanks to his holy remembrance.
For his anger lasts a moment, his good pleasure a lifetime; weeping lodges for the evening, and at the morning, a shout of joy.
And I said in my ease: 'I will never be shaken.'
LORD, in your good pleasure you made my mountain stand strong; you hid your face — I was dismayed.
To you, LORD, I call, and to the Lord I make supplication:
'What profit is there in my blood, in my going down to destruction? Will the dust give you thanks? Will it declare your faithfulness?
Hear, LORD, and be gracious to me; LORD, be my helper.'
You turned my wailing into dancing; you loosened my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
so that my glory may make music to you and not be silent. LORD my God, forever I will give thanks to you.

psalms_31.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David.
In you, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; in your righteousness bring me to safety.
Incline your ear to me, deliver me quickly; be for me a Rock of refuge, a fortified house, to save me.
For you are my rock and my fortress; and for the sake of your name you will guide me and lead me.
You will bring me out of the net they hid for me, for you are my stronghold.
Into your hand I entrust my spirit; you have redeemed me, LORD, God of faithfulness.
I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but I trust in the LORD.
I will rejoice and be glad in your steadfast love, because you have seen my affliction; you have known the distresses of my being,
and you have not shut me up in the hand of an enemy; you have set my feet in a roomy place.
Be gracious to me, LORD, for I am in distress; my eye has wasted away with vexation, my being and my belly too.
For my life is spent in sorrow, and my years in groaning; my strength has failed through my iniquity, and my bones have wasted away.
Because of all my adversaries I have become a reproach, and to my neighbours exceedingly so, and a dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.
I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; I have become like a vessel that is destroyed.
For I have heard the slander of many — terror all around — when they set themselves together against me; they plotted to take my being.
But I have trusted in you, LORD; I said, 'You are my God.'
My times are in your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from my pursuers.
Make your face shine upon your servant; save me in your steadfast love.
LORD, let me not be put to shame, for I have called on you; let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silenced into Sheol.
Let lying lips be struck dumb, those who speak arrogantly against the righteous with pride and contempt.
How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you have done for those who take refuge in you, before the children of humankind!
You hide them in the secret place of your presence from the conspiracies of man; you conceal them in a shelter from the strife of tongues.
Blessed be the LORD, for he has made his steadfast love wonderful to me in a besieged city.
And I said in my alarm, 'I have been cut off from before your eyes.' Nevertheless you heard the sound of my supplications when I cried to you for help.
Love the LORD, all you his loyal ones! The LORD preserves the faithful, and repays in full the one who acts in pride.
Be strong, and let your heart show strength, all you who wait for the LORD.

psalms_32.t: How blessed is the one whose transgression is lifted away, whose sin is covered!
How blessed is the man to whom the LORD does not reckon iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no treachery!
When I kept silent, my bones wore away through my roaring all day long.
For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my sap was turned as by the dry heat of summer. Selah
I made my sin known to you, and I did not cover my iniquity. I said, 'I will confess my transgressions to the LORD' — and you lifted away the iniquity of my sin. Selah
For this let every loyal one pray to you while you may be found; surely when the flood of many waters comes, it will not reach him.
You are a secret place for me; you preserve me from distress; you surround me with shouts of safety. Selah
I will make you prudent and teach you the way you should go; I will counsel you with my eye upon you.
Do not be like a horse or a mule, without understanding, whose trappings are bridle and halter to restrain it, or it will not come near you.
Many are the pains of the wicked, but steadfast love surrounds the one who trusts in the LORD.
Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, you righteous, and shout for joy, all you upright in heart!

psalms_33.t: Shout for joy in the LORD, you righteous; praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre; with the ten-stringed harp make music to him.
Sing to him a new song; play skilfully, with a shout.
For the word of the LORD is upright, and all his work is done in constancy.
He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the steadfast love of the LORD.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their host.
He gathers the waters of the sea like a heap; he puts the deeps in storehouses.
Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
For he spoke and it was; he commanded and it stood firm.
The LORD has broken the counsel of the nations; he has frustrated the plans of the peoples.
The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the plans of his heart to all generations.
How blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he has chosen as an inheritance for himself!
From the heavens the LORD looks; he sees all the children of humankind.
From his dwelling place he gazes on all the inhabitants of the earth —
he who forms their hearts together, who attends to all their deeds.
The king is not saved by great might; a mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
The horse is a false hope for salvation, and by its great might it does not let anyone escape.
Look — the eye of the LORD is toward those who fear him, toward those who wait for his steadfast love,
to deliver their being from death and to keep them alive in famine.
Our being waits for the LORD; he is our help and our shield.
For our heart is glad in him, for we have trusted in his holy name.
Let your steadfast love, LORD, be upon us, just as we have waited for you.

psalms_34.t: Of David, when he feigned madness before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he went.
I will bless the LORD at all times; his praise will continually be in my mouth.
In the LORD my being makes its boast; let the humble hear and be glad.
Magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
I sought the LORD and he answered me, and he delivered me from all my terrors.
They looked to him and were radiant, and their faces are not abashed.
This poor man called and the LORD heard, and saved him from all his distresses.
The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him, and he rescues them.
Taste and see that the LORD is good; how blessed is the man who takes refuge in him!
Fear the LORD, you his holy ones, for there is no lack for those who fear him.
Young lions are in want and go hungry, but those who seek the LORD do not lack any good thing.
Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
Who is the man who desires life, who loves days in which to see good?
Guard your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, and his ears toward their cry for help.
The face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
They cry out and the LORD hears, and he delivers them from all their distresses.
The LORD is near to the broken-hearted, and he saves the crushed in spirit.
Many are the evils that come on the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
He keeps all his bones; not one of them is broken.
Evil will kill the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be held guilty.
The LORD redeems the being of his servants, and none who take refuge in him will be held guilty.

psalms_35.t: Of David.
Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.
Take hold of shield and body-shield, and rise up as my help.
Draw out spear and javelin to meet my pursuers; say to my being, 'I am your salvation.'
Let them be put to shame and humiliated, those who seek my being; let them be turned back and abashed, those who plot harm against me.
Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them.
Let their way be darkness and slippery places, with the angel of the LORD pursuing them.
For without cause they hid the ditch of their net for me; without cause they dug a pit for my being.
Let destruction come upon him unawares, and let his own net that he hid catch him; let him fall into it, into destruction.
And my being will rejoice in the LORD; it will delight in his salvation.
All my bones will say, 'LORD, who is like you, delivering the afflicted from one too strong for him, the afflicted and the needy from the one who robs him?'
Malicious witnesses rise up; they question me about things I do not know.
They repay me evil in place of good — bereavement for my being.
But when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled my being with fasting, and I prayed with my head sunk to my chest.
I went about as for a neighbour, as for a brother of mine; like one mourning a mother, I bowed down in mourning.
But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered; attackers I did not know gathered against me; they tore at me and did not cease.
Like the godless, mocking for a morsel, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you look on? Bring back my being from their ravages, my only one from the young lions.
I will give thanks to you in the great assembly; among a numerous people I will praise you.
Let not my lying enemies rejoice over me; let not those who hate me for no reason wink the eye.
For they do not speak peace; against the quiet of the land they devise words of deceit.
They open their mouths wide against me; they say, 'Aha! Aha! Our own eye has seen it.'
You have seen it, LORD — do not be silent; Lord, do not be far from me.
Rouse yourself and awake for my vindication, my God and Lord, for my cause.
Judge me according to your righteousness, LORD my God, and do not let them rejoice over me.
Let them not say in their heart, 'Aha, just what we wanted!' Let them not say, 'We have swallowed him.'
Let them be put to shame and abashed together, those who are joyful at my harm; let them be clothed with shame and disgrace, those who magnify themselves against me.
Let them shout for joy and be glad, those who desire my vindication, and let them say continually, 'Let the LORD be great, who desires the welfare of his servant.'
And my tongue will murmur your righteousness, your praise all day long.

psalms_36.t: For the choir director. Of the servant of the LORD, of David.
Transgression speaks to the wicked in the midst of my heart: there is no dread of God before his eyes.
For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to find out his iniquity and hate it.
The words of his mouth are wrongdoing and deceit; he has ceased to act prudently, to do good.
He plans wrongdoing upon his bed; he takes his stand on a way that is not good; he does not reject evil.
LORD, your steadfast love is in the heavens, your constancy reaches to the skies.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judgements are a great deep; humankind and animals you save, LORD.
How precious is your steadfast love, God! The children of humankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
They take their fill from the fatness of your house, and you give them drink from the river of your delights.
For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
Prolong your steadfast love to those who know you, and your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Let not the foot of pride come upon me, and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
There the workers of wrongdoing have fallen; they were thrust down and could not rise.

psalms_37.t: Of David.
Do not fret over evildoers; do not be jealous of those who do injustice.
For like grass they will quickly wither, and like the green herb they will fade.
Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and feed on constancy.
Take delight in the LORD, and he will give you the requests of your heart.
Commit your way to the LORD, and trust in him, and he will act.
He will bring out your righteousness like the light, and your justice like the noonday.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him; do not fret over one who prospers in his way, over a man who carries out schemes.
Refrain from anger and forsake wrath; do not fret — it leads only to doing evil.
For evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD will possess the land.
In a little while the wicked will be no more; you will look carefully at his place, and he will not be there.
But the humble will possess the land, and take delight in abundance of peace.
The wicked plots against the righteous and gnashes his teeth at him.
The Lord laughs at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
The wicked have drawn a sword and bent their bow, to bring down the afflicted and the needy, to slaughter those upright in the way.
Their sword will enter their own heart, and their bows will be broken.
Better is the little the righteous has than the wealth of many wicked.
For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD sustains the righteous.
The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will be forever.
They will not be put to shame in a time of evil, and in days of famine they will be satisfied.
For the wicked will perish, and the enemies of the LORD are like the glory of the pastures: they come to an end; they come to an end in smoke.
The wicked borrows and does not repay, but the righteous is gracious and gives.
For those he blesses will possess the land, and those he curses will be cut off.
The steps of a man are established by the LORD, and he delights in his way.
Though he falls, he will not be thrown down, for the LORD holds his hand.
I have been young, and I have also grown old, and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, or his offspring seeking bread.
All day long he is gracious and lends, and his offspring become a blessing.
Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell forever.
For the LORD loves justice, and he will not forsake his loyal ones; they are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked is cut off.
The righteous will possess the land, and dwell upon it forever.
The mouth of the righteous murmurs wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not slip.
The wicked watches for the righteous and seeks to kill him.
The LORD will not leave him in his hand, and will not condemn him as guilty when he is judged.
Wait for the LORD and keep his way, and he will exalt you to possess the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
I have seen a wicked man, ruthless, spreading himself like a luxuriant native tree.
Then he passed away, and look — he was gone; I sought him, and he was not found.
Watch the blameless and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
But transgressors will be destroyed together; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD, their stronghold in a time of distress.
The LORD helps them and brings them to safety; he brings them to safety from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

psalms_38.t: A psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.
LORD, do not reprove me in your displeasure, and do not discipline me in your wrath.
For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down upon me.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no health in my bones because of my sin.
For my iniquities have gone over my head; like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
My wounds stink and fester because of my folly.
I am bent down, bowed very low; all day long I have gone about mourning.
For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
I am numb and crushed very low; I roar from the groaning of my heart.
Lord, all my desire is before you, and my sighing is not hidden from you.
My heart pounds, my strength has left me; and the light of my eyes — even that is gone from me.
My friends and my neighbours stand back from my plague, and my kinsmen have stood far off.
Those who seek my being set traps; those who seek my harm speak of destruction, and all day long they murmur deceits.
But I am like a deaf man — I do not hear; like a mute who does not open his mouth.
I have become like a man who does not hear, in whose mouth there are no reproofs.
For it is for you, LORD, that I have waited; you will answer, Lord my God.
For I said, 'Let them not rejoice over me; when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.'
For I am ready to stumble, and my pain is before me continually.
For I declare my iniquity; I am anxious because of my sin.
My enemies are alive and vigorous, and those who hate me falsely are many.
Those who repay evil in place of good accuse me, because I pursue good.
Do not forsake me, LORD; my God, do not be far from me.
Hasten to help me, Lord, my salvation.

psalms_39.t: For the choir director, for Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
I said, 'I will guard my ways from sinning with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle on my mouth while the wicked is before me.'
I was dumb and silent; I held back even from good, and my pain was stirred up.
My heart grew hot within me; as I murmured, a fire burned; I spoke with my tongue:
Make known to me my end, LORD, and the measure of my days — what it is; let me know how fleeting I am.
Look — you have made my days handbreadths, and my lifespan is as nothing before you. Surely every human being who stands is altogether a breath. Selah
Surely a man goes about as a shadow; surely they are in turmoil for a breath. He heaps up and does not know who will gather it.
And now, what do I wait for, Lord? My hope is in you.
Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of the fool.
I am dumb, I do not open my mouth, for you have done it.
Remove your plague from me; by the hostility of your hand I am finished.
With reproofs for iniquity you discipline a man, and you melt away what he desires, like a moth. Surely every human being is a breath. Selah
Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be silent at my tears, for I am a sojourner with you, a resident alien like all my ancestors.
Look away from me, and let me be cheerful, before I go and am no more.

psalms_40.t: For the choir director. Of David, a psalm.
I waited and waited for the LORD, and he stretched out to me and heard my cry for help.
He brought me up from a pit of tumult, from the mud of the mire, and he set my feet on a rock; he established my steps.
He put a new song in my mouth, a praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and they will trust in the LORD.
How blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, and has not turned to the proud or to those who fall away to falsehood.
Many things you have done, LORD my God — your wonders, and your plans toward us; there is none to compare with you. I would declare and speak of them, but they are too numerous to recount.
Sacrifice and grain offering you did not desire; ears you have dug open for me; burnt offering and sin offering you did not ask for.
Then I said, 'Look — I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written concerning me.
To do your will, my God, is my desire, and your law is within my inward parts.'
I have brought the news of righteousness in the great assembly; look — I do not restrain my lips. LORD, you know it.
I have not covered your righteousness within my heart; I have spoken of your faithfulness and your salvation; I have not concealed your steadfast love and your faithfulness from the great assembly.
You, LORD, will not withhold your compassion from me; your steadfast love and your faithfulness will continually preserve me.
For evils have encompassed me beyond number; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.
Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me; LORD, hasten to help me.
Let them be put to shame and abashed together, those who seek my being to snatch it away; let them be turned back and humiliated, those who desire my harm.
Let them be appalled at their own shameful reward, those who say to me, 'Aha! Aha!'
Let all who seek you delight and be glad in you; let those who love your salvation say continually, 'The LORD is great!'
But I am afflicted and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and the one who brings me to safety; my God, do not delay.

psalms_41.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David.
How blessed is the one who considers the poor; in a day of evil the LORD will bring him off safe.
The LORD will keep him and preserve him alive; he will be called blessed in the land; and do not give him over to the will of his enemies.
The LORD will support him on his sickbed; all his bed you have changed in his sickness.
I said, 'LORD, be gracious to me; heal my being, for I have sinned against you.'
My enemies speak evil of me: 'When will he die, and his name perish?'
And if one comes to see me, he speaks emptiness; his heart gathers up wrongdoing; he goes outside and speaks of it.
All who hate me whisper together against me; against me they devise evil:
'Some deadly thing has been poured into him, and the one who has lain down will not rise again.'
Even the man at peace with me, whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted his heel against me.
But you, LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, and let me repay them.
By this I know that you delight in me: that my enemy does not shout aloud over me.
And as for me, you have held me in my integrity, and you have set me before you forever.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and amen.

psalms_42.t: For the choir director. A maskil of the sons of Korah.
As a deer pants for channels of water, so my being pants for you, God.
My being thirsts for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
My tears have been my food day and night, while they say to me all day long, 'Where is your God?'

These things I will remember, and I pour out my being within me: how I used to pass on with the throng, leading them in procession to the house of God, with the sound of a shout of joy and thanksgiving, a multitude keeping festival.
Why are you bowed down, my being, and in turmoil within me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to him, the salvation of his presence.
My God, my being is bowed down within me; therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, and the Hermons, from Mount Mizar.
Deep calls to deep at the sound of your waterfalls; all your breakers and your waves have passed over me.
By day the LORD commands his steadfast love, and in the night his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
I will say to God my rock, 'Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go about mourning under the oppression of an enemy?'
With a shattering in my bones my adversaries have taunted me, while they say to me all day long, 'Where is your God?'
Why are you bowed down, my being, and why in turmoil within me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to him, the salvation of my face, and my God.

psalms_43.t: Judge me, God, and conduct my case against a nation that is not loyal; bring me to safety from a man of deceit and injustice.
For you are the God of my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go about mourning under the oppression of an enemy?
Send your light and your truth — let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain and to your dwelling places.
And I will come to the altar of God, to God, the gladness of my rejoicing, and I will give thanks to you with the lyre, God, my God.
Why are you bowed down, my being, and why in turmoil within me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to him, the salvation of my face, and my God.

psalms_44.t: For the choir director. Of the sons of Korah. A maskil.
God, with our own ears we have heard; our ancestors have recounted to us the deed you did in their days, in the days of old.
You — with your own hand you dispossessed nations and planted them; you did harm to peoples and drove them out.

For it was not by their sword that they took possession of the land, and their own arm did not save them, but your right hand and your arm and the light of your face, because you took pleasure in them.
You are he, my King, God; ordain the salvation of Jacob.
By you we gore our foes; in your name we tread down those who rise against us.
For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword does not save me.
For you have saved us from our foes, and you have put to shame those who hate us.
In God we have boasted all day long, and we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah
Yet you have rejected and humiliated us, and you do not go out with our armies.
You make us turn back from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us at will.
You give us over like sheep for food, and you have scattered us among the nations.
You sell your people for nothing, and you have gained nothing by their price.
You make us a reproach to our neighbours, a mockery and derision to those around us.
You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
All day long my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
at the sound of the one who taunts and reviles, because of the enemy and the avenger.
All this has come upon us, and we had not forgotten you, and we had not dealt falsely with your covenant.
Our heart had not turned back, and our steps had not turned aside from your path.
For you have crushed us in a place of jackals, and covered us over with deep darkness.
If we had forgotten the name of our God, and spread out our hands to a strange god,
would not God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
For on your account we are killed all day long; we are reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
Awake! Why do you sleep, Lord? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us in perpetuity.
Why do you hide your face? Do you forget our affliction and our oppression?
For our being has sunk down to the dust; our belly clings to the earth.
Rise up as a help for us, and redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love.

psalms_45.t: For the choir director, upon 'Lilies'. Of the sons of Korah. A maskil. A love song.
My heart is stirred with a good word; I speak my work to a king; my tongue is the stylus of a skilled scribe.
You are more handsome than the sons of humankind; grace has been poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
Gird your sword on your thigh, mighty one — your splendour and your majesty.
And in your majesty ride out in triumph for the cause of truth and humility and righteousness, and let your right hand teach you awesome deeds.
Your arrows are sharpened — peoples fall under you — in the heart of the king's enemies.
Your throne, God, is forever and ever; a sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of your kingdom.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy beyond your companions.
Myrrh and aloes and cassia are all your garments; from palaces of ivory stringed instruments have made you glad.
Daughters of kings are among your noble women; the queen stands at your right hand in the gold of Ophir.
Listen, daughter, and see, and incline your ear; forget your people and your father's house,
and let the king desire your beauty; for he is your lord — bow down to him.
And the daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; the rich of the people will entreat your favour.
All glorious is the king's daughter within; her clothing is of gold settings.
In embroidered robes she is led to the king; the virgins behind her, her companions, are brought to you.
They are brought with gladness and rejoicing; they enter the palace of the king.
In place of your ancestors will be your sons; you will make them princes in all the land.
I will cause your name to be remembered in every generation; therefore peoples will give you thanks forever and ever.

psalms_46.t: For the choir director. Of the sons of Korah, upon alamoth. A song.
God is for us a refuge and strength, a help in distresses, very readily found.
Therefore we will not fear when the earth changes, when the mountains shake in the heart of the seas.
Its waters roar and foam; the mountains shake at its swelling. Selah
There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place of the dwellings of the Most High.
God is in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her at the turn of the morning.
Nations were in a tumult, kingdoms shook; he gave forth his voice, and the earth melted.
The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is a high refuge for us. Selah
Come, see the works of the LORD, who has set desolations on the earth.
He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two; he burns the carts in the fire.
'Stop, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'
The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is a high refuge for us. Selah

psalms_47.t: For the choir director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
Clap your hands, all you peoples! Shout aloud to God with the sound of a shout of joy!
For the LORD Most High is to be feared, a great king over all the earth.
He subdues peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom he loves. Selah
God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a ram's horn.
Make music to God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
For God is the king of all the earth; make music with a maskil.
God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.
The nobles of the peoples have gathered as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.

psalms_48.t: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.
Beautiful in elevation, the delight of all the earth, is Mount Zion, the far reaches of the north, the town of the great king.
God in her fortresses has made himself known as a high refuge.
For look — the kings assembled; they passed on together.
They saw, and so they were astonished; they were terrified, they hurried away.
Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labour.
With an east wind you shatter the ships of Tarshish.
As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish her to perpetuity. Selah
We have reflected on your steadfast love, God, in the midst of your temple.
Like your name, God, so is your praise, to the ends of the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion be glad; let the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of your judgements.
Go around Zion and encircle her; count her towers.
Set your heart on her rampart; walk through her fortresses, so that you may recount it to a later generation.
For this is God, our God, forever and ever; he will guide us beyond death.

psalms_49.t: For the choir director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all you inhabitants of the world,
both children of humankind and children of man, rich and needy alike.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and the murmuring of my heart will be understanding.
I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will open my riddle with the lyre.
Why should I fear in days of evil, when the iniquity of those who cheat me surrounds me —
those who trust in their wealth and boast in the abundance of their riches?
No one can ever redeem a brother; he cannot give God his ransom.
for the redemption price of their life is costly, and he must cease forever —
that he should live on in perpetuity and not see destruction.
For he sees that wise men die; the stupid and the brutish perish alike, and they leave their wealth to others.
Their inward thought is that their houses last forever, their dwelling places from generation to generation; they have called lands by their own names.
And a human being in honour does not remain; he is like the animals that are destroyed.
This is their way — folly is theirs; and those after them approve their sayings. Selah
Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; death shepherds them; and the upright rule over them in the morning, and their form is for Sheol to consume, far from its lofty dwelling.
Surely God will redeem my being from the hand of Sheol, for he will take me. Selah
Do not fear when a man becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases,
for at his death he will take nothing; his glory will not go down after him.
Though in his life he blesses his being — and people praise you when you do well for yourself —
he will go to the generation of his ancestors, who will never see light.
A human being in honour, and without understanding — he is like the animals that are destroyed.

psalms_50.t: A psalm of Asaph.
God, God, the LORD has spoken and summoned the earth, from the rising of the sun to its setting.
From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.
Our God comes and does not keep silent; fire consumes before him, and around him it is a raging tempest.
He summons the heavens above, and the earth, to judge his people:
'Gather to me my loyal ones, those who made my covenant over a sacrifice.'
And the heavens declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah
'Hear, my people, and let me speak; Israel, and I will warn you — I am God, your God.
It is not for your sacrifices that I reprove you; your burnt offerings are before me continually.
I will not take a young bull from your household, or goats from your folds.
For every living creature of the forest is mine, the animals on a thousand hills.
I know every bird of the mountains, and the moving creatures of the field are with me.
If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world and everything in it are mine.
Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Sacrifice a thanksgiving to God, and pay your vows to the Most High,
and call on me in the day of distress; I will rescue you, and you will honour me.'
But to the wicked God says: 'What right have you to recount my statutes, or to take my covenant on your mouth?
And you hate discipline, and you have thrown my words behind you.
If you saw a thief, you were pleased with him, and your portion was with adulterers.
You let your mouth loose in evil, and your tongue harnesses deceit.
You sit and speak against your brother; against your own mother's son you put out slander.
These things you have done and I kept silent; you imagined that I was altogether like you. I will reprove you and lay it out before your eyes.
Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you apart, and there will be no deliverer.
Whoever sacrifices a thanksgiving honours me, and to the one who orders his way I will show the salvation of God.'

psalms_51.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
Be gracious to me, God, according to your steadfast love; according to the abundance of your compassion wipe out my transgressions.
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
For I myself know my transgressions, and my sin is before me continually.
Against you, you alone, I have sinned, and I have done the evil in your eyes, so that you may be just when you speak, and blameless when you judge.
Look — in iniquity I was brought forth, and in sin my mother conceived me.
Look — you desire truth in the inward places, and in a hidden place you make me know wisdom.
Purify me from sin with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall become whiter than snow.
Make me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins, and wipe out all my iniquities.
Create in me a clean heart, God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
Do not cast me away from your presence, and do not take your holy spirit from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and let a willing spirit sustain me.
I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will return to you.
Deliver me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation; let my tongue shout for joy of your righteousness.
Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
For you do not desire sacrifice, or I would give it; you are not pleased with a burnt offering.
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and crushed heart, God, you will not despise.
Do good to Zion in your good pleasure; build the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will delight in sacrifices of righteousness, burnt offering and whole offering; then they will offer up young bulls on your altar.

psalms_52.t: For the choir director. A maskil of David. When Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said to him, 'David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.'
Why do you boast in evil, mighty man? The steadfast love of God lasts all day long.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharpened razor, you worker of treachery.
You love evil more than good, lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah
You love all devouring words, a tongue of deceit.
God also will tear you down forever; he will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent, and root you out from the land of the living. Selah
The righteous will see and fear, and they will laugh at him:
'Look — the man who did not make God his stronghold, but trusted in the abundance of his riches and grew strong in his own destruction.'
But I am like a luxuriant olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the steadfast love of God forever and ever.
I will give thanks to you forever, because you have acted; and I will wait for your name, for it is good, in the presence of your loyal ones.

psalms_53.t: For the choir director, upon mahalath. A maskil of David.
The fool has said in his heart, 'There is no God.' They act corruptly and they make injustice abominable; there is no one who does good.
God looked down from the heavens on the children of humankind, to see whether there is anyone acting prudently, anyone seeking God.
Every one of them has turned back; together they are tainted; there is no one who does good, not even one.
Do they not know, the workers of wrongdoing, who devour my people as they eat bread? They do not call on God.
There they were in dread where there was no dread, for God has scattered the bones of the one who encamped against you; you have put them to shame, for God has rejected them.
Who will grant from Zion the salvation of Israel? When God turns back the captivity of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.

psalms_54.t: For the choir director, with stringed instruments. A maskil of David. When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, 'Is not David hiding among us?'
God, save me by your name, and by your might give judgement for me.
God, hear my prayer; give ear to the sayings of my mouth.
For strangers have risen against me, and ruthless men have sought my being; they have not set God before themselves. Selah
Look — God is my helper; the Lord is among those who sustain my being.
May he turn the evil back on those who watch me; in your faithfulness destroy them.
With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you; I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.
For he has delivered me from every distress, and my eye has looked on my enemies.

psalms_55.t: For the choir director, with stringed instruments. A maskil of David.
Give ear to my prayer, God, and do not hide yourself from my supplication.
Attend to me and answer me; I am restless in my complaint and I moan,
because of the voice of an enemy, because of the pressure of the wicked; for they drop wrongdoing on me, and in anger they are hostile to me.
My heart trembles within me, and the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
Fear and trembling come upon me, and shuddering has covered me.
And I said, 'Who will give me wings like a dove? I would fly away and settle down.'
Look — I would flee far away; I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah
I would hurry to a place of escape for myself from the rushing wind, from the storm.
Confuse them, Lord; divide their tongue, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
Day and night they go around it on its walls, and wrongdoing and trouble are within it.
Destruction is within it, and oppression and deceit do not depart from its public square.
For it is not an enemy who taunts me — then I could endure it; it is not one who hates me who has magnified himself against me — then I could hide from him.
But it is you, a man of my own rank, my close friend and my acquaintance,
with whom I once made counsel sweet; in the house of God we walked about in the throng.
Let death come on them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evils are where they dwell, within them.
As for me, I will call to God, and the LORD will save me.
Evening and morning and noon I complain and murmur, and he has heard my voice.
He has redeemed my being in peace from the battle against me, for they were many against me.
God will hear and humble them — he who sits enthroned from of old, Selah — those who have no changes and do not fear God.
He has stretched out his hands against those at peace with him; he has violated his covenant.
His mouth's smooth talk was creamy, but war was in his heart; his words were softer than oil, and they were drawn swords.
Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will provide for you; he will never permit the righteous to be shaken.
And you, God, will bring them down to the well of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in you.

psalms_56.t: For the choir director, upon 'The Dove among Terebinths Far Away'. Of David, a miktam. When the Philistines seized him in Gath.
Be gracious to me, God, for a human being has crushed me; all day long a fighter oppresses me.
My watchers have crushed me all day long, for many are fighting against me proudly.
On a day when I am afraid, I will trust in you.
In God I praise his word; in God I have trusted, I am not afraid. What can flesh do to me?
All day long they twist my words; all their plans against me are for evil.
They stir up trouble, they lie hidden; they watch my heels, just as they have waited for my being.
Because of wrongdoing — deliverance for them? In anger bring down peoples, God.
You have taken account of my wandering; put my tears in your skin-bottle — are they not in your record?
Then my enemies will turn back on the day I call. This I know: that God is for me.
In God I praise a word; in the LORD I praise a word.
In God I have trusted, I am not afraid. What can a human being do to me?
Your vows are upon me, God; I will pay thanksgivings to you.
For you have delivered my being from death — have you not kept my feet from stumbling? — to walk about before God in the light of the living.

psalms_57.t: For the choir director, upon 'Do Not Destroy'. Of David, a miktam. When he fled from Saul, in the cave.
Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me, for in you my being takes refuge; and in the shadow of your wings I take refuge until the destruction passes by.
I call to God Most High, to the God who carries things through for me.
He will send from the heavens and save me; he reproaches the one who crushes me. Selah God will send his steadfast love and his faithfulness.
My being is among lions; I lie among those who devour the children of humankind. Their teeth are spear and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.
They prepared a net for my steps; my being was bowed down. They dug a pit before me; they have fallen into the midst of it. Selah
My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.
Awake, my glory! Awake, harp and lyre! I will waken the dawn.
I will give thanks to you among the peoples, Lord; I will make music to you among the nations.
For your steadfast love is great, reaching to the heavens, and your faithfulness to the skies.
Be exalted above the heavens, God; let your glory be over all the earth.

psalms_58.t: For the choir director, upon 'Do Not Destroy'. Of David, a miktam.
Do you rulers really speak righteousness? Do you judge the children of humankind with uprightness?
Indeed, in your heart you do injustices; in the land you weigh out the violence of your hands.
The wicked are estranged from the womb; those who speak falsehood go astray from the belly.
Their venom is like the venom of a serpent, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
which does not listen to the voice of charmers, however skilful the caster of spells.
God, break away their teeth in their mouth; break off the fangs of the young lions, LORD.
Let them melt away like water that runs off; when he bends his arrows, let them be as though cut off.
Like a snail that melts away as it goes, like a woman's miscarriage that has never seen the sun.
Before your pots feel the thorn bush, whether green or burning, he will sweep it away.
The righteous will be glad when he sees vengeance; he will bathe his feet in the blood of the wicked.
And people will say, 'Surely there is fruit for the righteous; surely there is a God who judges in the earth.'

psalms_59.t: For the choir director, upon 'Do Not Destroy'. Of David, a miktam. When Saul sent men, and they watched the house to kill him.
Deliver me from my enemies, my God; set me on high, away from those who rise up against me.
Deliver me from the workers of wrongdoing, and save me from men of bloodshed.
For look — they lie in wait for my being; fierce men attack me, not for my transgression and not for my sin, LORD.
Through no iniquity of mine they run and take their positions. Awake to meet me, and see!
And you, LORD God of hosts, God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish all the nations; do not be gracious to any treacherous workers of wrongdoing. Selah
They return at evening; they growl like a dog and go around the city.
Look — they pour out words with their mouth; swords are on their lips, for they say, 'Who is listening?'
But you, LORD, laugh at them; you mock all the nations.
His strength — I will watch for you, for God is my high refuge.
The God of my steadfast love will meet me; God will let me look on my watchers.
Do not kill them, or my people will forget; make them wander by your might and bring them down, our shield, Lord.
The sin of their mouth is the word of their lips; let them be caught in their pride, and for the cursing and lying that they speak.
Make an end of them in wrath, make an end, and let them be no more; and let them know that God rules over Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah
And they return at evening; they growl like a dog and go around the city.
They wander about for food; if they are not satisfied, they stay out all night.
But I will sing of your strength, and in the morning I will sing for joy of your steadfast love; for you have been a high refuge for me, and a place of flight in the day of my distress.
My strength, to you I will make music, for God is my high refuge, the God of my steadfast love.

psalms_60.t: For the choir director, upon 'The Lily of the Testimony'. A miktam of David, to teach. When he struggled with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned and struck down twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
God, you have rejected us, you have broken out against us; you have been angry — restore us!
You have made the land quake, you have split it open; repair its fractures, for it is shaking.
You have made your people see hard things; you have made us drink wine that makes us stagger.
You have given a standard to those who fear you, to be raised because of the bow. Selah
so that your beloved ones may be rescued. Save with your right hand, and answer me.
God has spoken in his sanctuary: 'I will exult; I will divide up Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the stronghold of my head, Judah my commander's staff.
Moab is my washing-pot; over Edom I throw my sandal; over me, Philistia, shout aloud!'
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who has led me as far as Edom?
Have you not rejected us, God? And you do not go out, God, with our armies.
Give us help against the foe, for human salvation is vain.
In God we will act with might, and he will tread down our foes.

psalms_61.t: For the choir director, upon a stringed instrument. Of David.
Hear my cry of entreaty, God; attend to my prayer.
From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart grows faint; lead me to a rock that is higher than I am.
For you have been a refuge for me, a tower of strength against the enemy.
Let me sojourn in your tent forever; let me take refuge in the secret place of your wings. Selah
For you, God, have listened to my vows; you have given the heritage of those who fear your name.
You will add days to the days of the king; let his years be like many generations.
May he sit enthroned forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to preserve him.
So I will make music to your name forever, paying my vows day by day.

psalms_62.t: For the choir director, upon Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
My being is silent toward God alone; from him is my salvation.
He alone is my Rock and my salvation, my high refuge — I shall not be greatly shaken.
How long will you all attack a man? You will be murdered, all of you, like a leaning wall, a fence pushed down.
Surely they plot to thrust him down from his height; they take pleasure in falsehood. With their mouth they bless, and inwardly they curse. Selah
Be silent toward God alone, my being, for from him is my hope.
He alone is my Rock and my salvation, my high refuge — I shall not be shaken.
My salvation and my glory rest upon God; the Rock of my strength, my refuge, is in God.
Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah
Surely the children of humankind are a breath, the children of man a falsehood; placed in the balances, they rise — together they are lighter than a breath.
Do not trust in extortion, and do not put vain hope in robbery; if wealth increases, do not set your heart on it.
One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: that strength belongs to God,
and that to you, Lord, belongs steadfast love; for you repay each man according to his work.

psalms_63.t: A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
God, you are my God; I seek you earnestly. My being thirsts for you; my flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land without water.
So in the sanctuary I have looked upon you, to see your strength and your glory.
For your steadfast love is better than life; my lips will extol you.
So I will bless you as long as I live; in your name I will lift up my hands.
My being will be satisfied as with fat and rich food, and with joyful lips my mouth will praise you.
When I remember you upon my bed, in the night-watches I murmur on you.
For you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I shout for joy.
My being clings to you; your right hand holds me.
But those who seek my being, to ruin it, will go into the lower parts of the earth.
They will hand him over to the power of the sword; they will be the portion of foxes.
And the king will be glad in God; everyone who swears by him will boast, for the mouth of those who speak lies will be shut.

psalms_64.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David.
Hear my voice, God, in my complaint; preserve my life from dread of an enemy.
Hide me from the secret counsel of evildoers, from the tumult of the workers of wrongdoing,
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, who have bent their bow to shoot a bitter word,
to shoot at the blameless from the hiding places; suddenly they shoot at him and are not afraid.
They encourage each other in an evil matter; they talk of hiding traps; they say, 'Who will see them?'
They search out injustices: 'We have perfected a well-plotted plot!' And the inner being of a man, and the heart, is deep.
But God shot an arrow at them; suddenly their wounds came.
And they are made to stumble; their own tongue is against them; all who look on them shake their heads.
And all humankind will fear, and they will declare the work of God, and they will consider what he has done.
Let the righteous be glad in the LORD and take refuge in him, and let all the upright in heart boast.

psalms_65.t: For the choir director. A psalm of David. A song.
To you silence is praise, God, in Zion; and to you a vow will be paid.
You who hear prayer, to you all flesh will come.
Matters of iniquity are too strong for me; our transgressions — you atone for them.
How blessed is the one you choose and bring near to dwell in your courts! Let us be satisfied by the goodness of your house, the holy place of your temple.
With awesome deeds in righteousness you answer us, God of our salvation, the trust of all the ends of the earth and of the distant sea,
who establishes the mountains by his strength, girded with might;
who calms the uproar of the seas, the uproar of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.
And the inhabitants of the farthest ends are in awe of your signs; you make the going out of morning and evening shout for joy.
You have visited the earth and made it overflow; you greatly enrich it — the stream of God is full of water. You prepare their grain, for so you prepare the earth.
Watering its furrows, settling its ridges; with copious showers you soften it; you bless its growth.
You crown the year with your goodness, and your tracks drip fatness.
The pastures of the wilderness drip, and the hills gird themselves with rejoicing.
The meadows are clothed with flocks, and the valleys cover themselves with grain; they shout aloud, they even sing.

psalms_66.t: For the choir director. A song. A psalm.
Shout aloud to God, all the earth!
Make music to the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.
Say to God, 'How awesome are your works! Through the greatness of your strength your enemies cringe before you.'
All the earth will bow down to you and make music to you; they will make music to your name. Selah
Come and see the works of God — awesome in his deeds toward the children of humankind.
He turned the sea into dry ground; they crossed the river on foot. There let us be glad in him,
who rules by his might forever; his eyes keep watch on the nations. Let the rebellious not exalt themselves. Selah
Bless our God, you peoples, and make the sound of his praise heard,
who has kept our being among the living, and has not let our foot slip.
For you have tested us, God; you have refined us as silver is refined.
You brought us into the net; you laid a crushing weight on our hips.
You made men ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water, and you brought us out to abundance.
I will come into your house with burnt offerings; I will pay you my vows,
which my lips uttered and my mouth spoke in my distress.
I will offer up to you burnt offerings of fatlings, with the smoke of rams; I will offer cattle with goats. Selah
Come, listen, and let me recount, all you who fear God, what he has done for my being.
To him I called with my mouth, and high praise was under my tongue.
If I had regarded wrongdoing in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
But God has heard; he has attended to the sound of my prayer.
Blessed be God, who has not turned aside my prayer, or his steadfast love from me.

psalms_67.t: For the choir director, with stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.
May God be gracious to us and bless us; may he make his face shine upon us. Selah
so that your way may be known on the earth, your salvation among all nations.
Let the peoples give thanks to you, God; let all the peoples give thanks to you.
Let the nations be glad and shout for joy, for you judge the peoples with uprightness, and guide the nations on the earth. Selah
Let the peoples give thanks to you, God; let all the peoples give thanks to you.
The earth has given its produce; God, our God, will bless us.
God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear him.

psalms_68.t: For the choir director. Of David. A psalm. A song.
Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, and let those who hate him flee from before him.
As smoke is driven away, drive them away; as wax melts before a fire, let the wicked perish before God.
But the righteous will be glad; they will exult before God, and they will be jubilant with gladness.
Sing to God, make music to his name; build up a highway for the one who rides through the deserts — the LORD is his name — and exult before him.
A father of the fatherless and a judge of widows is God in his holy dwelling.
God settles the solitary in a household; he brings out prisoners into prosperity. Only the rebellious dwell in a parched land.
God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wasteland, Selah
the earth quaked, the heavens also poured down before God — the One of Sinai — before God, the God of Israel.
You spread abroad a generous rain, God; your inheritance was weary, and you established it.
Your community settled in it; in your goodness you provided for the afflicted, God.
The Lord gives the utterance; the women who bear the news are a great host.
'Kings of armies flee, they flee!' And the woman who stays at home divides the plunder.
Though you lie down among the sheepfolds — the wings of a dove covered with silver, her pinions with the green sheen of gold.
When the Almighty scattered kings there, snow fell on Zalmon.
A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
Why do you look with envy, mountains of many peaks, at the mountain God desired for his dwelling? Indeed, the LORD will dwell there in perpetuity.
The chariotry of God is twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands; the Lord is among them — Sinai is in the sanctuary.
You went up to the height, you took captives captive; you received gifts among humankind, and even from the rebellious — that the LORD God might dwell there.
Blessed be the Lord day by day; he bears our burden — the God of our salvation. Selah
The God for us is a God of saving acts, and to GOD the Lord belong the escapes from death.
Surely God will shatter the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of the one who goes on in his guilt.
The Lord said, 'From Bashan I will bring them back; I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
so that you may bathe your foot in blood, and the tongue of your dogs have its portion from the enemies.'
They have seen your processions, God, the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
The singers went in front, the musicians behind, among young women playing tambourines.
In the assemblies bless God, the LORD, you who are from the fountain of Israel.
There is Benjamin, the youngest, leading them, the princes of Judah in their throng, the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
Your God has ordained your strength. Show your strength, God — you who have acted for us!
Because of your temple above Jerusalem, kings will bring you gifts.
Rebuke the beast of the reeds, the herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples, trampling down those who delight in pieces of silver. He has scattered the peoples who delight in wars.
Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will hurry to stretch out its hands to God.
Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; make music to the Lord. Selah
to him who rides in the ancient heaven of heavens. Look — he gives forth his voice, a mighty voice.
Ascribe strength to God! His majesty is over Israel, and his strength is in the skies.
Awesome is God from your sanctuary; the God of Israel — he gives strength and might to the people. Blessed be God!

psalms_69.t: For the choir director, upon 'Lilies'. Of David.
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
I have sunk in deep mire, and there is no foothold; I have come into deep waters, and a flood has swept over me.
I am weary with my calling; my throat is parched; my eyes have failed while I wait for my God.
Those who hate me without cause are more than the hairs of my head; those who would destroy me, my lying enemies, are many. What I did not steal I must then restore.
God, you know my folly, and my guilt is not hidden from you.
Let not those who wait for you be put to shame through me, Lord GOD of hosts; let not those who seek you be humiliated through me, God of Israel.
For on your account I have borne reproach; dishonour has covered my face.
I have become a stranger to my brothers, and a foreigner to my mother's children.
For zeal for your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen upon me.
When I wept for my being with fasting, it became a reproach to me.
I made sackcloth my clothing, and I became a byword to them.
Those who sit in the gate talk about me, and I am the taunt-song of drinkers of strong drink.
But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, at an acceptable time; God, in the abundance of your steadfast love answer me, in the faithfulness of your salvation.
Deliver me from the mud, and let me not sink; let me be delivered from those who hate me and from the deep waters.
Let not the flood of waters sweep over me, or the deep swallow me, or the pit close its mouth over me.
