Answer me, LORD, for your steadfast love is good; according to the abundance of your compassion turn to me.
And do not hide your face from your servant; I am in distress — hurry, answer me.
Draw near to my being, act as its kinsman-redeemer; on account of my enemies redeem me.
You know my reproach and my shame and my disgrace; all my adversaries are before you.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick; I waited for sympathy, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.
And they put poison in my food, and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
Let their table before them become a snare, and a trap for their allies.
Let their eyes grow too dim to see, and make their loins shake continually.
Pour out your indignation on them, and let your burning anger overtake them.
Let their encampment be made desolate; let no one dwell in their tents.
For they have harassed the one you struck, and they tell of the pain of those you have wounded.
Add iniquity to their iniquity, and let them not enter into your righteousness.
Let them be wiped out from the scroll of the living, and not be written down with the righteous.
But I am afflicted and in pain; let your salvation, God, set me on high.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and magnify him with thanksgiving.
And this will please the LORD more than an ox, a young bull with horns and hooves.
The humble have seen it — let them be glad; you who seek God, let your heart live!
For the LORD listens to the needy, and he does not despise his prisoners.
Let the heavens and the earth praise him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah; and they will dwell there and take possession of it.
And the offspring of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell in it.

psalms_70.t: For the choir director. Of David, to bring to remembrance.
God, come to deliver me! LORD, hasten to help me!
Let them be put to shame and abashed, those who seek my being; let them be turned back and humiliated, those who desire my harm.
Let them turn back because of their own shame, those who say, 'Aha! Aha!'
Let all who seek you delight and be glad in you, and let those who love your salvation say continually, 'God is great!'
But I am afflicted and needy — God, hasten to me! You are my help and the one who brings me to safety; LORD, do not delay.

psalms_71.t: In you, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
In your righteousness rescue me and bring me to safety; incline your ear to me and save me.
Be for me a Rock of refuge, to which I may always come; you have given command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
My God, bring me to safety from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the wrongdoer and the ruthless.
For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
Upon you I have leaned from the womb; you were the one who brought me out of my mother's body; my praise is continually of you.
I have become like a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge.
My mouth is filled with your praise, all day long with your splendour.
Do not cast me away in the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
For my enemies speak about me, and those who watch for my being take counsel together,
saying, 'God has forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is no one to deliver.'
God, do not be far from me; my God, hasten to help me.
Let the accusers of my being be put to shame and come to an end; let those who seek my harm be covered with reproach and disgrace.
But I will wait continually, and I will add to all your praise.
My mouth will recount your righteousness, all day long your salvation, though I do not know their number.
I will come with the mighty deeds of the Lord GOD; I will bring to remembrance your righteousness, yours alone.
God, you have taught me from my youth, and until now I declare your wonders.
And even to old age and grey hair, God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to a generation, your might to all who are to come.
And your righteousness, God, reaches to the height — you who have done great things. God, who is like you?
You who have made us see many distresses and calamities will return and preserve us alive, and from the depths of the earth you will return and bring me up.
Increase my greatness, and turn and comfort me.
I also will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God; I will make music to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
My lips will shout for joy when I make music to you, and so will my being, which you have redeemed.
My tongue also will murmur your righteousness all day long, for they are put to shame, they are abashed, those who seek my harm.

psalms_72.t: Of Solomon.
God, give your judgements to the king, and your righteousness to the king's son.
May he judge your people with righteousness, and your afflicted ones with justice.
Let the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills, in righteousness.
May he judge the afflicted of the people, save the children of the needy, and crush the oppressor.
May they fear you as long as the sun endures, and before the moon, through all generations.
May he come down like rain on mown grass, like copious showers that water the earth.
In his days let the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace till the moon is no more.
And may he rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
Before him let the desert-dwellers bow down, and let his enemies lick the dust.
May the kings of Tarshish and the islands bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba bring a gift.
And let all kings bow down to him; let all nations serve him.
For he will deliver the needy who cries for help, and the afflicted who has no helper.
He will have compassion on the poor and the needy, and the lives of the needy he will save.
From oppression and from violence he will redeem their being, and their blood will be precious in his eyes.
And may he live, and may gold of Sheba be given to him; and may prayer be made for him continually; all day long may he be blessed.
Let there be an abundance of grain in the land, on the tops of the mountains; let its fruit wave like Lebanon, and let people blossom from the city like the vegetation of the earth.
May his name endure forever; before the sun may his name increase, and may they bless themselves by him; may all nations call him blessed.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonders.
And blessed be his glorious name forever, and let his glory fill all the earth. Amen and amen.
The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are ended.

psalms_73.t: A psalm of Asaph.
Surely God is good to Israel, to those pure in heart.
But as for me, my feet had almost turned aside; my steps had all but been poured out.
For I was envious of the boastful; I kept seeing the well-being of the wicked.
For they have no pangs in their dying, and their belly is fat.
They are not in the trouble of ordinary people, and they are not stricken along with humankind.
So pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
Their eyes bulge out of fatness; the imaginings of their heart overflow.
They scoff and speak with malice; from on high they speak oppression.
They set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walks about on the earth.
So his people turn back here, and abundant waters are drained by them.
And they say, 'How would God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?'
Look at them — these are the wicked; always at ease, they increase their wealth.
Surely it was for nothing that I kept my heart pure and washed my hands in innocence.
And I have been stricken all day long, and my rebuke has come every morning.
If I had said, 'I will talk like this,' I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
When I thought about how to understand this, it was trouble in my eyes.
until I went into the sanctuaries of God; then I understood their end.
Surely you set them on slippery ground; you make them fall into ruin.
How they have become a desolation in a moment! They come to an end, they are finished off by terrors.
Like a dream when one awakes, Lord, when you rouse yourself you will despise their image.
When my heart was soured and I was pierced in my kidneys,
then I was brutish, and I did not know; I was a beast with you.
Yet I am always with you; you have taken hold of my right hand.
You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will receive me to glory.
Whom do I have in the heavens? And beside you I desire nothing on earth.
My flesh and my heart have come to an end, but God is the Rock of my heart and my portion for ever.
For look, those far from you will perish; you destroy everyone who whores away from you.
But as for me, the nearness of God is my good; I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, to recount all your works.

psalms_74.t: A maskil of Asaph.
Why, God, have you cast us off for ever? Why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?
Remember your congregation, which you acquired long ago, which you redeemed as the tribe of your inheritance, Mount Zion, where you have dwelt.
Lift up your steps to the everlasting ruins — all the harm the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
Your foes have roared in the midst of your meeting place; they set up their own signs as signs.
It became known, like someone bringing axes upward into a thicket of trees.
And now they smash all its carved work with axe and hatchets.
They have set fire to your sanctuary; they have profaned the dwelling place of your name to the ground.
They said in their heart, 'Let us crush them all together.' They burned all the meeting places of God in the land.
We do not see our signs; there is no prophet any more, and no one with us knows how long.
How long, God, will the foe taunt? Will the enemy spurn your name for ever?
Why do you draw back your hand, your right hand? From within your bosom — destroy!
Yet God is my king from of old, working acts of salvation in the midst of the earth.
You divided the sea by your strength; you shattered the heads of the sea creatures on the waters.
You crushed the heads of Leviathan; you gave him as food to a people, to desert-dwellers.
You split open spring and torrent; you dried up ever-flowing rivers.
Yours is the day, yours also the night; you established the light and the sun.
You set up all the boundaries of the earth; summer and winter — you formed them.
Remember this: an enemy has taunted, LORD, and a foolish people have spurned your name.
Do not give the being of your turtledove to the beast; do not forget the life of your poor for ever.
Look to the covenant, for the dark places of the land are full of dwellings of violence.
Do not let the crushed turn back humiliated; let the poor and needy praise your name.
Arise, God, plead your own case; remember how a fool reproaches you all day long.
Do not forget the voice of your foes, the uproar of those who rise against you, which goes up continually.

psalms_75.t: For the choir director. 'Do Not Destroy'. A psalm of Asaph. A song.
We give thanks to you, God, we give thanks; your name is near, and people recount your wonders.
'When I take the appointed time, I myself will judge with equity.'
'The earth and all who live in it are melting away; I myself set its pillars firm. Selah.'
I said to the boastful, 'Do not boast,' and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horn;
do not lift your horn on high; do not speak with an arrogant neck.'
For not from the sunrise, nor from the sunset, and not from the wilderness, does lifting up come.
For God is the judge: he brings one low and lifts another up.
For there is a cup in the hand of the LORD, and the wine foams, full of mixed spices, and he pours from it; surely all the wicked of the earth will drain its dregs and drink them.
But I will declare it for ever; I will make music to the God of Jacob.
'And I will cut off all the horns of the wicked; the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.'

psalms_76.t: For the choir director. With stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song.
God is known in Judah; in Israel his name is great.
His lair came to be in Salem, his den in Zion.
There he shattered the flames of the bow, shield and sword and battle. Selah.
You are radiant, more majestic than the mountains of prey.
The stout-hearted were plundered; they slept their sleep, and not one of the warriors could find his hands.
At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse lay stunned in sleep.
You — you are to be feared; and who can stand before you once your anger has come?
From the heavens you made your verdict heard; the earth was afraid and fell still.
when God rose up for judgement, to save all the humble of the earth. Selah.
For the wrath of humankind gives you thanks; the remainder of wrath you gird on yourself.
Make vows and pay them to the LORD your God; let all who are round about him bring tribute to the one to be feared.
He cuts off the spirit of rulers; he is to be feared by the kings of the earth.

psalms_77.t: For the choir director. According to Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A psalm.
My voice goes up to God, and I cry out; my voice goes up to God, and he gives ear to me.
In the day of my distress I sought the Lord; at night my hand was stretched out and did not go numb; my being refused to be comforted.
I remember God and I murmur; I complain, and my spirit grows faint. Selah.
You held my eyelids open; I was too troubled to speak.
I thought about the days of old, the years of long ago.
I remember my song in the night; I complain within my heart, and my spirit searches.
Will the Lord reject for ever, and never show favour again?
Has his steadfast love come to an end for ever? Has his utterance ceased for all generations?
Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he shut off his compassion in anger? Selah.
And I said, 'This is my grief: that the right hand of the Most High has changed.'
I will remember the deeds of the LORD; yes, I will remember your wonder from of old.
And I will meditate on all your work, and muse on your deeds.
God, your way is in holiness. Who is a great god like God?
You are the God who does wonder; you have made your strength known among the peoples.
You redeemed your people with an arm, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
The waters saw you, God; the waters saw you and writhed; the deeps also trembled.
The clouds poured out water; the skies gave forth their sound; your arrows also flew about.
The sound of your thunder was in the whirlwind; lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.
Your way was through the sea, your path through many waters, and your footprints were not known.
You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

psalms_78.t: A maskil of Asaph.
Give ear, my people, to my law; incline your ear to the sayings of my mouth.
I will open my mouth in a parable; I will pour out riddles from of old.
things we have heard and known, which our fathers recounted to us.
We will not hide them from their children, but will recount to a later generation the praises of the LORD and his might, and the wonders that he has done.
He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers to make known to their children,
so that a later generation might know them — children yet to be born — and would rise up and recount them to their children,
so that they would put their confidence in God, and not forget the deeds of God, but would observe his commandments;
and would not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that did not set its heart firm, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
The sons of Ephraim, armed and shooting the bow, turned back on the day of battle.
They did not keep the covenant of God, and they refused to walk in his law.
They forgot his deeds and the wonders he had shown them.
Before their fathers he did wonder in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
He split open the sea and brought them through, and made the waters stand like a heap.
He guided them with the cloud by day, and all night by the light of a fire.
He split open rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink in abundance, as from the deeps.
He brought out streams from a rock and made water run down like rivers.
But they went on sinning against him, rebelling against the Most High in the parched land.
They tested God in their heart by asking food for their appetite.
They spoke against God; they said, 'Is God able to set a table in the wilderness?'
'Look — he struck a rock and water flowed out, and torrents overflowed. Can he give bread as well? Or will he provide meat for his people?'
Therefore the LORD heard and was furious, and fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also rose against Israel,
because they did not believe in God and did not trust in his salvation.
Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of the heavens,
and rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them the grain of the heavens.
Each ate the bread of the mighty; he sent them provision in plenty.
He led out an east wind in the heavens and drove a south wind out by his strength.
He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the seas.
He made them fall in the middle of his camp, all around his dwelling places.
They ate and were fully satisfied, for he brought them what they craved.
They had not turned away from their craving; their food was still in their mouths
when the anger of God rose against them; he killed their strongest, and made the young men of Israel bow down.
In spite of all this they went on sinning, and did not believe in his wonders.
So he brought their days to an end in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
Whenever he killed them, they sought him; they turned back and searched earnestly for God.
They remembered that God was their Rock, and God Most High their redeemer.
But they deceived him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
Their heart was not steadfast with him, and they were not faithful to his covenant.
Yet he was compassionate; he made atonement for iniquity and did not destroy them. Many times he turned his anger back and did not stir up all his rage.
He remembered that they were flesh, a wind that goes and does not return.
How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the wasteland!
Again and again they tested God and pained the Holy One of Israel.
They did not remember his hand, the day he ransomed them from the foe,
when he performed his signs in Egypt and his wonders in the region of Zoan,
He turned their canals to blood, so that they could not drink from their streams.
He sent the swarm among them, and it devoured them, and frogs, and they ruined them.
He gave their produce to the shearer-locust, and what their labour won to the swarming locust.
He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamore-figs with frost.
He delivered their cattle to the hail, and their livestock to the flames.
He sent against them his burning anger, fury and indignation and trouble, a deputation of angels of calamity.
He levelled a path for his anger; he did not keep them back from death but delivered their life to the pestilence.
He struck down every firstborn in Egypt, the first of their vigour in the tents of Ham.
He led his people out like sheep and drove them like a flock in the wilderness.
He guided them in safety, and they were not afraid, and the sea covered their enemies.
He brought them to the territory of his holiness, to this mountain that his right hand had acquired.
He drove out nations before them, allotted them their inheritance by measuring-line, and settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
But they tested and rebelled against God Most High, and did not keep his testimonies.
They turned back and acted treacherously like their fathers; they twisted like a treacherous bow.
They provoked him to anger with their high places and made him jealous with their carved images.
God heard and was furious, and utterly rejected Israel.
He abandoned the dwelling place at Shiloh, the tent he had pitched among humankind.
He gave his strength over to captivity, and his splendour into the hand of the foe.
He delivered his people to the sword, and was furious with his inheritance.
Fire consumed their young men, and their virgins were not praised.
Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows did not weep.
Then the Lord awoke like a sleeper, like a warrior overcome by wine.
He struck his foes back and gave them an everlasting reproach.
He rejected the tent of Joseph and did not choose the tribe of Ephraim.
He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.
He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he founded for ever.
He chose David his servant and took him from the sheepfolds.
He brought him from following the nursing ewes to shepherd Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
He shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with the skill of his hands.

psalms_79.t: God, the nations have come into your inheritance; they have made the temple of your holiness unclean; they have reduced Jerusalem to heaps of ruins.
They have given the corpses of your servants as food to the birds of the heavens, the flesh of your loyal ones to the beasts of the earth.
They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
We have become a reproach to our neighbours, mockery and derision to those around us.
How long, LORD? Will you be angry for ever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Pour out your rage on the nations that do not know you, and on the kingdoms that do not call on your name.
For they have consumed Jacob and devastated his habitation.
Do not remember against us the iniquities of former generations; let your compassion come quickly to meet us, for we have been brought very low.
Help us, God of our salvation, for the sake of the glory of your name; deliver us and make atonement for our sins, for your name's sake.
Why should the nations say, 'Where is their God?' Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that you avenge the poured-out blood of your servants.
Let the groaning of the prisoner come before you; according to the greatness of your arm, leave alive those appointed to death.
Return to our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom the reproach with which they reproached you, Lord.
And we, your people, the sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks for ever; to all generations we will recount your praise.

psalms_80.t: For the choir director. To 'Lilies, Testimony'. Of Asaph. A psalm.
Shepherd of Israel, give ear, you who lead Joseph like a flock; you who sit enthroned on the cherubim, shine out.
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might, and come to save us.
God, restore us; make your face shine, and let us be saved.
LORD, God of hosts, how long will you smoke at the prayer of your people?
You have fed them the bread of tears and made them drink tears by the measureful.
You make us an object of contention to our neighbours, and our enemies mock us among themselves.
God of hosts, restore us; make your face shine, and let us be saved.
You uprooted a vine from Egypt; you drove out nations and planted it.
You cleared the ground before it; it took root and filled the land.
The mountains were covered by its shade, and its boughs were the cedars of God.
It sent out its branches to the sea, and its shoots to the River.
Why have you broken down its walls, so that everyone who passes along the road plucks its fruit?
A boar from the forest gnaws at it, and what moves in the field grazes on it.
God of hosts, turn back, please; look down from the heavens and see; attend to this vine,
and the stock your right hand planted, and the son you made strong for yourself.
It is burned with fire, cut down; at the rebuke of your face they perish.
Let your hand be on the man at your right hand, on the son of humankind you made strong for yourself.
Then we will not turn back from you; give us life, and we will call on your name.
LORD, God of hosts, restore us; make your face shine, and let us be saved.

psalms_81.t: For the choir director. According to the Gittith. Of Asaph.
Shout for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob.
Raise a song and sound the tambourine, the sweet lyre with the harp.
Blow the ram's horn at the new moon, at the full moon, for the day of our festival.
For it is a statute for Israel, a judgement of the God of Jacob.
He established it as a testimony in Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt. I heard a language I did not know:
'I removed his shoulder from the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
In distress you called, and I rescued you; I answered you from the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
'Listen, my people, and let me warn you; Israel, if only you would listen to me!
'There shall be no strange god among you; you shall not bow down to a foreign god.
'I am the LORD your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
'But my people did not listen to my voice, and Israel would not yield to me.
'So I gave them over to the stubbornness of their heart; they walked in their own schemes.
'If only my people would listen to me, if Israel would walk in my ways!
'In a moment I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes.
'Those who hate the LORD would cringe before him, and their fate would last for ever.
'And he would feed them with the finest of the wheat; and from a rock I would satisfy you with honey.'

psalms_82.t: God takes his stand in the divine congregation; in the midst of the gods he judges.
How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah.
Give judgement for the poor and the fatherless; vindicate the afflicted and the destitute.
Rescue the poor and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
They do not know and they do not understand; they walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
I myself said, 'You are gods, and sons of the Most High, all of you.'
Nevertheless you will die like humankind, and fall like one of the princes.
Arise, God, judge the earth, for you yourself will inherit all the nations.

psalms_83.t: A song. A psalm of Asaph.
God, do not keep silence; do not be deaf, and do not be still, God.
For look, your enemies are in an uproar, and those who hate you have lifted their heads.
Against your people they lay crafty plans, and consult together against those you treasure.
They have said, 'Come, let us wipe them out as a nation, so that the name of Israel is remembered no more.'
For they have taken counsel with one heart together; against you they are making a covenant.
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre.
Assyria too has joined them; they have become an arm for the sons of Lot. Selah.
Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin at the wadi of Kishon,
who were destroyed at En-dor, who became dung for the ground.
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
who said, 'Let us take possession for ourselves of the pastures of God.'
My God, make them like whirling dust, like chaff before the wind.
As fire burns a forest, and as a flame sets mountains ablaze,
so pursue them with your storm, and terrify them with your storm-wind.
Fill their faces with shame, so that they may seek your name, LORD.
Let them be ashamed and dismayed for ever; let them be abashed and perish,
and let them know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

psalms_84.t: For the choir director. According to the Gittith. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
How lovely are your dwelling places, LORD of hosts!
My being has longed, and been spent with longing, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh shout for joy to the living God.
Even the bird has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she has laid her young — your altars, LORD of hosts, my king and my God.
How blessed are those who dwell in your house! They go on praising you. Selah.
How blessed is the person whose strength is in you, in whose heart are the highways.
Passing through the valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; the early rain also covers it with blessings.
They go from strength to strength; each one appears before God in Zion.
LORD, God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Selah.
Look on our shield, God, and attend to the face of your anointed.
For one day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God than dwell in the tents of wickedness.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives favour and glory. He does not withhold good from those who walk in blamelessness.
LORD of hosts, how blessed is anyone who trusts in you!

psalms_85.t: For the choir director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
You showed favour to your land, LORD; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.
You lifted away the iniquity of your people; you covered all their sin. Selah.
You withdrew all your fury; you turned back from your burning anger.
Restore us, God of our salvation, and put an end to your vexation with us.
Will you be angry with us for ever? Will you prolong your anger to all generations?
Will you not turn back and give us life, so that your people may rejoice in you?
Show us your steadfast love, LORD, and give us your salvation.
Let me hear what God the LORD will speak; for he will speak peace to his people and to his loyal ones — but let them not turn back to folly.
Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
Steadfast love and faithfulness have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
Faithfulness springs up from the earth, and righteousness looks down from the heavens.
The LORD also will give what is good, and our land will give its produce.
Righteousness will go before him and will make his footsteps a way.

psalms_86.t: Incline your ear, LORD; answer me, for I am poor and needy.
Keep my being, for I am loyal; save your servant, who trusts in you — you are my God.
Be gracious to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
Make glad the being of your servant, for to you, Lord, I lift up my being.
For you, Lord, are good and ready to forgive, abounding in steadfast love to all who call on you.
Give ear, LORD, to my prayer, and attend to the sound of my supplications.
In the day of my distress I call on you, for you will answer me.
There is none like you among the gods, Lord, and there are no works like yours.
All the nations you have made will come and bow down before you, Lord, and will glorify your name.
For you are great and you do wonders; you are God, you alone.
Teach me your way, LORD; I will walk in your truth. Unite my heart to fear your name.
I will give you thanks, Lord my God, with all my heart, and glorify your name for ever.
For your steadfast love toward me is great, and you have delivered my being from the depths of Sheol.
God, the arrogant have risen against me, and a band of the ruthless have sought my life; they have not set you before them.
But you, Lord, are a God compassionate and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.
Turn to me and be gracious to me; give your strength to your servant, and save the son of your maidservant.
Work a sign for me, for good, so that those who hate me may see and be ashamed, because you, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

psalms_87.t: Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song.
He has founded his city on the mountains of holiness.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken of you, city of God. Selah.
I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon among those who know me. Look — Philistia and Tyre, with Cush: 'This one was born there.'
And of Zion it will be said, 'This one and that one were born in her'; and he himself, the Most High, will establish her.
The LORD will count, when he records the peoples: 'This one was born there.' Selah.
And singers, and dancers alike: 'All my springs are in you.'

psalms_88.t: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choir director. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
LORD, God of my salvation, by day I have cried out, and in the night, before you.
Let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry of entreaty.
For my being has had its fill of troubles, and my life has reached Sheol.
I am reckoned among those going down to the pit; I have become like a man with no strength,
set loose among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, and who are cut off from your hand.
You have put me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in the depths.
Your rage has lain heavy on me, and you have afflicted me with all your breakers. Selah.
You have removed my acquaintances far from me; you have made me an abomination to them; I am shut in and cannot go out.
My eye grows faint from affliction. I have called on you, LORD, every day; I have spread out my hands to you.
Will you do wonder for the dead? Will the shades rise and give you thanks? Selah.
Will your steadfast love be recounted in the grave, your constancy in Abaddon?
Will your wonder be known in the darkness, and your righteousness in the land of forgetting?
But I cry to you for help, LORD, and in the morning my prayer comes to meet you.
Why, LORD, do you reject my being? Why do you hide your face from me?
I have been afflicted, and near death from my youth; I have borne your terrors; I am helpless.
Your burning angers have passed over me; your terrors have destroyed me.
They surround me like water all day long; they close in on me all together.
You have removed far from me the one who loves me, and my friend; my acquaintances are darkness.

psalms_89.t: A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
I will sing of the LORD's acts of steadfast love for ever; to all generations I will make known your constancy with my mouth.
For I have said, 'Steadfast love is built for ever; in the heavens you establish your constancy.'
'I have made a covenant with my chosen one; I have sworn to David my servant:
'For ever I will establish your offspring, and build your throne to all generations.' Selah.
The heavens give thanks for your wonder, LORD, and your constancy too, in the assembly of the holy ones.
For who in the skies can be ranked with the LORD? Who is like the LORD among the sons of gods?
God is greatly to be dreaded in the council of the holy ones, and to be feared above all those around him.
LORD, God of hosts, who is like you? Mighty is the LORD, and your constancy surrounds you.
You rule over the surging of the sea; when its waves rise, you still them.
You crushed Rahab like one slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.
Yours are the heavens, yours also the earth; the world and all that fills it — you founded them.
North and south — you created them; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at your name.
Yours is an arm with might; your hand is strong, your right hand is lifted high.
Righteousness and judgement are the foundation of your throne; steadfast love and faithfulness go before you.
How blessed is the people who know the shout! LORD, they walk in the light of your face.
In your name they rejoice all day long, and in your righteousness they are lifted high.
For you are the splendour of their strength, and by your favour our horn is lifted high.
For our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
Then you spoke in a vision to your loyal ones and said: 'I have laid help on a warrior; I have raised up a chosen one from the people.
'I have found David my servant; with my holy oil I have anointed him,
'my hand will be steadfast with him; my arm also will strengthen him.
'No enemy will exact tribute from him, and no son of injustice will afflict him.
'I will crush his foes before him, and strike down those who hate him.
'My constancy and my steadfast love will be with him, and in my name his horn will be lifted high.
'I will set his hand on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
'He will call to me, "You are my father, my God and the Rock of my salvation."
'I also will make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
'For ever I will keep my steadfast love for him, and my covenant with him will hold.
'I will set his offspring for ever, and his throne like the days of the heavens.
'If his sons forsake my law and do not walk in my judgements,
'if they violate my statutes and do not keep my commandments,
'then I will punish their transgression with a rod, and their iniquity with plagues.
'But I will not break off my steadfast love from him, and I will not be false to my constancy.
'I will not violate my covenant, nor change what has gone out from my lips.
'Once and for all I have sworn by my holiness: I will not lie to David.
'His offspring will endure for ever, and his throne like the sun before me.
'Like the moon it will be established for ever, and the witness in the skies is faithful.' Selah.
But you have spurned and rejected; you have been furious with your anointed.
You have repudiated the covenant with your servant; you have profaned his crown to the ground.
You have broken through all his walls; you have made his strongholds a ruin.
All who pass along the road have plundered him; he has become a reproach to his neighbours.
You have lifted high the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
You also turn back the edge of his sword, and you have not raised him up in the battle.
You have made his lustre cease, and thrown his throne to the ground.
You have shortened the days of his youth; you have wrapped him in shame. Selah.
How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself for ever? Will your rage burn like fire?
Remember how short my lifespan is! For what emptiness you have created all the children of humankind!
Who is the man who will live and not see death, who will deliver his own being from the hand of Sheol? Selah.
Where are your former acts of steadfast love, Lord, which you swore to David in your constancy?
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants — how I bear in my bosom the insults of all the many peoples,
with which your enemies have reproached you, LORD, with which they have reproached the footsteps of your anointed.
Blessed be the LORD for ever. Amen and amen.

psalms_90.t: A prayer of Moses, the man of God.
Lord, you have been our dwelling in every generation.
Before the mountains were born, before you brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.
You return humankind to dust, and you say, 'Return, children of humankind.'
For a thousand years in your eyes are like yesterday when it passes, like a watch in the night.
You sweep them away in a flood; they are a sleep; in the morning they are like grass that sprouts up.
In the morning it flourishes and sprouts up; by evening it withers and dries up.
For we come to an end in your anger, and by your rage we are terrified.
You have set our iniquities before you, our hidden sins in the light of your face.
For all our days pass away in your fury; we finish our years like a sigh.
The days of our years are seventy years, or by strength, eighty years; yet their pride is toil and trouble, for it passes quickly and we fly away.
Who knows the strength of your anger, or your fury, as the fear of you deserves?
Teach us to count our days, that we may bring a heart of wisdom.
Turn back, LORD — how long? — and have compassion on your servants.
Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, that we may shout for joy and rejoice all our days.
Make us rejoice as many days as you afflicted us, as many years as we saw trouble.
Let your work appear to your servants, and your majesty to their children.
And let the kindness of the Lord our God be upon us; establish for us the work of our hands — yes, establish the work of our hands.

psalms_91.t: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will lodge in the shadow of the Almighty.
I say of the LORD, 'My refuge and my stronghold, my God, in whom I trust.'
For he will deliver you from the fowler's snare, from the deadly plague.
With his pinion he will cover you, and under his wings you will take refuge; his faithfulness is a shield and a wall.
You will not be afraid of the terror of the night, of the arrow that flies by day,
of the plague that walks in the darkness, of the destruction that lays waste at noon.
A thousand will fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
You will only look with your own eyes and see the retribution of the wicked.
Because you have made the LORD — my refuge — the Most High, your dwelling,
no harm will befall you, and no plague will come near your tent.
For he will command his angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.
On their hands they will lift you up, so that you do not strike your foot against a stone.
You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the young lion and the serpent.
'Because he has clung to me, I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he knows my name.
'He will call me and I will answer him; I will be with him in distress; I will rescue him and honour him.
'With length of days I will satisfy him, and I will show him my salvation.'

psalms_92.t: A psalm. A song for the day of the sabbath.
It is good to give thanks to the LORD, and to make music to your name, Most High,
to declare your steadfast love in the morning, and your constancy in the nights,
on the ten-stringed instrument and on the harp, to a melody on the lyre.
For you have made me rejoice, LORD, by your deed; at the works of your hands I shout for joy.
How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
A brutish man does not know, and a fool does not understand this:
when the wicked flourish like vegetation and all who do wickedness blossom, it is so that they may be destroyed for ever.
But you are on high for ever, LORD.
For look, your enemies, LORD — for look, your enemies will perish; all who do wickedness will be scattered.
But you have raised my horn like a wild ox's; I have been anointed with fresh oil.
My eye has looked on those who watch me; my ears have heard of the evildoers who rise against me.
The righteous will flourish like the palm; like a cedar in Lebanon they will grow tall.
Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
They will still bear fruit in old age; they will be full of sap and fresh,
to declare that the LORD is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no injustice in him.

psalms_93.t: The LORD reigns; he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed, he has girded himself with strength. The world also is established; it will not be shaken.
Your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting.
The rivers have lifted up, LORD, the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their pounding.
Above the sounds of many waters, majestic are the breakers of the sea — majestic on high is the LORD.
Your testimonies are entirely reliable; holiness befits your house, LORD, for length of days.

psalms_94.t: God of vengeance, LORD, God of vengeance, shine out!
Raise yourself up, judge of the earth; repay the proud what they deserve.
How long will the wicked, LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
They pour out words, they speak arrogance; all who do wickedness boast.
They crush your people, LORD, and afflict your inheritance.
They kill the widow and the sojourner, and they murder the fatherless.
And they say, 'The LORD does not see, and the God of Jacob does not perceive.'
Understand, you brutish ones among the people; and you fools, when will you have insight?
He who planted the ear — does he not hear? He who formed the eye — does he not see?
He who disciplines nations — does he not rebuke, he who teaches humankind knowledge?
The LORD knows the thoughts of humankind, that they are a breath.
How blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and whom you teach from your law,
giving him quiet from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
For the LORD will not abandon his people, and he will not forsake his inheritance.
For judgement will return to righteousness, and after it all the upright in heart.
Who will rise up for me against evildoers? Who will take a stand for me against those who do wickedness?
If the LORD had not been my help, my being would soon have dwelt in silence.
When I said, 'My foot has slipped,' your steadfast love, LORD, supported me.
When my disquieting thoughts were many within me, your consolations delighted my being.
Can a throne of destruction be allied with you, one that fashions mischief by statute?
They band together against the life of the righteous and condemn innocent blood.
But the LORD has become my stronghold, and my God the Rock of my shelter.
He has brought their wickedness back on them and will destroy them in their own evil; the LORD our God will destroy them.

psalms_95.t: Come, let us shout for joy to the LORD; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
Let us come before him with thanksgiving; let us shout aloud to him with songs.
For the LORD is a great God, and a great king above all gods.
In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the peaks of the mountains are his.
The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry ground.
Come, let us bow down and kneel; let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, the flock of his hand. Today, if only you would listen to his voice —
'Do not harden your heart as at Meribah, as on the day of Massah in the wilderness,
'where your fathers put me to the test, they tested me, though they had seen my work.
'For forty years I loathed a generation, and I said, "They are a people whose heart goes astray, and they have not known my ways."
'so I swore in my anger: They shall not enter my resting place.'

psalms_96.t: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD, bless his name; proclaim his salvation from day to day.
Recount his glory among the nations, his wonders among all the peoples.
For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; he is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
Splendour and majesty are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
Ascribe to the LORD, clans of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.
Bow down to the LORD in the adornment of holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.
Say among the nations, 'The LORD reigns. The world also is established; it will not be shaken. He will judge the peoples with equity.'
Let the heavens rejoice and the earth be glad; let the sea thunder, and all that fills it.
Let the field exult, and all that is in it; then all the trees of the forest will shout for joy
before the LORD, for he is coming — for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in his constancy.

psalms_97.t: The LORD reigns; let the earth be glad; let the many islands rejoice.
Cloud and thick darkness are around him; righteousness and judgement are the foundation of his throne.
Fire goes before him and burns up his foes all around.
His lightning lit up the world; the earth saw and trembled.
The mountains melted like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
The heavens declared his righteousness, and all the peoples saw his glory.
Let all who serve a carved image be ashamed, those who glory in worthless idols. Bow down to him, all gods!
Zion heard and rejoiced, and the daughters of Judah were glad, because of your judgements, LORD.
For you, LORD, are Most High over all the earth; you are greatly exalted above all gods.
You who love the LORD, hate evil! He guards the lives of his loyal ones; from the hand of the wicked he delivers them.
Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous, and give thanks to his holy remembrance.

psalms_98.t: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done wonders. His right hand has won him the victory, and his holy arm.
The LORD has made known his salvation; before the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness.
He has remembered his steadfast love and his constancy toward the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Shout aloud to the LORD, all the earth; break forth, shout for joy, and make music.
Make music to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of song.
With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn, shout aloud before the king, the LORD.
Let the sea thunder, and all that fills it, the world and those who dwell in it.
Let the rivers clap their hands; let the mountains shout for joy together
before the LORD, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

psalms_99.t: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned on the cherubim; let the earth quake.
The LORD is great in Zion, and he is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them give thanks to your name — great and to be feared. Holy is he.
The king in his strength loves judgement. You have established equity; judgement and righteousness in Jacob — you have done them.
Exalt the LORD our God, and bow down at his footstool. Holy is he.
Moses and Aaron were among his priests, and Samuel among those who call on his name; they called to the LORD, and he would answer them.
In a pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and the statute he gave them.
LORD our God, you answered them; a God who lifted away their guilt you were to them, yet one who avenged their deeds.
Exalt the LORD our God, and bow down at his holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.

psalms_100.t: Shout aloud to the LORD, all the earth.
Serve the LORD with joy; come before him with a shout of joy.
Know that the LORD — he is God. He made us, and we are his, his people and the flock of his pasture.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise; give thanks to him, bless his name.
For the LORD is good; his steadfast love is for ever, and his constancy to all generations.

psalms_101.t: Of steadfast love and judgement I will sing; to you, LORD, I will make music.
I will give attention to a blameless way. When will you come to me? I will walk in the integrity of my heart within my house.
I will not set before my eyes anything worthless. I hate the doing of crooked deeds; it will not cling to me.
A perverse heart will turn away from me; I will have nothing to do with evil.
Whoever slanders his neighbour in secret, him I will destroy. The haughty of eye and the proud of heart, him I cannot bear.
My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; whoever walks in a blameless way, he will serve me.
No one who practises deceit will dwell within my house; no one who speaks lies will be established before my eyes.
Every morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land, cutting off from the city of the LORD all who do wickedness.

psalms_102.t: A prayer of an afflicted person, when he grows faint and pours out his complaint before the LORD.
LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry for help come to you.
Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress; incline your ear to me; in the day I call, answer me quickly.
For my days have vanished in smoke, and my bones are burned like a hearth.
My heart has been struck like grass and has withered, for I forget to eat my food.
From the sound of my groaning my bones cling to my flesh.
I am like a desert owl of the wilderness; I have become like an owl of the ruins.
I lie awake, and I have become like a bird alone on a roof.
All day long my enemies have taunted me; those who mock me have used my name as a curse.
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with weeping,
because of your indignation and your wrath; for you picked me up and threw me away.
My days are like a lengthening shadow, and I wither like grass.
But you, LORD, are enthroned for ever, and your remembrance to all generations.
You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is the time to show her favour; the appointed time has come.
For your servants take pleasure in her stones and show favour to her dust.
Then the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth your glory,
for the LORD has built Zion; he has appeared in his glory.
He has turned to the prayer of the destitute and has not despised their prayer.
Let this be written for a later generation, and a people yet to be created will praise the LORD.
For he has looked down from his holy height; the LORD has looked from the heavens to the earth,
to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to set free those appointed to death,
to recount in Zion the name of the LORD, and his praise in Jerusalem,
when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
He has broken my strength on the way; he has cut short my days.
I said, 'My God, do not take me away in the middle of my days — your years run through all generations.'
Long ago you founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
They will perish, but you will endure; all of them will wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them, and they will pass away.
But you are the same, and your years will not come to an end.
The children of your servants will dwell secure, and their offspring will be established before you.

psalms_103.t: Of David.
Bless the LORD, my being, and all that is within me, his holy name.
Bless the LORD, my being, and do not forget all his benefits —
who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from the pit, who crowns you with steadfast love and compassion,
who satisfies you with good, so that your youth renews itself like the eagle's.
The LORD does acts of righteousness and judgements for all who are oppressed.
He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the Israelites.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
He will not contend for ever, and will not keep his anger for all time.
He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities.
For as the heavens are high above the earth, so strong is his steadfast love over those who fear him.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
For he knows how we are formed; he remembers that we are dust.
As for humankind, his days are like grass; like the flower of the field, so he flourishes.
For the wind passes over it and it is gone, and its place knows it no more.
But the steadfast love of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear him, and his righteousness to children's children,
to those who keep his covenant and remember his precepts, to do them.
The LORD has established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom rules over all.
Bless the LORD, you his angels, mighty in strength, who do his word, listening to the sound of his word.
Bless the LORD, all his hosts, his servants who do his will.
Bless the LORD, all his works, in all the places of his dominion. Bless the LORD, my being.

psalms_104.t: Bless the LORD, my being. LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendour and majesty,
wrapping yourself in light like a garment, stretching out the heavens like a curtain,
who lays the beams of his upper rooms on the waters, who makes the clouds his chariot, who walks on the wings of the wind,
who makes winds his messengers, a flaming fire his servants.
He founded the earth on its foundations; it will not be shaken for ever and ever.
You covered it with the deep like clothing; the waters stood above the mountains.
At your rebuke they fled; at the sound of your thunder they hurried away.
The mountains rose, the valleys sank, to the place you established for them.
You set a boundary they will not pass; they will not return to cover the earth.
He sends forth springs into the wadis; they run between the mountains.
They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; from among the foliage they give voice.
He waters the mountains from his upper rooms; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your works.
causing grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for humankind to cultivate, to bring forth food from the earth,
and wine that gladdens the heart of humanity, oil to make the face shine, and bread that sustains the heart of humanity.
The trees of the LORD are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted,
where the birds make their nests; as for the stork, the fir trees are her home.
The high mountains belong to the mountain goats; the rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its setting.
You make darkness, and it becomes night; in it every beast of the forest moves about.
The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
The sun rises; they withdraw and lie down in their dens.
Humankind goes out to his work, and to his labour until evening.
How many are your works, LORD! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
There is the sea, great and wide on every side, with creeping things beyond number, living creatures small and great.
There the ships go about, and Leviathan, whom you formed to play in it.
All of them look to you to give them their food in its time.
You give to them, and they gather it up; you open your hand, and they are satisfied with good.
You hide your face, and they are terrified; you withdraw their breath, and they die and return to their dust.
You send forth your spirit, and they are created, and you renew the surface of the ground.
Let the glory of the LORD endure for ever; let the LORD rejoice in his works.
He looks at the earth and it trembles; he touches the mountains and they smoke.
I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will make music to my God while I still am.
May my meditation be pleasing to him; I myself rejoice in the LORD.
Let sinners be finished from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my being. Hallelujah.

psalms_105.t: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name; make known his deeds among the peoples.
Sing to him, make music to him; tell of all his wonders.
Glory in his holy name; let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
Seek the LORD and his strength; seek his face continually.
Remember the wonders he did, his signs and the judgements of his mouth,
offspring of Abraham his servant, children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He is the LORD our God; his judgements are in all the earth.
He remembers his covenant for ever, the word he commanded, to a thousand generations,
which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac,
and he confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as a perpetual covenant,
saying, 'To you I will give the land of Canaan, the portion of your inheritance.'
when they were few in number, very few, and sojourners in it,
and they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
He allowed no one to oppress them, and he rebuked kings on their account:
'Do not touch my anointed ones, and do my prophets no harm.'
He called a famine on the land; he broke every staff of bread.
He sent a man before them: Joseph, sold as a slave.
They afflicted his feet with shackles; his neck was put in iron.
until the time his word came; the speech of the LORD tested him.
A king sent and released him, a ruler of peoples, and set him free.
He appointed him master of his household and ruler over all his possessions,
to bind his officials at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
Then Israel came to Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
He made his people very fruitful and made them stronger than their foes.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal deceptively with his servants.
He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
They performed among them the words of his signs, and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent darkness and made it dark, and they did not rebel against his word.
He turned their waters to blood and killed their fish.
Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
He spoke, and the swarm came, and gnats in all their territory.
He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
He struck their vines and their fig trees and broke the trees of their territory.
He spoke, and the locusts came, and young locusts without number,
and they ate all the vegetation in their land and ate the fruit of their ground.
He struck down every firstborn in their land, the first of all their vigour.
He brought them out with silver and gold, and among his tribes there was no one who stumbled.
Egypt was glad when they went out, for the dread of them had fallen on them.
He spread out a cloud as a covering, and fire to give light at night.
They asked, and he brought quail, and satisfied them with the bread of the heavens.
He opened a rock and water flowed out; it ran through the dry places like a river.
For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham his servant.
He brought out his people with joy, his chosen ones with a shout of joy.
He gave them the lands of nations, and they took possession of what the peoples had laboured for,
so that they might keep his statutes and observe his laws. Hallelujah.

psalms_106.t: Hallelujah. Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his steadfast love is for ever.
Who can tell the mighty deeds of the LORD, or proclaim all his praise?
How blessed are those who keep judgement, who do righteousness at all times!
Remember me, LORD, with the favour you show your people; visit me with your salvation,
to look on the good of your chosen ones, to rejoice in the joy of your nation, to glory with your inheritance.
We have sinned with our fathers; we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly.
Our fathers in Egypt did not consider your wonders; they did not remember the abundance of your acts of steadfast love, but rebelled at the sea, at the Sea of Reeds.
Yet he saved them for the sake of his name, to make known his might.
He rebuked the Sea of Reeds and it dried up, and he led them through the deeps as through the wilderness.
He saved them from the hand of the one who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
The waters covered their foes; not one of them was left.
Then they believed his words; they sang his praise.
They quickly forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.
They craved a craving in the wilderness and tested God in the wasteland.
He gave them their petition but sent a wasting disease among them.
They were envious of Moses in the camp, and of Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
The earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered over the company of Abiram.
Fire burned among their company; a flame burned up the wicked.
They made a calf at Horeb and bowed down to a molten image.
They exchanged their glory for the image of an ox that eats grass.
They forgot God their saviour, who did great things in Egypt,
wonders in the land of Ham, fearsome deeds at the Sea of Reeds.
So he said he would destroy them — had not Moses his chosen one stood in the breach before him to turn back his rage from destroying.
They rejected the desirable land; they did not believe his word.
They murmured in their tents; they did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
So he raised his hand against them, to make them fall in the wilderness,
and to make their offspring fall among the nations and to scatter them among the lands.
They joined themselves to Baal of Peor and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
They provoked him to anger by their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
And it was reckoned to him as righteousness to all generations, for ever.
They provoked wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses because of them,
for they rebelled against his spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.
They did not destroy the peoples, as the LORD had told them,
but they mixed with the nations and learned their works.
They served their idols, and these became a snare to them.
They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.
They became unclean by their works and played the whore by their deeds.
So the anger of the LORD burned against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.
He gave them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
Their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.
Many times he delivered them, but they rebelled in their plans and sank low in their iniquity.
Yet he saw their distress when he heard their cry of entreaty.
He remembered his covenant for their sake and relented according to the abundance of his acts of steadfast love.
He gave them over to compassion before all their captors.
Save us, LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to glory in your praise.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. And let all the people say, 'Amen.' Hallelujah.

psalms_107.t: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his steadfast love is for ever.
Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, those he has redeemed from the hand of the foe
and gathered from the lands, from east and from west, from north and from the sea.
They wandered in the wilderness, in a trackless waste; they found no city to dwell in.
Hungry and thirsty, their being fainted away within them.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress; he delivered them from their troubles.
He led them by a straight way, to go to a city to dwell in.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
for he satisfies the longing throat and fills the hungry throat with good.
Those who sat in darkness and deep darkness, prisoners in affliction and iron,
because they had rebelled against the sayings of God and spurned the counsel of the Most High.
So he humbled their heart with trouble; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
Then they cried aloud to the LORD in their distress; he saved them from their troubles.
He brought them out from darkness and deep darkness and tore their fetters apart.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
for he has broken gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.
The senseless were afflicted because of the way of their transgression and because of their iniquities.
Their throat loathed all food, and they came to the gates of death.
Then they cried aloud to the LORD in their distress; he saved them from their troubles.
He sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their pits.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and recount his works with a shout of joy.
Those who go down to the sea in ships, doing business on the great waters —
they saw the works of the LORD and his wonders in the deep.
He spoke and raised up a stormy wind, and it lifted its waves high.
They went up to the heavens, they went down to the deeps; their being melted away in the trouble.
They reeled and staggered like a drunkard, and all their skill was swallowed up.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and he brought them out of their troubles.
He stilled the storm to a whisper, and the waves were hushed.
They rejoiced because the waters were quiet, and he guided them to the harbour they desired.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love, and for his wonders to the children of humankind,
and let them exalt him in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
He turns rivers into wilderness, and springs of water into thirsty ground,
a fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the evil of those who dwell in it.
He turns wilderness into a pool of water, and dry land into springs of water.
He settles the hungry there, and they establish a city to dwell in;
they sow fields and plant vineyards and produce a fruitful yield.
He blesses them, and they multiply greatly, and he does not let their cattle grow few.
Then they became few and were bowed down by the pressure of calamity and sorrow.
He pours out contempt on nobles and makes them wander in a trackless waste.
But he sets the needy on high, away from affliction, and makes their families like a flock.
The upright see it and rejoice, and all injustice shuts its mouth.
Whoever is wise, let them observe these things and consider carefully the acts of steadfast love of the LORD.

psalms_108.t: A song. A psalm of David.
My heart is steadfast, God; I will sing and make music — my glory too.
Awake, harp and lyre! I will waken the dawn.
I will give you thanks among the peoples, LORD, and make music to you among the nations.
For your steadfast love is great above the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Be exalted above the heavens, God, and let your glory be over all the earth.
So that your beloved may be rescued, save with your right hand and answer me.
God has spoken in his sanctuary: 'I will exult; I will divide up Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.
'Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the protection of my head, Judah my commander's staff.
'Moab is my washing pot; over Edom I throw my sandal; over Philistia I shout aloud.'
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?
Have you not rejected us, God? You do not go out, God, with our armies.
Give us help against the foe, for human salvation is vain.
With God we will do valiantly, and he will tread down our foes.

psalms_109.t: For the choir director. Of David. A psalm.
God of my praise, do not be silent,
for the mouth of the wicked and a mouth of deceit have opened against me; they have spoken to me with a tongue of falsehood.
With words of hatred they have surrounded me; they have fought against me without cause.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I am prayer.
They have repaid me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Appoint a wicked man over him, and let an accuser stand at his right hand.
When he is judged, let him come out guilty, and let his prayer be counted as sin.
Let his days be few; let another take his office.
Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
Let his children wander about and beg, seeking far from their ruins.
Let a creditor seize all that belongs to him, and let strangers plunder what he has laboured for.
Let there be no one to extend steadfast love to him, no one to show favour to his fatherless children.
Let his posterity be cut off; in the next generation let their name be wiped out.
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and let his mother's sin not be wiped out.
Let them be before the LORD continually, and let him cut off their memory from the earth,
because he did not remember to show steadfast love, but harassed the poor and needy and the disheartened, to put them to death.
He loved a curse, and it came upon him; he did not delight in blessing, and it stayed far from him.
He put on a curse as his garment, and it came like water into his inward parts, and like oil into his bones.
Let it be for him like a garment he wraps himself in, like a band he puts on every day.
This is the wage of my accusers from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my life.
But you, GOD the Lord, deal with me for the sake of your name; because your steadfast love is good, deliver me.
For I am poor and needy, and my heart is pierced within me.
Like a lengthening shadow I have gone; I have been shaken off like a locust.
My knees give way from fasting, and my flesh has grown lean, without fat.
And I have become a reproach to them; they see me and shake their head.
Help me, LORD my God; save me according to your steadfast love,
and let them know that this is your hand, that you, LORD, have done it.
Let them curse, but you will bless. They have risen up and been put to shame, but your servant will rejoice.
Let my accusers be clothed with ignominy, and wrap themselves in their shame like a robe.
I will give thanks to the LORD greatly with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise him.
For he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his life.

psalms_110.t: Declares the LORD to my lord: 'Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.'
The LORD will stretch out the staff of your strength from Zion: 'Rule in the midst of your enemies!'
Your people are freewill offerings on the day of your force; in majesties of holiness, from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten you.
The LORD has sworn and will not relent: 'You are a priest for ever after the manner of Melchizedek.'
The Lord is at your right hand; he shatters kings on the day of his anger.
He judges among the nations — the field is full of corpses; he shatters the head over the wide earth.
From a wadi by the way he drinks; therefore he lifts up his head.

psalms_111.t: Hallelujah. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart, in the council of the upright and in the congregation.
Great are the works of the LORD, studied by all who delight in them.
Splendour and majesty are his work, and his righteousness endures for ever.
He has made a remembrance for his wonders; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
He gives food to those who fear him; he remembers his covenant for ever.
He has declared the power of his works to his people, in giving them the inheritance of nations.
The works of his hands are faithfulness and judgement; all his precepts are trustworthy.
They are sustained for ever and ever, done in faithfulness and uprightness.
He sent ransom to his people; he ordained his covenant for ever. Holy and to be feared is his name.
The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD; a good understanding belongs to all who do them. His praise endures for ever.

psalms_112.t: Hallelujah. How blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments!
His offspring will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures for ever.
Light rises in the darkness for the upright — he is gracious and compassionate and righteous.
It goes well with the one who shows favour and lends, who conducts his affairs with judgement.
For he will never be shaken; the righteous will be remembered for ever.
He will not be afraid of bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
His heart is supported; he will not be afraid, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
He has scattered abroad, he has given to the needy; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn will be lifted high in honour.
The wicked will see it and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

psalms_113.t: Hallelujah. Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
May the name of the LORD be blessed, from now and for ever.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
The LORD is exalted above all nations; his glory is above the heavens.
Who is like the LORD our God, who sets his seat on high,
who stoops down to look on the heavens and on the earth?
He raises the poor from the dust; from the ash heap he lifts up the needy,
to seat him with nobles, with the nobles of his people.
He gives the barren woman of the house a home, a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.

psalms_114.t: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange speech,
Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned back.
The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
What is it with you, sea, that you flee, Jordan, that you turn back,
mountains, that you skip like rams, hills, like lambs?
Tremble, earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turns the rock into a pool of water, flint into a spring of water.

psalms_115.t: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love, for the sake of your faithfulness.
Why should the nations say, 'Where now is their God?'
But our God is in the heavens; he does all that he desires.
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have a mouth, but do not speak; eyes, but do not see;
ears, but do not hear; a nose, but do not smell;
hands, but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; they make no sound in their throat.
Those who make them will become like them, and everyone who trusts in them.
Israel, trust in the LORD; he is their help and their shield.
House of Aaron, trust in the LORD; he is their help and their shield.
You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; he is their help and their shield.
The LORD has remembered us; he will bless. He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless those who fear the LORD, the small along with the great.
May the LORD increase you, you and your children.
Blessed are you by the LORD, maker of the heavens and the earth.
The heavens are the heavens of the LORD, but the earth he has given to the children of humankind.
The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do any who go down into silence.
But we will bless the LORD from now and for ever. Hallelujah.

psalms_116.t: I love the LORD, because he hears my voice, my supplications;
because he has inclined his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.
The cords of death surrounded me, and the distresses of Sheol found me; I found trouble and sorrow.
And I called on the name of the LORD: 'I beg you, LORD, deliver my life!'
Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; our God is compassionate.
The LORD guards the simple; I had been brought low, and he saved me.
Return, my being, to your rest, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
For you have rescued my life from death, my eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.
I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, and so I spoke; I was greatly afflicted.
I said in my alarm, 'Everyone is a liar.'
What shall I give back to the LORD for all his benefits to me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
I will pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people.
Precious in the eyes of the LORD is the death of his loyal ones.
I beg you, LORD — for I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your maidservant. You have loosened my fetters.
To you I will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and call on the name of the LORD.
I will pay my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of the house of the LORD, in your midst, Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

psalms_117.t: Praise the LORD, all nations; extol him, all peoples.
For his steadfast love is strong over us, and the faithfulness of the LORD is for ever. Hallelujah.

psalms_118.t: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his steadfast love is for ever.
Let Israel say: 'His steadfast love is for ever.'
